# .gitattributes

```
# Disable autocrlf on generated files, they always generate with LF
# Add any extra files or paths here to make git stop saying they
# are changed when only line endings change.
src/generated/**/.cache/cache text eol=lf
src/generated/**/*.json text eol=lf

```

# .github\workflows\build.yml

```yml
name: Build

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Setup JDK 26
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '26'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Build with Gradle
        run: ./gradlew build
```

# BNF.bnf

```bnf
// Basic building blocks
letter       ::= [a-z] | [A-Z] | '_'
char         ::= any character except '"' or '\n'
any_char     ::= any printable character other than '\n'
text         ::= any_char text | ε

// Constants
const        ::= long_const | double_const | string_const | bool_const | array_literal
long_const   ::= '[0-9]+'
double_const ::= '[0-9]+' '.' '[0-9]+' ( 'd' | 'D' | '' ) | '[0-9]+' ( 'd' | 'D' )
string_const ::= '"' char_seq '"'
char_seq     ::= char | char char_seq
bool_const   ::= 'true' | 'True' | 'false' | 'False'
array_literal ::= '[' const_list ']'
const_list   ::= const | const ',' const_list

// Names and identifiers
name         ::= letter name_rest
name_rest    ::= ε | letter name_rest

// Variable, parameter, and placeholder
holder       ::= 'p' | 'g' | 't'[name]
var          ::= holder '.' name

phname       ::= 'server.name' | 'server.shortname' | 'player.name' | 'player.ping' | 'player.health' |
                 'player.maxhealth' | 'player.hunger' | 'player.experience' | 'player.level' | 'player.version' |
                 'player.protocol' | 'player.gamemode' | 'player.region.name' | 'player.location.x' |
                 'player.location.y' | 'player.location.z' | 'player.location.pitch' | 'player.location.yaw' |
                 'player.pos.x' | 'player.pos.y' | 'player.pos.z' | 'player.group.name' | 'player.group.tag' |
                 'player.group.priority' | 'player.group.color' | 'player.team.name' | 'player.team.tag' |
                 'player.team.color' | 'player.team.players' '(' name ')' | 'player.parkour.ticks' |
                 'player.parkour.formatted' | 'house.name' | 'house.guests' | 'house.cookies' |
                 'house.visitingrules' | 'house.players' | 'date.day' '(' name ')' | 'date.month' '(' name ')' |
                 'date.year' '(' name ')' | 'date.hour' '(' name ')' | 'date.minute' '(' name ')' |
                 'date.seconds' '(' name ')' | 'date.unix' | 'date.unix.ms' | 'random.whole' '(' long_arg ',' long_arg ')' |
                 'random.decimal' '(' double_arg ',' double_arg ')' | 'var.player' '(' name ',' const_expr ')' |
                 'var.global' '(' name ',' const_expr ')' | 'var.team' '(' name ',' name ',' const_expr ')'
placeholder  ::= 'ph' '.' phname

// Types
base_type    ::= 'long' | 'double' | 'string' | 'var'
type         ::= base_type | base_type '[' long_arg ']'

// Expressions (can involve variables, functions, etc.)
expr         ::= var
              | array_operation
              | placeholder
              | func_call
              | general_math_expr

// Strict constant-only expressions
const_expr   ::= const
              | identifier
              | '(' const_expr ')'
              | const_expr '+' const_expr
              | const_expr '-' const_expr
              | const_expr '*' const_expr
              | const_expr '/' const_expr
              | const_expr '++'
              | const_expr '--'
              | '-' const_expr
              | const_expr '%' const_expr

// General math (can include variables or anything else from expr)
general_math_expr ::= expr '+' expr
                    | expr '-' expr
                    | expr '*' expr
                    | expr '/' expr
                    | expr '++'
                    | expr '--'
                    | '-' expr
                    | '|' expr '|'
                    | expr '%' expr
                    | 'sin' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'asin' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'cos' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'acos' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'tan' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'atan' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'sqrt' '(' expr ')'
                    | 'nroot' '(' expr ',' expr ')'
                    | 'pow' '(' expr ',' expr ')'
                    | '(' expr ')'
                    | expr comp_op expr
                    | '!' expr
                    | bool_expr log_op bool_expr


identifier ::= 'PI' | 'E' | 'HALF_PI' | 'TWO_PI'

array_operation ::= var '[' long_arg ']' | var '.' 'length'

// Boolean operations
bool_expr    ::= expr comp_op expr
              | '!' bool_expr
              | bool_expr log_op bool_expr
              | h_cond
              | bool_arg

comp_op      ::= '<' | '>' | '<=' | '>=' | '==' | '!='
log_op       ::= '||' | '&&'

// Statements
cond         ::= note 'if' '(' bool_expr ')' '{' stmt_list '}'
              | note 'if' '(' bool_expr ')' '{' stmt_list '}' 'else' '{' stmt_list '}'

stmt_list    ::= ε | stmt | stmt stmt_list
stmt         ::= asgn ';' | def ';' | define ';' | h_action ';' | func_call ';' | broadcast_func_call ';' | return ';'
              | cond | cmt

// Actions
h_action     ::= note 'setGroup' '(' string_arg ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'kill' '(' ')'
              | note 'heal' '(' ')'
              | note 'title' '(' expr ',' expr ',' long_arg ',' long_arg ',' long_arg ')'
              | note 'actionBar' '(' expr ')'
              | note 'clear' '(' ')'
              | note 'maxHealth' '(' expr ',' operation ',' bool_arg')'
              | note 'checkpoint' '(' ')'
              | note 'give' '(' item ',' bool_arg ',' slot ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'remove' '(' item ')'
              | note 'send' '(' expr ')'
              | note 'effect' '(' potion ',' long_arg ',' long_arg ',' bool_arg  ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'clearEffect' '(' ')'
              | note 'xp' '(' long_arg ')'
              | note 'lobby' '(' lobby ')'
              | note 'tp' '(' location ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'fail' '(' string_arg ')'
              | note 'sound' '(' sound ',' double_arg ',' double_arg ',' location ')'
              | note 'compass' '(' location ')'
              | note 'gamemode' '(' gamemode ')'
              | note 'health' '(' expr ',' operation ')'
              | note 'hunger' '(' expr ',' operation ')'
              | note 'layout' '(' string_arg ')'
              | note 'enchant' '(' long_arg ')'
              | note 'sleep' '(' long_arg ')'
              | note 'team' '(' string_arg ')'
              | note 'menu' '(' string_arg ')'
              | note 'drop' '(' item ',' location ',' bool_arg ',' bool_arg ',' bool_arg ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'velocity' '(' expr ',' expr ',' expr ')'
              | note 'launch' '(' location ',' expr ')'
              | note 'weather' '(' weather ')'
              | note 'time' '(' time ')'
              | note 'nametag' '(' bool_arg ')'

h_cond       ::= note 'hasGroup' '(' string_arg ',' bool_arg ')'
              | note 'hasPermission' '(' permission ')'
              | note 'withinRegion' '(' string_arg ')'
              | note 'hasItem' '(' item ',' what_check ',' where_check ',' amount ')'
              | note 'doingParkour' '(' ')'
              | note 'hasEffect' '(' potion ')'
              | note 'isSneaking' '(' ')'
              | note 'isFlying' '(' ')'
              | note 'condHealth' '(' comparator ',' expr ')'
              | note 'condMaxHealth' '(' comparator ',' expr ')'
              | note 'condHunger' '(' comparator ',' expr ')'
              | note 'hasGamemode' '(' gamemode ')'
              | note 'hasTeam' '(' string_arg ')'


// return
return ::= 'return' expr | 'return'

string_arg   ::= const_expr
long_arg     ::= const_expr
bool_arg     ::= const_expr
double_arg   ::= const_expr


operation    ::= 'set' | 'inc' | 'dec' | 'mult' | 'div'
comparator   ::= 'l' | 'le' | 'e' | 'ge' | 'g'

item         ::= 'item' '{' item_field_list '}'
item_field_list ::= item_field | item_field ',' item_field_list
item_field   ::= 'id' '=' string_const | 'name' '=' string_const | 'count' '=' long_const

// Assignments and definitions
asgn         ::= note var '=' expr
              | note var '+=' expr
              | note var '-=' expr
              | note var '*=' expr
              | note var '/=' expr
              | note var '%=' expr

def          ::= type var

define       ::= 'define' name '=' const_expr

// Comments
cmt          ::= '//' text '\n' | '/*' text '*/'

// Function related
func_def     ::= note 'function' type name '(' param_list ')' '{' stmt_list '}'
              | note 'function' name '(' param_list ')' '{' stmt_list '}'

func_call    ::= note name '(' arg_list ')'
broadcast_func_call ::= note 'broadcast' name '(' arg_list ')'

param_list   ::= ε | param | param ',' param_list
param        ::= type var
arg_list     ::= ε | expr | expr ',' arg_list

// Repeats, events, random
repeat       ::= 'repeat' '(' long_arg ')' '{' stmt_list '}'
event_def    ::= 'event' event_name '{' stmt_list '}'
random       ::= 'random' '{' stmt_list '}'

// Commands
cmd_mode     ::= 'self' | 'target' | ε
cmd_param    ::= 'priority' '=' long_arg | 'listed' '=' bool_const
cmd_params   ::= '(' ')' | '(' cmd_param ')' | '(' cmd_param ',' cmd_param ')' | ε
command_def  ::= 'command' name cmd_mode cmd_params '{' stmt_list '}'

// Preprocessor directives (processed before parsing)
define_dir   ::= 'define' name '=' string_const ';'
import_dir   ::= 'import' string_const ';'

// Descriptions and metadata
note         ::= ε | '///' text '\n'
event_name   ::= 'PlayerJoin' | 'PLayerQuit' | 'PlayerDeath' | 'PlayerKill' | 'PlayerRespawn'
              | 'GroupChange' | 'PvpStateChange' | 'FishCaught' | 'PlayerEnterPortal' | 'PlayerDamage'
              | 'PlayerBlockBreak' | 'StartParkour' | 'CompleteParkour' | 'PlayerDropItem'
              | 'PlayerPickUpItem' | 'PlayerChangeHeldItem' | 'PlayerToggleSneak' | 'PlayerToggleFlight'

// Menus
slot_id      ::= 'slot' long_const
slot_def     ::= slot_id ':' '(' item ')' '{' stmt_list '}'
menu_def     ::= 'menu' name '(' long_const ')' '{' slot_def* '}'

// Program entry
main         ::= func_def | event_def | command_def | menu_def | define_dir | import_dir
```

# common\build.gradle

```gradle
apply plugin: 'dev.architectury.loom'
apply plugin: 'architectury-plugin'

architectury {
    common('neoforge', 'fabric')
}

base {
    archivesName = "${mod_id}-common"
}

loom {
    silentMojangMappingsLicense()
}

version = mod_version
group = mod_group_id
java.toolchain.languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)

dependencies {
    def mcVer    = rootProject.ext.active_mc_version
    def parchMc  = rootProject.ext.active_parch_mc
    def parchVer = rootProject.ext.active_parch_ver

    minecraft "com.mojang:minecraft:${mcVer}"
    if (parchVer && parchMc) {
        mappings loom.layered() {
            officialMojangMappings()
            parchment("org.parchmentmc.data:parchment-${parchMc}:${parchVer}@zip")
        }
    } else {
        mappings loom.layered() { officialMojangMappings() }
    }

    compileOnly "net.fabricmc:fabric-loader:${fabric_loader_version}"
}

tasks.withType(JavaCompile).configureEach { options.encoding = 'UTF-8' }

// Select version-specific compat source dirs based on active MC version.
def itemApiVersions   = ['1.21.6','1.21.7','1.21.8','1.21.9','1.21.10','1.21.11'] as Set
def mcVer = rootProject.ext.active_mc_version
sourceSets.main.java.srcDir(itemApiVersions.contains(mcVer) ? 'src/compat/mc1215plus' : 'src/compat/mc1214')
sourceSets.main.java.srcDir(
    mcVer == '1.21.11'                         ? 'src/compat/mc12111plus' :
    mcVer in ['1.21.9', '1.21.10']             ? 'src/compat/mc1219plus'  :
                                                  'src/compat/mc1218minus'
)

// Generates BuildConstants.java with the current build date baked in.
def generatedBuildSrcDir = layout.buildDirectory.dir("generated/sources/buildinfo")
sourceSets.main.java.srcDir generatedBuildSrcDir

def generateBuildConstants = tasks.register("generateBuildConstants") {
    def buildDate = new Date().format("MMMM d, yyyy")
    inputs.property("buildDate", buildDate)
    outputs.dir(generatedBuildSrcDir)
    doLast {
        def out = generatedBuildSrcDir.get()
                .file("com/drakou111/neohouse/BuildConstants.java").asFile
        out.parentFile.mkdirs()
        out.text = """\
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

public final class BuildConstants {
    public static final String BUILD_DATE = "${buildDate}";
    private BuildConstants() {}
}
"""
    }
}

tasks.named("compileJava").configure { dependsOn(generateBuildConstants) }
```

# common\src\compat\mc1214\com\drakou111\neohouse\compat\ItemParseHelper.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compat;

import com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException;
import net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.TagParser;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class ItemParseHelper {
    private ItemParseHelper() {}

    // TagParser.parseTag(String) was removed in 1.21.5; resolve once at load time.
    private static final Method PARSE_TAG;
    static {
        Method m = null;
        try { m = TagParser.class.getMethod("parseTag", String.class); }
        catch (NoSuchMethodException ignored) {}
        PARSE_TAG = m;
    }

    public static Optional<ItemStack> parse(String snbt, ClientLevel level) throws CommandSyntaxException {
        if (PARSE_TAG == null) return Optional.empty();
        try {
            CompoundTag nbt = (CompoundTag) PARSE_TAG.invoke(null, snbt);
            return ItemStack.parse(level.registryAccess(), nbt);
        } catch (java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException e) {
            Throwable cause = e.getCause();
            if (cause instanceof CommandSyntaxException) throw (CommandSyntaxException) cause;
            throw new RuntimeException("NBT parse failed", cause);
        } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("NBT parse failed", e);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compat;

import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;

public final class PoseHelper {
    private PoseHelper() {}

    public static void push(GuiGraphics g) { g.pose().pushPose(); }
    public static void pop(GuiGraphics g)  { g.pose().popPose(); }

    public static void scale(GuiGraphics g, float x, float y) {
        g.pose().scale(x, y, 1f);
    }
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compat;

import com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException;
import net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.TagParser;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtOps;
import net.minecraft.resources.RegistryOps;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.util.Optional;

public final class ItemParseHelper {
    private ItemParseHelper() {}

    public static Optional<ItemStack> parse(String snbt, ClientLevel level) throws CommandSyntaxException {
        CompoundTag nbt = TagParser.parseCompoundFully(snbt);
        RegistryOps<net.minecraft.nbt.Tag> ops =
                level.registryAccess().createSerializationContext(NbtOps.INSTANCE);
        return ItemStack.CODEC.parse(ops, nbt).result();
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compat;
```

```java
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
```
```java
import net.minecraft.client.input.KeyEvent;
import net.minecraft.client.input.MouseButtonEvent;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

public abstract class ScreenBase extends Screen {
    protected ScreenBase(Component title) { super(title); }

    private MouseButtonEvent _me; private boolean _mc;
    private MouseButtonEvent _dme; private double _ddx, _ddy;
    private MouseButtonEvent _rme;
    private KeyEvent _ke;

    @Override
    public final boolean mouseClicked(MouseButtonEvent e, boolean consumed) {
        _me = e; _mc = consumed;
        boolean r = onMouseClicked(e.x(), e.y(), e.button());
        _me = null;
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public final boolean mouseDragged(MouseButtonEvent e, double dx, double dy) {
        _dme = e; _ddx = dx; _ddy = dy;
        boolean r = onMouseDragged(e.x(), e.y(), e.button(), dx, dy);
        _dme = null;
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public final boolean mouseReleased(MouseButtonEvent e) {
        _rme = e;
        boolean r = onMouseReleased(e.x(), e.y(), e.button());
        _rme = null;
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public final boolean keyPressed(KeyEvent e) {
        _ke = e;
        boolean r = onKeyPressed(e.key(), e.scancode(), e.modifiers());
        _ke = null;
        return r;
    }

    protected boolean onMouseClicked(double mx, double my, int btn) { return superMouseClicked(mx, my, btn); }
    protected boolean onMouseDragged(double mx, double my, int btn, double dx, double dy) { return superMouseDragged(mx, my, btn, dx, dy); }
    protected boolean onMouseReleased(double mx, double my, int btn) { return superMouseReleased(mx, my, btn); }
    protected boolean onKeyPressed(int key, int scan, int mods) { return superKeyPressed(key, scan, mods); }

    protected final boolean superMouseClicked(double mx, double my, int btn) {
        return _me != null && super.mouseClicked(_me, _mc);
    }
    protected final boolean superMouseDragged(double mx, double my, int btn, double dx, double dy) {
        return _dme != null && super.mouseDragged(_dme, _ddx, _ddy);
    }
    protected final boolean superMouseReleased(double mx, double my, int btn) {
        return _rme != null && super.mouseReleased(_rme);
    }
    protected final boolean superKeyPressed(int key, int scan, int mods) {
        return _ke != null && super.keyPressed(_ke);
```
```java
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\AnvilAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AnvilScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;

public class AnvilAction extends Action {
    private final String name;

    public AnvilAction(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!(mc.screen instanceof AnvilScreen anvil)) throw new InterruptActionException("Not in anvil screen.");

        EditBox edit = anvil.children().stream()
                .filter(c -> c instanceof EditBox)
                .map(c -> (EditBox) c)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);

        if (edit == null || edit.getValue() == null || edit.getValue().isEmpty()) return false;

        edit.setValue(name);
        anvil.getMenu().setItemName(name);
        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(anvil.getMenu().containerId, 2, 0, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        return true;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\ChatAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.player.LocalPlayer;

public class ChatAction extends Action {
    private final String message;

    public ChatAction(String message) {
        this.message = message;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        LocalPlayer player = mc.player;
        if (player != null) {
            player.connection.sendChat(message);
            return true;
        }

        throw new InterruptActionException("An unexpected error occurred, could not type in chat.");
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\CheckSlotEmptyAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;

/**
 * Runs ifEmpty if the given slot has no item, otherwise runs ifOccupied.
 */
public class CheckSlotEmptyAction extends Action {
    private final int   slotIndex;
    private final Action ifEmpty;
    private final Action ifOccupied;
    private Action active = null;

    public CheckSlotEmptyAction(int slotIndex, Action ifEmpty, Action ifOccupied) {
        this.slotIndex   = slotIndex;
        this.ifEmpty     = ifEmpty;
        this.ifOccupied  = ifOccupied;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (active == null) {
            AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
            if (menu == null || menu.slots.size() <= slotIndex) return true;
            active = menu.slots.get(slotIndex).hasItem() ? ifOccupied : ifEmpty;
        }
        if (active.run(mc)) { active = null; return true; }
        return false;
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class ClientMessageAction extends Action {
    private final String message;
    private final boolean isWarning;

    public ClientMessageAction(String message, boolean isWarning) {
        this.message   = message;
        this.isWarning = isWarning;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (isWarning) MessageUtils.warningToChat(message);
        else           MessageUtils.debugToChat(message);
        return true;
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\CreativeGiveAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compat.ItemParseHelper;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ServerboundSetCreativeModeSlotPacket;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.util.Optional;

public class CreativeGiveAction extends Action {
    private final String rawItemData;

    public CreativeGiveAction(String rawItemData) {
        this.rawItemData = rawItemData;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.getConnection() == null || mc.level == null) return true;

        if (!mc.player.isCreative()) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Player must be in creative mode to give items.");
        }

        ItemStack finalStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;

        if (rawItemData != null && !rawItemData.isBlank()) {
            try {
                Optional<ItemStack> parsedStack = ItemParseHelper.parse(rawItemData, mc.level);
                finalStack = parsedStack.filter(stack -> !stack.isEmpty()).orElse(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } catch (CommandSyntaxException e) {
                throw new InterruptActionException("Tried to get an item with invalid data.");
            }
        }

        int creativeSlot = mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() - 29; // hotbar 8th slot
        mc.getConnection().send(new ServerboundSetCreativeModeSlotPacket(creativeSlot, finalStack.copy()));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresCreative() {
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;

public class DeleteAllAction extends Action {
    private final int slotIndex;
    private boolean waiting = false;
    private final WaitForAction waitFor;
    private final WaitTicksAction waitTicks;

    public DeleteAllAction(int slotIndex) {
        this.slotIndex = slotIndex;
        this.waitFor = new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true);
        this.waitTicks = new WaitTicksAction(1);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (waiting) {
            if (!waitFor.run(mc) || !waitTicks.run(mc)) {
                return false;
            }
            waitTicks.reset();
            waitFor.reset();
            waiting = false;
        }

        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        Slot s = menu.slots.get(slotIndex);

        if (s.getItem().isEmpty()) return true;

        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(menu.containerId, slotIndex, 1, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        this.waiting = true;
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;

public class DeleteAllCommandsAction extends Action {
    private Action current = null;

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return true;
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        if (menu == null) return true;

        if (current == null) {
            if (menu.slots.size() <= 10 || !menu.slots.get(10).hasItem()) return true;
            String fullName = menu.slots.get(10).getItem().getHoverName().getString();
            // Command items in the list are shown as "/commandName"; strip the slash for removeCommandIfPresent
            String name = fullName.startsWith("/") ? fullName.substring(1) : fullName;
            current = new ActionBuilder().removeCommandIfPresent(name).get();
        }

        if (current.run(mc)) current = null;
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import java.util.List;

public class GroupAction extends Action {
    private final List<Action> actions;
    private int index = 0;

    public GroupAction(List<Action> actions) {
        this.actions = actions;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        while (index < actions.size()) {
            if (!actions.get(index).run(mc)) return false;
            index++;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresCreative() {
        for (Action action : actions) {
            if (action.requiresCreative()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\SearchAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;

public class SearchAction extends Action {
    private final int[] primarySlots;
    private final String targetName;
    private final Item itemType;
    private final boolean leftClick;
    private final boolean includePlayerInventory;
    private final Action onFound;
    private final Action onNotFound;
    private final boolean paged;
    private int searchMissTicks = 0;
    private static final int SEARCH_GRACE_TICKS = 6;

    private final WaitForAction waitForUI;
    private final WaitForAction waitForFound;
    private final WaitTicksAction waitTick = new WaitTicksAction(1);

    private enum Step {
        STEP_SEARCH,
        STEP_CLICK_BACKUP,
        STEP_WAIT_UI,
        STEP_WAIT_FOUND,
        STEP_FOUND,
        STEP_NOT_FOUND,
        STEP_DONE
    }

    private Step step = Step.STEP_SEARCH;

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, boolean includePlayerInventory, boolean paged, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, boolean waitForOpen, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this.primarySlots = primarySlots;
        this.targetName = targetName;
        this.paged = paged;
        this.itemType = itemType;
        this.leftClick = leftClick;
        this.includePlayerInventory = includePlayerInventory;
        this.onFound = onFound;
        this.onNotFound = onNotFound;
        this.waitForUI = new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true);
        this.waitForFound = new WaitForAction(waitForAfterClick, waitForOpen);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, boolean waitForOpen, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, waitForAfterClick, waitForOpen, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, waitForAfterClick, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, boolean includePlayerInventory, boolean paged,  Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(null, targetName, itemType, leftClick, includePlayerInventory, paged, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(null, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return true;
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        if (menu == null) return true;

        int[] slots = primarySlots;
        if (slots == null) {
            slots = menu.slots.stream()
                    .filter(s -> includePlayerInventory || !(s.container instanceof Inventory))
                    .mapToInt(s -> s.index)
                    .toArray();
        }

        if (step == Step.STEP_SEARCH) {
            boolean found = false;

            for (int idx : slots) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= menu.slots.size()) continue;

                Slot s = menu.getSlot(idx);
                if (s.hasItem()
                    && s.getItem().getHoverName().getString().equals(targetName)
                    && (itemType == null || s.getItem().getItem() == itemType)
                    && mc.gameMode != null) {

                    mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(
                            menu.containerId,
                            idx,
                            leftClick ? 0 : 1,
                            ClickType.PICKUP,
                            mc.player
                                                         );

                    step = Step.STEP_WAIT_FOUND;
                    searchMissTicks = 0;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!found) {
                searchMissTicks++;
                if (searchMissTicks >= SEARCH_GRACE_TICKS) {
                    searchMissTicks = 0;
                    step = Step.STEP_CLICK_BACKUP;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_CLICK_BACKUP) {
            Slot arrow = menu.getSlot(slots[slots.length - 1]);
            if (arrow.hasItem() && mc.gameMode != null) {
                mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(menu.containerId, arrow.index, 0, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
                step = Step.STEP_WAIT_UI;
            } else {
                step = Step.STEP_NOT_FOUND;
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_WAIT_UI) {
            if (waitForUI.run(mc) && waitTick.run(mc)) {
                step = Step.STEP_SEARCH;
                searchMissTicks = 0;
                waitForUI.reset();
                waitTick.reset();
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_WAIT_FOUND) {
            if (waitForFound.run(mc) && waitTick.run(mc)) {
                step = Step.STEP_FOUND;
                waitForFound.reset();
                waitTick.reset();
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_FOUND) {
            if (onFound == null || onFound.run(mc)) step = Step.STEP_DONE;
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_NOT_FOUND) {
            if (onNotFound == null || onNotFound.run(mc)) step = Step.STEP_DONE;
            if (onNotFound == null) throw new InterruptActionException("Could not find item called '" + targetName + "'.");
        }
        else {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\SignAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractSignEditScreen;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;

public class SignAction extends Action {
    private final String text;
    private static final Field MESSAGES_FIELD;

    static {
        Field found = null;
        for (Field f : AbstractSignEditScreen.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            if (f.getType() == String[].class) {
                f.setAccessible(true);
                found = f;
                break;
            }
        }
        MESSAGES_FIELD = found;
    }

    public SignAction(String text) {
        this.text = text;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!(mc.screen instanceof AbstractSignEditScreen sign))
            throw new InterruptActionException("Not in sign edit screen.");

        if (MESSAGES_FIELD == null)
            throw new InterruptActionException("Could not locate sign messages field via reflection.");

        try {
            String[] msgs = (String[]) MESSAGES_FIELD.get(sign);
            if (msgs != null && msgs.length > 0) msgs[0] = text;
        } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Could not write sign text: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        sign.onClose();
        return true;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\SlotAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;

public class SlotAction extends Action {
    private final int slotIndex;
    private final boolean leftClick;
    private final boolean fromEnd;

    public SlotAction(int slotIndex, boolean leftClick) {
        this(slotIndex, leftClick, false);
    }

    public SlotAction(int slotIndex, boolean leftClick, boolean fromEnd) {
        this.slotIndex = slotIndex;
        this.leftClick = leftClick;
        this.fromEnd = fromEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.gameMode == null || mc.player == null) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("An unexpected error occurred, could not click a slot.");
        }

        int newIndex = fromEnd ? mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() - 1 - slotIndex : slotIndex;
        if (mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() <= newIndex) throw new InterruptActionException("Tried clicking a slot that doesn't exist.");
        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(mc.player.containerMenu.containerId, newIndex, leftClick ? 0 : 1, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        return true;
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\WaitForAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.platform.Platforms;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;

public class WaitForAction extends Action {
    private static final int TIMEOUT_TICKS = 200;

    private final Class<? extends Screen> screenClass;
    private final boolean waitForOpen;
    private boolean done = false;
    private boolean registered = false;
    private int ticksWaited = 0;

    public WaitForAction(Class<? extends Screen> screenClass, boolean waitForOpen) {
        this.screenClass = screenClass;
        this.waitForOpen = waitForOpen;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!registered) {
            Platforms.get().watchForScreen(this);
            registered = true;
        }
        if (done) return true;
        if (++ticksWaited > TIMEOUT_TICKS) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Timed out waiting for UI screen to " + (waitForOpen ? "open" : "close") + ".");
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean matchesScreen(Screen screen, boolean isOpening) {
        return isOpening == waitForOpen && screen != null && screenClass.isAssignableFrom(screen.getClass());
    }

    public void markDone() {
        this.done = true;
    }

    public void reset() {
        this.done = false;
        this.registered = false;
        this.ticksWaited = 0;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\WaitTicksAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class WaitTicksAction extends Action {
    private int ticks;
    private int ticksRemaining;

    public WaitTicksAction(int ticks) {
        this.ticks = ticks;
        this.ticksRemaining = ticks;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (ticksRemaining <= 0) return true;
        ticksRemaining--;
        return false;
    }

    public void reset() {
        ticksRemaining = ticks;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.BinaryOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

public class BinaryExpressionNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final BinaryOperator operator;
    public final NormalExpressionNode left;
    public final NormalExpressionNode right;

    public BinaryExpressionNode(final NormalExpressionNode left, final NormalExpressionNode right, final BinaryOperator operator, VariableType type, final Token token) {
        super(type);
        this.left = left;
        this.right = right;
        this.operator = operator;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitBinaryExpr(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "BinaryExpressionNode[operator=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", left=" + left + ", right=" + right + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "BExpr[op=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", l=" + left.toShortString() + ", r=" + right.toShortString() + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants;

import java.util.List;

public final class BoolArrayValue implements ConstantArray {
    public final List<BoolValue> value;
    public BoolArrayValue(final List<BoolValue> value) { this.value = List.copyOf(value); }
    public Object getValue() { return value; }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(value.get(i).toString());
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(value.get(i).toShortString());
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\expr\constants\ConstantNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants;
```

```java
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class ConstantNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final ConstantValue value;

    public ConstantNode(final ConstantValue value, VariableType type, final Token token) {
        super(type);
        this.value = value;
        this.token = token;

        if (value instanceof StringValue str) {
            if (str.value.length() > 256) {
                throw new SemanticException(token, "The constant '" + str.value + "' is too long.");
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitConstant(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "ConstantNode[value=" + value + ", type=" + type + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Const[v=" + value.toShortString() + ", type=" + type + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants;

import java.util.List;

public final class DoubleArrayValue implements ConstantArray {
    public final List<Double> value;
    public DoubleArrayValue(final List<Double> value) { this.value = List.copyOf(value); }
    public Object getValue() { return value; }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(value.get(i).toString());
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            double v = value.get(i);
            ret.append(String.format("%.2f", v));
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\expr\LogicalExpressionNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.LogicalOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class LogicalExpressionNode extends ConditionExpressionNode {
    public final LogicalOperator operator;
    public final List<ExpressionNode> conditions;

    public LogicalExpressionNode(final List<ExpressionNode> conditions, final LogicalOperator operator, final Token token) {
        super(VariableType.BOOL);
        if (conditions == null || conditions.isEmpty())
            this.conditions = new ArrayList<>();
        else
            this.conditions = new ArrayList<>(conditions);

        this.operator = operator;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitLogicalExpr(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder("LogicalExpressionNode[operator=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", conditions=[");
        for (int i = 0; i < conditions.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(conditions.get(i).toString());
            if (i < conditions.size() - 1)
                ret.append(", ");
        }
        ret.append("]]");
        return ret.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder("LExpr[op=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", conds=[");
        for (int i = 0; i < conditions.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(conditions.get(i).toShortString());
            if (i < conditions.size() - 1)
                ret.append(", ");
        }
        ret.append("]]");
        return ret.toString();
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\expr\var\VariableNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Holder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class VariableNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final Holder holder;
    public final String name;
    public final String teamName;

    public VariableNode(final VariableType type, final Holder holder, final String name, final String teamName, final Token token) {
        super(type);

        this.type = type;
        this.holder = holder;
        this.name = name;
        this.teamName = teamName;
        this.token = token;

        if (name.length() > 16)
            throw new SemanticException(token, "The variable named '" + name + "' is too long.");
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitVariable(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "VariableNode[type=" + type + ", holder=" + holder + ", name=" + name + ", teamName=" + teamName + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Var[type=" + type + ", hold=" + holder + ", name=" + name + ", tname=" + teamName + "]";
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainStatementNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public abstract class FunctionNode extends MainStatementNode {
    public final String name;
    public final String description;
    public StatementListNode statements;

    public FunctionNode(final String name, final String description, final StatementListNode statements, final Token token) {
        this.name = name;
        this.description = description;
        this.statements = statements;
        this.token = token;

        if (name.length() > 50)
            throw new SemanticException(token, "The function named '" + name + "' is too long.");
    }

    @Override
    public abstract <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor);
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

public class SlotNode extends ASTNode {
    public final int slotId;
    public final String item; // SNBT\0searchName format
    public final StatementListNode statements;

    public SlotNode(int slotId, String item, StatementListNode statements, Token token) {
        this.slotId = slotId;
        this.item = item;
        this.statements = statements;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitSlot(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "SlotNode[slotId=" + slotId + ", statements=" + statements + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Slot[" + slotId + ", stmts=" + statements.toShortString() + "]";
    }
}

```

```java
public class TypedFunctionNode extends FunctionNode {
    public final VariableType returnType;
    public final ParameterListNode parameters;

        super(name, description, statements, token);
        this.returnType = returnType;
        this.parameters = parameters;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitTypedFunction(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "TypedFunctionNode[name=" + name + ", description=" + description + ", returnType=" + returnType + ", parameters=" + parameters + ", statements=" + statements + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Fun[name=" + name + ", desc=" + description + ", return=" + returnType + ", params=" + parameters.toShortString() + ", stmts=" + statements.toShortString() + "]";
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\main\StatementListNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.helpers.StringHelper;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
```

```java
public class StatementListNode extends StatementNode {
    public List<StatementNode> statements;

    public StatementListNode(final List<StatementNode> statements) {
        this.statements = new ArrayList<>();
        if (statements == null) return;

        for (StatementNode statement : statements) {
            if (statement instanceof StatementListNode s)
                this.statements.addAll(s.statements);
            else
                this.statements.add(statement);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitStatements(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "StatementListNode[statements=" + statements + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "StmtList[stmts=" + StringHelper.nodeListToString(statements) + "]";
    }
}

```
