```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.call.FunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants.ConstantArrayNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants.ConstantNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants.ConstantPrimitiveNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.PlaceholderNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.*;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public abstract class DefaultVisitor extends EmptyVisitor<ASTNode> {

    public MainNode analyze(MainNode main) {
        return (MainNode) main.accept(this);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitConstant(ConstantNode constant) {
        return constant;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitConstantPrimitive(ConstantPrimitiveNode constant)  {
        return constant;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitConstantArray(ConstantArrayNode constant) {
        return constant;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitUnaryExpr(UnaryExpressionNode unaryExpression) {
        NormalExpressionNode operand = (NormalExpressionNode) unaryExpression.operand.accept(this);
        return new UnaryExpressionNode(unaryExpression.operator, operand, unaryExpression.type, unaryExpression.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitBinaryExpr(BinaryExpressionNode binaryExpression) {
        NormalExpressionNode left = (NormalExpressionNode)binaryExpression.left.accept(this);
        NormalExpressionNode right = (NormalExpressionNode)binaryExpression.right.accept(this);
        return new BinaryExpressionNode(left, right, binaryExpression.operator, binaryExpression.type, binaryExpression.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitBooleanExpr(BooleanExpressionNode booleanExpression) {
        NormalExpressionNode left = (NormalExpressionNode)booleanExpression.left.accept(this);
        NormalExpressionNode right = (NormalExpressionNode)booleanExpression.right.accept(this);
        return new BooleanExpressionNode(left, right, booleanExpression.operator, booleanExpression.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitLogicalExpr(LogicalExpressionNode logicalExpression) {
        List<ExpressionNode> expressions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ExpressionNode expr : logicalExpression.conditions) {
            expressions.add((ExpressionNode)expr.accept(this));
        }
        return new LogicalExpressionNode(expressions, logicalExpression.operator, logicalExpression.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitVariable(VariableNode variable) {
        return variable;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitPlaceholder(PlaceholderNode placeholder) {
        ConstantPrimitiveList constants = (ConstantPrimitiveList)placeholder.constants.accept(this);
        return new PlaceholderNode(placeholder.placeholder, constants, placeholder.type, placeholder.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitFunctionCall(FunctionCallNode functionCall) {
        ArgumentListNode args = (ArgumentListNode)functionCall.arguments.accept(this);
        return new FunctionCallNode(functionCall.functionName, args, functionCall.type, functionCall.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode function) {
        ParameterListNode params = (ParameterListNode)function.parameters.accept(this);
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)function.statements.accept(this);
        return new TypedFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, function.returnType, params, stmts, function.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode function) {
        ParameterListNode params = (ParameterListNode)function.parameters.accept(this);
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)function.statements.accept(this);
        return new VoidFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, params, stmts, function.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitLoop(LoopNode loop) {
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)loop.statements.accept(this);
        return new LoopNode(loop.name, loop.description, stmts, loop.tickDelay, loop.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitEvent(EventNode event) {
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)event.statements.accept(this);
        return new EventNode(event.event, stmts, event.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitCommand(CommandNode command) {
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)command.statements.accept(this);
        return new CommandNode(command.name, command.targeted, command.priority, command.listed, stmts, command.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitMenu(MenuNode menu) {
        List<SlotNode> slots = new ArrayList<>();
        for (SlotNode slot : menu.slots) {
            slots.add((SlotNode) slot.accept(this));
        }
        return new MenuNode(menu.name, menu.rows, slots, menu.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitSlot(SlotNode slot) {
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode) slot.statements.accept(this);
        return new SlotNode(slot.slotId, slot.item, stmts, slot.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitGlobalDeclaration(GlobalDeclarationNode declaration) {
        VariableNode var = (VariableNode)declaration.variable.accept(this);
        return new GlobalDeclarationNode(var, declaration.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitTypedReturn(TypedReturnNode returnNode) {
        NormalExpressionNode expr = (NormalExpressionNode)returnNode.expression.accept(this);
        return new TypedReturnNode(expr, returnNode.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitVoidReturn(VoidReturnNode returnNode) {
        return returnNode;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitCancel(CancelNode cancelNode) {
        return cancelNode;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitConditional(ConditionalNode conditional) {
        ExpressionNode cond = null;
        if (conditional.condition != null)
            cond = (ExpressionNode)conditional.condition.accept(this);
        StatementListNode thenBlock = (StatementListNode)conditional.thenBlock.accept(this);
        StatementListNode elseBlock = null;
        if (conditional.elseBlock != null)
            elseBlock = (StatementListNode)conditional.elseBlock.accept(this);
        return new ConditionalNode(cond, thenBlock, elseBlock, conditional.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitDefinition(DefinitionNode definition) {
        return definition;
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitDeclaration(DeclarationNode declaration) {
        VariableNode var = (VariableNode)declaration.variable.accept(this);
        return new DeclarationNode(var, declaration.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitAssignation(AssignationNode assignation) {
        VariableNode var = (VariableNode)assignation.variable.accept(this);
        NormalExpressionNode expr = (NormalExpressionNode)assignation.value.accept(this);
        return new AssignationNode(var, assignation.operator, expr, assignation.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitVoidFunctionCall(VoidFunctionCallNode function) {
        ArgumentListNode args = (ArgumentListNode)function.arguments.accept(this);
        return new VoidFunctionCallNode(function.functionName, args, function.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitGlobalFunctionCall(GlobalFunctionCallNode function) {
        ArgumentListNode args = (ArgumentListNode)function.arguments.accept(this);
        return new GlobalFunctionCallNode(function.functionName, args, function.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitRandom(RandomNode random) {
        List<StatementListNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementListNode list : random.statements) {
            stmts.add((StatementListNode)list.accept(this));
        }
        return new RandomNode(stmts, random.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitRepeat(RepeatNode repeat) {
        StatementListNode stmts = (StatementListNode)repeat.statements.accept(this);
        return new RepeatNode(repeat.count, stmts, repeat.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitConditionCall(ConditionCallNode condCall) {
        ArgumentListNode argList = (ArgumentListNode)condCall.arguments.accept(this);
        return new ConditionCallNode(condCall.name, argList, condCall.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitActionCall(ActionCallNode actionCall) {
        ArgumentListNode argList = (ArgumentListNode)actionCall.arguments.accept(this);
        return new ActionCallNode(actionCall.name, argList, actionCall.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitMain(MainNode main) {
        List<MainStatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (MainStatementNode stmt : main.statements) {
            stmts.add((MainStatementNode)stmt.accept(this));
        }
        return new MainNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitStatements(StatementListNode statements) {
        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementNode stmt : statements.statements) {
            stmts.add((StatementNode)stmt.accept(this));
        }
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitParameters(ParameterListNode parameters) {
        List<VariableNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VariableNode stmt : parameters.parameters) {
            stmts.add((VariableNode)stmt.accept(this));
        }
        return new ParameterListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitArguments(ArgumentListNode arguments) {
        List<NormalExpressionNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (NormalExpressionNode stmt : arguments.expressions) {
            stmts.add((NormalExpressionNode)stmt.accept(this));
        }
        return new ArgumentListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitPrimitiveConstants(ConstantPrimitiveList constants) {
        return constants;
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\FunctionBodyRewriter.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.AssignationNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.TypedReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.AssignmentOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Holder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.helpers.HolderAndName;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class FunctionBodyRewriter extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final Map<HolderAndName, String> renameMap;

    FunctionBodyRewriter(Map<HolderAndName, String> renameMap) {
        this.renameMap = renameMap;
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVariable(VariableNode var) {
        HolderAndName key = new HolderAndName(var.holder, var.name);
        if (renameMap.containsKey(key)) {
            String newName = renameMap.get(key);
            return new VariableNode(var.type, var.holder, newName, var.teamName, var.token);
        }
        return var;
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedReturn(TypedReturnNode ret) {
        NormalExpressionNode rewrittenExpr = (NormalExpressionNode) ret.expression.accept(this);

        VariableNode outVar = new VariableNode(ret.expression.type, Holder.PLAYER, "o$", null, ret.token);
        AssignationNode assignToO = new AssignationNode(outVar, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, rewrittenExpr, ret.token);

        VoidReturnNode voidReturn = new VoidReturnNode(ret.token);
        return new StatementListNode(List.of(assignToO, voidReturn));
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\FunctionCallLoweringVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.ExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.call.FunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.AssignationNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.GlobalFunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.TypedReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidFunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.AssignmentOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Holder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class FunctionCallLoweringVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {

    private final Map<String, VoidFunctionNode> voidFunctions = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, TypedFunctionNode> typedFunctions = new HashMap<>();


    public FunctionCallLoweringVisitor(MainNode main) {
        for (MainStatementNode top : main.statements) {
            if (top instanceof TypedFunctionNode tf) {
                String name = tf.name;
                if (typedFunctions.containsKey(name) || voidFunctions.containsKey(name)) {
                    throw new SemanticException(tf.token, "Duplicate function name '" + name + "'");
                }
                typedFunctions.put(name, tf);

            } else if (top instanceof VoidFunctionNode vf) {
                String name = vf.name;
                if (typedFunctions.containsKey(name) || voidFunctions.containsKey(name)) {
                    throw new SemanticException(vf.token, "Duplicate function name '" + name + "'");
                }
                voidFunctions.put(name, vf);
            }
        }
    }

    private record ArgLowerResult(NormalExpressionNode simple, List<StatementNode> stmts) {}

    private ArgLowerResult lowerArgument(ExpressionNode expr) {
        if (expr instanceof FunctionCallNode tfc) {
            TypedFunctionNode def = typedFunctions.get(tfc.functionName);
            List<VariableNode> params = def.parameters.parameters;
            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();

            List<NormalExpressionNode> realArgs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < tfc.arguments.expressions.size(); i++) {
                ExpressionNode rawArg = tfc.arguments.expressions.get(i);
                ArgLowerResult sub = lowerArgument(rawArg);
                stmts.addAll(sub.stmts());
                realArgs.add(sub.simple);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < realArgs.size(); i++) {
                NormalExpressionNode argExpr = realArgs.get(i);
                VariableNode param = params.get(i);
                String newName = tfc.functionName + "_p$" + i;
                VariableNode target = new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, newName, param.teamName, tfc.token);
                stmts.add(new AssignationNode(target, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, argExpr, tfc.token));
            }
            stmts.add(new VoidFunctionCallNode(tfc.functionName, new ArgumentListNode(List.of()), tfc.token));
            VariableNode resultVar = new VariableNode(def.returnType, Holder.PLAYER, "o$", null, tfc.token);
            return new ArgLowerResult(resultVar, stmts);
        }

        return new ArgLowerResult((NormalExpressionNode) expr, List.of());
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunctionCall(VoidFunctionCallNode call) {
        VoidFunctionNode def = voidFunctions.get(call.functionName);

        // Allow calling a typed function as void (return value discarded)
        if (def == null) {
            TypedFunctionNode typedDef = typedFunctions.get(call.functionName);
            if (typedDef != null) {
                return lowerTypedCallAsVoid(call, typedDef);
            }
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Undefined function '" + call.functionName + "'");
        }

        List<NormalExpressionNode> rawArgs = call.arguments.expressions;
        List<VariableNode> params = def.parameters.parameters;

        if (rawArgs.size() != params.size()) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Function " + call.functionName + " expects " + params.size() + " arguments but got " + rawArgs.size());
        }

        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < rawArgs.size(); i++) {
            ArgLowerResult lowered = lowerArgument(rawArgs.get(i));
            stmts.addAll(lowered.stmts());
            VariableNode param = params.get(i);
            String newName = call.functionName + "_p$" + i;
            VariableNode target = new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, newName, param.teamName, call.token);
            stmts.add(new AssignationNode(target, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, lowered.simple, call.token));
        }

        stmts.add(new VoidFunctionCallNode(call.functionName, new ArgumentListNode(List.of()), call.token));

        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    private ASTNode lowerTypedCallAsVoid(VoidFunctionCallNode call, TypedFunctionNode def) {
        List<NormalExpressionNode> rawArgs = call.arguments.expressions;
        List<VariableNode> params = def.parameters.parameters;

        if (rawArgs.size() != params.size()) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Function " + call.functionName + " expects " + params.size() + " arguments but got " + rawArgs.size());
        }

        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < rawArgs.size(); i++) {
            ArgLowerResult lowered = lowerArgument(rawArgs.get(i));
            stmts.addAll(lowered.stmts());
            VariableNode param = params.get(i);
            String newName = call.functionName + "_p$" + i;
            VariableNode target = new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, newName, param.teamName, call.token);
            stmts.add(new AssignationNode(target, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, lowered.simple, call.token));
        }
        // Call the function; the return value in o$ is simply discarded
        stmts.add(new VoidFunctionCallNode(call.functionName, new ArgumentListNode(List.of()), call.token));
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitGlobalFunctionCall(GlobalFunctionCallNode call) {
        TypedFunctionNode def = typedFunctions.get(call.functionName);
        if (def == null) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Undefined function '" + call.functionName + "'");
        }

        List<NormalExpressionNode> rawArgs = call.arguments.expressions;
        List<VariableNode> params = def.parameters.parameters;

        if (rawArgs.size() != params.size()) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Function " + call.functionName + " expects " + params.size() + " arguments but got " + rawArgs.size());
        }

        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < rawArgs.size(); i++) {
            ArgLowerResult lowered = lowerArgument(rawArgs.get(i));
            stmts.addAll(lowered.stmts());

            VariableNode param = params.get(i);
            String newName = call.functionName + "_p$" + i;
            VariableNode target = new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, newName, param.teamName, call.token);
            stmts.add(new AssignationNode(target, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, lowered.simple, call.token));
        }

        stmts.add(new GlobalFunctionCallNode(call.functionName,new ArgumentListNode(List.of()),call.token));
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitAssignation(AssignationNode node) {
        ArgLowerResult lowered = lowerArgument(node.value);
        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>(lowered.stmts());
        stmts.add(new AssignationNode(node.variable, node.operator, lowered.simple, node.token));
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedReturn(TypedReturnNode returnNode) {
        ArgLowerResult lowered = lowerArgument(returnNode.expression);
        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>(lowered.stmts());
        stmts.add(new TypedReturnNode(lowered.simple, returnNode.token));
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\FunctionParamLoweringVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.ParameterListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.helpers.HolderAndName;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class FunctionParamLoweringVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode function) {
        Map<HolderAndName, String> renameMap = new HashMap<>();
        List<VariableNode> params = function.parameters.parameters;
        for (int i = 0; i < params.size(); i++) {
            VariableNode param = params.get(i);
            renameMap.put(new HolderAndName(param.holder, param.name), function.name + "_p$" + i);
        }

        StatementListNode rewrittenBody = (StatementListNode) new FunctionBodyRewriter(renameMap).visitStatements(function.statements);

        return new VoidFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, new ParameterListNode(List.of()), rewrittenBody, function.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode function) {
        Map<HolderAndName, String> renameMap = new HashMap<>();
        List<VariableNode> params = function.parameters.parameters;
        for (int i = 0; i < params.size(); i++) {
            VariableNode param = params.get(i);
            renameMap.put(new HolderAndName(param.holder, param.name), function.name + "_p$" + i);
        }

        StatementListNode rewrittenBody = (StatementListNode) new FunctionBodyRewriter(renameMap).visitStatements(function.statements);

        return new VoidFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, new ParameterListNode(List.of()), rewrittenBody, function.token);
    }

}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\LinkFunctionVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.call.FunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.ArgumentListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainStatementNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.GlobalFunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidFunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class LinkFunctionVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final Map<String, TypedFunctionNode> typedDefs = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, VoidFunctionNode> voidDefs = new HashMap<>();

    public LinkFunctionVisitor(MainNode main) {
        for (MainStatementNode top : main.statements) {
            if (top instanceof TypedFunctionNode tf) {
                String name = tf.name;
                if (typedDefs.containsKey(name) || voidDefs.containsKey(name)) {
                    throw new SemanticException(tf.token, "Duplicate function name '" + name + "'");
                }
                typedDefs.put(name, tf);

            } else if (top instanceof VoidFunctionNode vf) {
                String name = vf.name;
                if (typedDefs.containsKey(name) || voidDefs.containsKey(name)) {
                    throw new SemanticException(vf.token, "Duplicate function name '" + name + "'");
                }
                voidDefs.put(name, vf);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public MainNode analyze(MainNode main) {
        return (MainNode) main.accept(this);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitFunctionCall(FunctionCallNode call) {
        String fname = call.functionName;
        TypedFunctionNode def = typedDefs.get(fname);
        if (def == null) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Undefined typed function '" + fname + "'");
        }
        ArgumentListNode newArgs = (ArgumentListNode) call.arguments.accept(this);
        VariableType retType = def.returnType;
        return new FunctionCallNode(fname, newArgs, retType, call.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunctionCall(VoidFunctionCallNode call) {
        String fname = call.functionName;
        VoidFunctionNode def = voidDefs.get(fname);
        if (def == null) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Undefined void function '" + fname + "'");
        }
        ArgumentListNode newArgs = (ArgumentListNode) call.arguments.accept(this);
        return new VoidFunctionCallNode(fname, newArgs, call.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitGlobalFunctionCall(GlobalFunctionCallNode call) {
        String fname = call.functionName;
        VoidFunctionNode def = voidDefs.get(fname);
        if (def == null) {
            throw new SemanticException(call.token, "Undefined global function '" + fname + "')");
        }
        ArgumentListNode newArgs = (ArgumentListNode) call.arguments.accept(this);
        return new GlobalFunctionCallNode(fname, newArgs, call.token);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\PlaceholderValidationVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants.ConstantPrimitiveNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.PlaceholderNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.ConstantPrimitiveList;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Placeholder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class PlaceholderValidationVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitPlaceholder(PlaceholderNode node) {
        Placeholder sig;
        try {
            sig = Placeholder.requireByName(node.placeholder);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            throw new SemanticException(node.token, "Unknown placeholder `" + node.placeholder + "`");
        }

        ConstantPrimitiveList args = node.constants;
        int expected = sig.constTypes.size();
        if (args.constants.size() != expected) {
            throw new SemanticException(node.token, "`" + node.placeholder + "` expects " + expected + " constant(s), but got " + args.constants.size());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < expected; i++) {
            ConstantPrimitiveNode c = args.constants.get(i);
            VariableType want = sig.constTypes.get(i);
            if (c.type != want) {
                throw new SemanticException(c.token, "Placeholder `" + node.placeholder + "` parameter #" + (i+1) + " must be " + want + " but found " + c.type);
            }
        }
        return new PlaceholderNode(node.placeholder, node.constants, sig.type, node.token);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\RandomUnfoldingVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.RandomNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidFunctionCallNode;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class RandomUnfoldingVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final List<VoidFunctionNode> generated = new ArrayList<>();
    private int nextId = 0;

    @Override
    public MainNode analyze(MainNode main) {
        MainNode rewritten = (MainNode) main.accept(this);
        List<MainStatementNode> all = new ArrayList<>(rewritten.statements);
        all.addAll(generated);
        return new MainNode(all);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRandom(RandomNode random) {
        List<StatementListNode> newOptions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementListNode arm : random.statements) {
            if (arm.statements.size() <= 1) {
                newOptions.add(arm);
            } else {
                String fnName = "random$" + (nextId++);
                StatementListNode bodyClone = new StatementListNode(new ArrayList<>(arm.statements));
                VoidFunctionNode helper = new VoidFunctionNode(fnName, "", new ParameterListNode(List.of()), bodyClone, random.token);
                generated.add(helper);

                VoidFunctionCallNode call = new VoidFunctionCallNode(fnName, new ArgumentListNode(List.of()), random.token);
                newOptions.add(new StatementListNode(List.of(call)));
            }
        }
        return new RandomNode(newOptions, random.token);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\RepeatUnrollingVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.RepeatNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;


public class RepeatUnrollingVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRepeat(RepeatNode repeat) {
        StatementListNode rewrittenBody = (StatementListNode) repeat.statements.accept(this);

        long count = repeat.count;
        if (count < 0) {
            throw new SemanticException(
                    repeat.token,
                    "Repeat count cannot be negative: " + count
            );
        }

        List<StatementNode> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            for (StatementNode stmt : rewrittenBody.statements) {
                out.add(stmt);
            }
        }

        return new StatementListNode(out);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.helpers.HolderAndName;

import java.util.Map;

public class ReplaceVariableNamesVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final Map<HolderAndName, HolderAndName> nameMap;

    public ReplaceVariableNamesVisitor(Map<HolderAndName, HolderAndName> nameMap) {
        this.nameMap = nameMap;
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVariable(VariableNode var) {
        HolderAndName key = new HolderAndName(var.holder, var.name);
        if (nameMap.containsKey(key)) {
            HolderAndName newRef = nameMap.get(key);
            return new VariableNode(var.type, newRef.holder, newRef.name, var.teamName, var.token);
        }
        return var;
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\ReturnCheckVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.ConditionalNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.RandomNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.ReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class ReturnCheckVisitor extends EmptyVisitor<Void> {

    public Void analyze(MainNode main) {
        main.accept(this);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode function) {
        if (!allPathsReturn(function.statements)) {
            throw new SemanticException(function.token, "Function '" + function.name + "' may fall through without returning a value. Make sure the function will always return a value.");
        }
        return null;
    }

    private boolean allPathsReturn(StatementListNode block) {
        // Iterate in order; once a statement is “guaranteed return,” no need to look further:
        for (StatementNode stmt : block.statements) {
            if (stmt instanceof StatementListNode list) {
                if (allPathsReturn(list))
                    return true;
            }
            if (stmt instanceof ReturnNode) {
                return true;
            }
            if (stmt instanceof ConditionalNode cond) {
                // Both branches must exist and both must guarantee return:
                StatementListNode thenBlock = cond.thenBlock;
                StatementListNode elseBlock = cond.elseBlock;
                if (elseBlock == null) {
                    // No else => some path falls through
                    continue;
                }
                boolean thenReturns = allPathsReturn(thenBlock);
                boolean elseReturns = allPathsReturn(elseBlock);
                if (thenReturns && elseReturns) {
                    // This if‐statement guarantees return regardless of condition
                    return true;
                } else {
                    // One branch or both might fall through; keep scanning next statements
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (stmt instanceof RandomNode rnd) {
                // Every alternative block in “random” must guarantee a return:
                boolean everyOptionReturns = true;
                for (StatementListNode option : rnd.statements) {
                    if (!allPathsReturn(option)) {
                        everyOptionReturns = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (everyOptionReturns) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\ReturnContextChecker.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.TypedReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class ReturnContextChecker extends EmptyVisitor<Void> {
    private boolean inTypedFunction = false;
    private VariableType functionType = null;

    public Void analyze(ASTNode root) {
        root.accept(this);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode fn) {
        inTypedFunction = false;
        fn.parameters.accept(this);
        fn.statements.accept(this);
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode fn) {
        inTypedFunction = true;
        functionType = fn.returnType;
        fn.parameters.accept(this);
        fn.statements.accept(this);
        inTypedFunction = false;
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitTypedReturn(TypedReturnNode ret) {
        if (!inTypedFunction) {
            throw new SemanticException(ret.token, "Cannot return a value here, not in a typed function");
        }
        ret.expression.accept(this);
        if (functionType != ret.expression.type && functionType != VariableType.VAR)
            throw new SemanticException(ret.token, "Return type mismatch. Expected to return " + functionType + " but returning " + ret.expression.type);

        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public Void visitVoidReturn(VoidReturnNode ret) {
        if (inTypedFunction) {
            throw new SemanticException(ret.token, "Must return a value in a typed function");
        }

        return null;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\ReturnPlacementVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.EventNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.LoopNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.VoidReturnNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ReturnPlacementVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode fn) {
        return super.visitVoidFunction(new VoidFunctionNode(fn.name, fn.description, fn.parameters, stripReturn(fn.statements), fn.token));
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitEvent(EventNode event) {
        return super.visitEvent(new EventNode(event.event, stripReturn(event.statements), event.token));
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitLoop(LoopNode loop) {
        return super.visitLoop(new LoopNode(loop.name, loop.description, stripReturn(loop.statements), loop.tickDelay, loop.token));
    }

    private StatementListNode stripReturn(StatementListNode stmts) {
        List<StatementNode> list = stmts.statements;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            if (list.get(i) instanceof VoidReturnNode ret) {
                if (i < list.size() - 1) {
                    throw new SemanticException(ret.token,
                            "return can only appear inside a conditional/random block or as the very last statement");
                }
                return new StatementListNode(new ArrayList<>(list.subList(0, list.size() - 1)));
            }
        }
        return stmts;
    }
}

```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\ScopeCheckingVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.ExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.ParameterListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.StatementListNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.*;

public class ScopeCheckingVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final Map<String, VariableType> globalDecls;
    private final Set<String> allLocalNames;
    private final Deque<Map<String, VariableType>> scopeStack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private boolean inFunction = false;

    public ScopeCheckingVisitor(Map<String, VariableType> globals, Set<String> locals) {
        this.globalDecls = globals;
        this.allLocalNames = locals;
    }

    public MainNode analyze(MainNode main) {
        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>(globalDecls));
        ASTNode result = main.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();
        return (MainNode) result;
    }

    private VariableType resolveOrDeclareGlobal(String fullname, Token token, VariableNode varNode) {
        for (Map<String, VariableType> scope : scopeStack) {
            if (scope.containsKey(fullname)) {
                VariableType vt = scope.get(fullname);
                if (varNode != null) varNode.type = vt;
                return vt;
            }
        }
        if (allLocalNames.contains(fullname)) {
            throw new SemanticException(token, "Ambiguous reference to '" + fullname + "' (declared locally elsewhere, but not in this scope)");
        }
        if (globalDecls.containsKey(fullname)) {
            VariableType vt = globalDecls.get(fullname);
            scopeStack.getLast().put(fullname, vt);
            if (varNode != null) varNode.type = vt;
            return vt;
        }
        VariableType vt = VariableType.VAR;
        globalDecls.put(fullname, vt);
        scopeStack.getLast().put(fullname, vt);
        if (varNode != null) varNode.type = vt;
        return vt;
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitGlobalDeclaration(GlobalDeclarationNode node) {
        String fullname = node.variable.holder + "." + node.variable.name;
        scopeStack.peek().put(fullname, node.variable.type);

        VariableNode varCopy = new VariableNode(node.variable.type, node.variable.holder, node.variable.name, null, node.variable.token);
        return new GlobalDeclarationNode(varCopy, node.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode fn) {
        Map<String, VariableType> localScope = new HashMap<>();
        for (VariableNode param : fn.parameters.parameters) {
            String fullname = param.holder + "." + param.name;
            localScope.put(fullname, param.type);
        }
        scopeStack.push(localScope);
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) fn.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();

        List<VariableNode> newParams = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VariableNode param : fn.parameters.parameters) {
            newParams.add(new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, param.name, param.teamName, param.token));
        }
        ParameterListNode newParamList = new ParameterListNode(newParams);
        return new TypedFunctionNode(fn.name, fn.description, fn.returnType, newParamList, newBody, fn.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode fn) {
        Map<String, VariableType> localScope = new HashMap<>();
        for (VariableNode param : fn.parameters.parameters) {
            String fullname = param.holder + "." + param.name;
            localScope.put(fullname, param.type);
        }

        scopeStack.push(localScope);
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) fn.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();

        List<VariableNode> newParams = new ArrayList<>();
        for (VariableNode param : fn.parameters.parameters) {
            newParams.add(new VariableNode(param.type, param.holder, param.name, param.teamName, param.token));
        }
        ParameterListNode newParamList = new ParameterListNode(newParams);

        return new VoidFunctionNode(fn.name, fn.description, newParamList, newBody, fn.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitDeclaration(DeclarationNode decl) {
        String fullname = decl.variable.holder + "." + decl.variable.name;
        Map<String, VariableType> current = scopeStack.peek();
        if (current.containsKey(fullname)) {
            throw new SemanticException(decl.token, "Duplicate declaration of '" + fullname + "' in this same scope");
        }
        current.put(fullname, decl.variable.type);

        VariableNode varCopy = new VariableNode(decl.variable.type, decl.variable.holder, decl.variable.name, decl.variable.teamName, decl.variable.token);
        return new DeclarationNode(varCopy, decl.token);
    }

    @Override public ASTNode visitAssignation(AssignationNode assign) {
        String fullname = assign.variable.holder + "." + assign.variable.name;
        VariableType vt = resolveOrDeclareGlobal(fullname, assign.token, assign.variable);
        NormalExpressionNode newRhs = (NormalExpressionNode) assign.value.accept(this);
        VariableNode newVar = new VariableNode(vt, assign.variable.holder, assign.variable.name, assign.variable.teamName, assign.variable.token);
        return new AssignationNode(newVar, assign.operator, newRhs, assign.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVariable(VariableNode var) {
        String fullname = var.holder + "." + var.name;
        resolveOrDeclareGlobal(fullname, var.token, var);
        return new VariableNode(var.type, var.holder, var.name, var.teamName, var.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitConditional(ConditionalNode cond) {
        ExpressionNode newCond = (ExpressionNode) cond.condition.accept(this);

        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
        StatementListNode newThen = (StatementListNode) cond.thenBlock.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();

        StatementListNode newElse = null;
        if (cond.elseBlock != null) {
            scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
            newElse = (StatementListNode) cond.elseBlock.accept(this);
            scopeStack.pop();
        }

        return new ConditionalNode(newCond, newThen, newElse, cond.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitLoop(LoopNode loop) {
        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) loop.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();

        return new LoopNode(loop.name, loop.description, newBody, loop.tickDelay, loop.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitEvent(EventNode event) {
        boolean saved = inFunction;
        inFunction = true;

        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());

        event.statements.accept(this);

        scopeStack.pop();
        inFunction = saved;
        return new EventNode(event.event, event.statements, event.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitCommand(CommandNode cmd) {
        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) cmd.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();
        return new CommandNode(cmd.name, cmd.targeted, cmd.priority, cmd.listed, newBody, cmd.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitMenu(MenuNode menu) {
        List<SlotNode> newSlots = new ArrayList<>();
        for (SlotNode slot : menu.slots) {
            newSlots.add((SlotNode) slot.accept(this));
        }
        return new MenuNode(menu.name, menu.rows, newSlots, menu.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitSlot(SlotNode slot) {
        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) slot.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();
        return new SlotNode(slot.slotId, slot.item, newBody, slot.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRepeat(RepeatNode repeat) {
        scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode) repeat.statements.accept(this);
        scopeStack.pop();
        return new RepeatNode(repeat.count, newBody, repeat.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRandom(RandomNode random) {
        List<StatementListNode> newOptions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementListNode opt : random.statements) {
            scopeStack.push(new HashMap<>());
            StatementListNode rewritten = (StatementListNode) opt.accept(this);
            scopeStack.pop();
            newOptions.add(rewritten);
        }
        return new RandomNode(newOptions, random.token);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\SimplifyingExpressionsVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.call.FunctionCallNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.PlaceholderNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var.VariableNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.EventNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.LoopNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.TypedFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main_statements.VoidFunctionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.statement.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class SimplifyingExpressionsVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    private final String VAR_PREFIX = "t$";
    private int tempCounter = 0;

    private record LowerResult(ExpressionNode simple, List<StatementNode> stmts) {}

    private LowerResult lowerExpr(ExpressionNode expr) {
        if (expr instanceof ConstantPrimitiveNode || expr instanceof PlaceholderNode || expr instanceof VariableNode) {
            return new LowerResult(expr, List.of());
        }

        if (expr instanceof BinaryExpressionNode bin) {
            LowerResult leftRes  = lowerExpr(bin.left);
            LowerResult rightRes = lowerExpr(bin.right);

            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
            stmts.addAll(leftRes.stmts());
            stmts.addAll(rightRes.stmts());

            VariableType leftType  = leftRes.simple.type;
            VariableType rightType = rightRes.simple.type;

            VariableType varType;
            if (leftType == VariableType.VAR || rightType == VariableType.VAR) {
                varType = VariableType.VAR;
            } else if (leftType == rightType) {
                varType = leftType;
            } else {
                throw new SemanticException(bin.token, "Type mismatch in binary expression: left is " + leftType + ", right is " + rightType);
            }

            VariableNode accVar;
            boolean reuseLeft = leftRes.simple instanceof VariableNode && ((VariableNode) leftRes.simple).name.startsWith(VAR_PREFIX);

            if (reuseLeft) {
                accVar = (VariableNode) leftRes.simple;
            } else {
                accVar = makeTemp(leftRes.simple.token, varType);
                stmts.add(new AssignationNode(accVar, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, (NormalExpressionNode) leftRes.simple, bin.token));
            }

            AssignmentOperator opAssign = switch (bin.operator) {
                case ADD      -> AssignmentOperator.ADD_ASSIGN;
                case SUBTRACT -> AssignmentOperator.SUB_ASSIGN;
                case MULTIPLY -> AssignmentOperator.MUL_ASSIGN;
                case DIVIDE   -> AssignmentOperator.DIV_ASSIGN;
                default -> throw new SemanticException(bin.token, "Unsupported binary operator: " + bin.operator);
            };

            stmts.add(new AssignationNode(accVar, opAssign, (NormalExpressionNode) rightRes.simple, bin.token));

            return new LowerResult(accVar, stmts);
        }

        if (expr instanceof UnaryExpressionNode un) {
            LowerResult opRes = lowerExpr(un.operand);

            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>(opRes.stmts());

            switch (un.operator) {
                case LONG_CAST, DOUBLE_CAST -> {
                    VariableType fromType = un.operand.type;
                    VariableType toType = un.operator == UnaryOperator.LONG_CAST
                            ? VariableType.LONG : VariableType.DOUBLE;

                    if (fromType == VariableType.STRING) {
                        throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Cannot cast STRING to " + toType);
                    }

                    boolean reuse = opRes.simple() instanceof VariableNode && ((VariableNode) opRes.simple()).name.startsWith(VAR_PREFIX);
                    VariableNode result;
                    if (reuse) {
                        result = (VariableNode) opRes.simple();
                    } else {
                        result = makeTemp(un.token, toType);
                        stmts.add(new AssignationNode(result, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, (NormalExpressionNode) opRes.simple(), un.token));
                    }
                    result.type = toType;
                    return new LowerResult(result, stmts);
                }
                case STRING_CAST -> {
                    VariableType fromType = un.operand.type;
                    if (fromType == VariableType.STRING) return opRes;
                    // Constant literal → convert at compile time, no temp variable needed
                    if (opRes.simple() instanceof ConstantPrimitiveNode constNode) {
                        String strVal = switch (constNode.value) {
                            case LongValue l   -> l.toString();
                            case DoubleValue d -> d.toString();
                            case BoolValue b   -> b.toString();
                            default -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Cannot cast to string");
                        };
                        return new LowerResult(new ConstantPrimitiveNode(
                                new StringValue(strVal), VariableType.STRING, un.token), opRes.stmts());
                    }
                    // Variable → embed as in-game placeholder reference (avoids broken string +=)
                    if (opRes.simple() instanceof VariableNode v) {
                        String ref = switch (v.holder) {
                            case PLAYER -> "%var.player/" + v.name + "%";
                            case GLOBAL -> "%var.global/" + v.name + "%";
                            case TEAM   -> "%var.team/" + v.name + " " + v.teamName + "%";
                        };
                        return new LowerResult(new ConstantPrimitiveNode(
                                new StringValue(ref), VariableType.STRING, un.token), opRes.stmts());
                    }
                    // Placeholder → embed as in-game placeholder reference
                    if (opRes.simple() instanceof PlaceholderNode p) {
                        com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Placeholder ph =
                                com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Placeholder.requireByName(p.placeholder);
                        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("%").append(ph.inGameName);
                        List<ConstantPrimitiveNode> consts = p.constants.constants;
                        if (!consts.isEmpty()) {
                            sb.append("/");
                            for (int i = 0; i < consts.size(); i++) {
                                if (i > 0) sb.append(" ");
                                ConstantPrimitive prim = consts.get(i).value;
                                sb.append(switch (prim) {
                                    case StringValue sv -> sv.value;
                                    case LongValue lv   -> lv.toString();
                                    case DoubleValue dv -> dv.toString();
                                    case BoolValue bv   -> bv.toString();
                                });
                            }
                        }
                        sb.append("%");
                        return new LowerResult(new ConstantPrimitiveNode(
                                new StringValue(sb.toString()), VariableType.STRING, un.token), opRes.stmts());
                    }
                    // Fallback for complex expressions: assign "" then += value
                    VariableNode result = makeTemp(un.token, VariableType.STRING);
                    ConstantPrimitiveNode emptyStr = new ConstantPrimitiveNode(
                            new StringValue(""), VariableType.STRING, un.token);
                    stmts.add(new AssignationNode(result, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, emptyStr, un.token));
                    stmts.add(new AssignationNode(result, AssignmentOperator.ADD_ASSIGN,
                            (NormalExpressionNode) opRes.simple(), un.token));
                    return new LowerResult(result, stmts);
                }
            }

            VariableNode accVar;
            boolean reuse = opRes.simple() instanceof VariableNode && ((VariableNode) opRes.simple()).name.startsWith(VAR_PREFIX);
            if (reuse) {
                accVar = (VariableNode) opRes.simple();
            } else {
                accVar = makeTemp(opRes.simple().token, un.operand.type);
                stmts.add(new AssignationNode(accVar, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, (NormalExpressionNode) opRes.simple(), un.token));
            }

            VariableType varType = un.operand.type;
            ConstantPrimitiveNode constantNode;
            switch (varType) {
                case LONG -> {
                    long value = switch (un.operator) {
                        case NEGATE -> -1L;
                        case INC, DEC -> 1L;
                        default -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Unhandled unary op: " + un.operator);
                    };
                    constantNode = new ConstantPrimitiveNode(new LongValue(value), VariableType.LONG, un.token);
                }
                case DOUBLE -> {
                    double value = switch (un.operator) {
                        case NEGATE -> -1.0D;
                        case INC, DEC -> 1.0D;
                        default -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Unhandled unary op: " + un.operator);
                    };
                    constantNode = new ConstantPrimitiveNode(new DoubleValue(value), VariableType.DOUBLE, un.token);
                }
                case BOOL, STRING -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Cannot apply '" + un.operator + "' to type " + varType);
                default -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Unknown VariableType: " + varType);
            }

            AssignmentOperator op = switch (un.operator) {
                case NEGATE -> AssignmentOperator.MUL_ASSIGN;
                case INC -> AssignmentOperator.ADD_ASSIGN;
                case DEC -> AssignmentOperator.SUB_ASSIGN;
                default -> throw new SemanticException(un.token, "Unhandled unary op: " + un.operator
                );
            };

            stmts.add(new AssignationNode(accVar, op, constantNode, un.token));

            return new LowerResult(accVar, stmts);
        }

        if (expr instanceof BooleanExpressionNode be) {
            LowerResult leftRes  = lowerExpr(be.left);
            LowerResult rightRes = lowerExpr(be.right);

            VariableType leftType = leftRes.simple.type;
            VariableType rightType = rightRes.simple.type;

            VariableType varType;
            if (leftType == VariableType.VAR || rightType == VariableType.VAR) {
                varType = VariableType.VAR;
            } else if (leftType == rightType) {
                varType = leftType;
            } else {
                throw new SemanticException(be.token, "Type mismatch in boolean expression: left is " + leftType + ", right is " + rightType);
            }

            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
            stmts.addAll(leftRes.stmts());
            stmts.addAll(rightRes.stmts());

            VariableNode leftVar;
            if (leftRes.simple instanceof VariableNode lv && lv.name.startsWith(VAR_PREFIX)) {
                leftVar = lv;
            } else if (leftRes.simple instanceof VariableNode v2) {
                leftVar = v2;
            } else {
                leftVar = makeTemp(leftRes.simple.token, varType);
                stmts.add(new AssignationNode(leftVar, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, (NormalExpressionNode) leftRes.simple, be.token));
            }

            NormalExpressionNode rightSimple = (NormalExpressionNode)rightRes.simple;

            BooleanExpressionNode newBool = new BooleanExpressionNode(leftVar, rightSimple, be.operator, be.token);
            return new LowerResult(newBool, stmts);
        }

        if (expr instanceof LogicalExpressionNode le) {
            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();

            List<ExpressionNode> newConds = new ArrayList<>();
            for (ExpressionNode condExpr : le.conditions) {
                LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(condExpr);
                stmts.addAll(lr.stmts());

                ExpressionNode simple = lr.simple();

                if (simple instanceof BooleanExpressionNode) {
                    newConds.add(simple);

                } else if (simple instanceof VariableNode || simple instanceof ConstantPrimitiveNode || simple instanceof PlaceholderNode) {
                    ConstantPrimitiveNode zero = switch (simple.type) {
                        case LONG   -> new ConstantPrimitiveNode(new LongValue(0L), VariableType.LONG, simple.token);
                        case DOUBLE -> new ConstantPrimitiveNode(new DoubleValue(0.0), VariableType.DOUBLE, simple.token);
                        default -> throw new SemanticException(simple.token, "Cannot use a variable of type " + simple.type + " directly in a logical condition");
                    };
                    newConds.add(new BooleanExpressionNode((NormalExpressionNode)simple, zero, BooleanOperator.GREATER_THAN, simple.token));
                }
                else {
                    throw new SemanticException(le.token, "Cannot lower logical condition of type " + simple.getClass().getSimpleName());
                }
            }

            LogicalExpressionNode newLog = new LogicalExpressionNode(newConds, le.operator, le.token);
            return new LowerResult(newLog, stmts);
        }

        if (expr instanceof FunctionCallNode call) {
            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
            List<NormalExpressionNode> newArgs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (NormalExpressionNode arg : call.arguments.expressions) {
                LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(arg);
                stmts.addAll(lr.stmts());
                newArgs.add((NormalExpressionNode)lr.simple);
            }
            ArgumentListNode loweredArgs = new ArgumentListNode(newArgs);
            FunctionCallNode newCall = new FunctionCallNode(call.functionName, loweredArgs, call.type, call.token);
            return new LowerResult(newCall, stmts);
        }

        return new LowerResult(expr, List.of());
    }

    private VariableNode makeTemp(Token basedOn, VariableType type) {
        String name = VAR_PREFIX + (tempCounter++);
        return new VariableNode(type, Holder.PLAYER, name, null, basedOn);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitMain(MainNode main) {
        List<MainStatementNode> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (MainStatementNode stmt : main.statements) {
            ASTNode lowered = stmt.accept(this);
            if (lowered instanceof MainNode slab) {
                result.addAll(slab.statements);
            } else if (lowered instanceof MainStatementNode single) {
                result.add(single);
            } else {
                throw new SemanticException(main.token, "Expected start of code");
            }
        }
        return new MainNode(result);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitStatements(StatementListNode statements) {
        List<StatementNode> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementNode stmt : statements.statements) {
            ASTNode lowered = stmt.accept(this);
            if (lowered instanceof StatementListNode slab) {
                result.addAll(slab.statements);
            } else if (lowered instanceof StatementNode single) {
                result.add(single);
            } else {
                throw new SemanticException(statements.token, "Expected statement(s)");
            }
        }
        return new StatementListNode(result);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitAssignation(AssignationNode assignation) {
        LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(assignation.value);

        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>(lr.stmts());

        VariableNode lhsVar = assignation.variable;
        VariableType lhsType = lhsVar.type;
        VariableType rhsType = lr.simple.type;

        if (lhsType != VariableType.VAR && rhsType != VariableType.VAR && lhsType != rhsType) {
            throw new SemanticException(assignation.token, "Cannot assign a " + rhsType + " into a " + lhsType + " variable '" + lhsVar.name + "'");
        }

        stmts.add(new AssignationNode(lhsVar, AssignmentOperator.ASSIGN, (NormalExpressionNode) lr.simple, assignation.token));

        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunctionCall(VoidFunctionCallNode callStmt) {
        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        List<NormalExpressionNode> newArgs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (NormalExpressionNode arg : callStmt.arguments.expressions) {
            LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(arg);
            stmts.addAll(lr.stmts());
            newArgs.add((NormalExpressionNode)lr.simple);
        }
        ArgumentListNode newArgList = new ArgumentListNode(newArgs);
        VoidFunctionCallNode newCall = new VoidFunctionCallNode(callStmt.functionName, newArgList, callStmt.token);
        stmts.add(newCall);
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitGlobalFunctionCall(GlobalFunctionCallNode callStmt) {
        List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>();
        List<NormalExpressionNode> newArgs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (NormalExpressionNode arg : callStmt.arguments.expressions) {
            LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(arg);
            stmts.addAll(lr.stmts());
            newArgs.add((NormalExpressionNode)lr.simple);
        }
        ArgumentListNode newArgList = new ArgumentListNode(newArgs);
        GlobalFunctionCallNode newCall = new GlobalFunctionCallNode(callStmt.functionName, newArgList, callStmt.token);
        stmts.add(newCall);
        return new StatementListNode(stmts);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedReturn(TypedReturnNode returnNode) {
        if (returnNode.expression != null) {
            LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(returnNode.expression);
            List<StatementNode> stmts = new ArrayList<>(lr.stmts());
            TypedReturnNode newRet = new TypedReturnNode((NormalExpressionNode)lr.simple, returnNode.token);
            stmts.add(newRet);
            return new StatementListNode(stmts);
        } else {
            return returnNode;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitConditional(ConditionalNode conditional) {
        LowerResult lr = lowerExpr(conditional.condition);
        List<StatementNode> beforeIf = new ArrayList<>(lr.stmts());

        ExpressionNode simpleCond = lr.simple;
        StatementListNode newThen = (StatementListNode) visitStatements(conditional.thenBlock);
        StatementListNode newElse = (conditional.elseBlock == null) ? null : (StatementListNode) visitStatements(conditional.elseBlock);

        ConditionalNode newIf = new ConditionalNode(simpleCond, newThen, newElse, conditional.token);
        beforeIf.add(newIf);
        return new StatementListNode(beforeIf);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRepeat(RepeatNode repeat) {
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode)visitStatements(repeat.statements);
        return new RepeatNode(repeat.count, newBody, repeat.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitLoop(LoopNode loop) {
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode)visitStatements(loop.statements);
        return new LoopNode(loop.name, loop.description, newBody, loop.tickDelay, loop.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitRandom(RandomNode random) {
        List<StatementListNode> newOptions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StatementListNode opt : random.statements) {
            newOptions.add((StatementListNode)visitStatements(opt));
        }
        return new RandomNode(newOptions, random.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitTypedFunction(TypedFunctionNode function) {
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode)visitStatements(function.statements);
        return new TypedFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, function.returnType, function.parameters, newBody, function.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitVoidFunction(VoidFunctionNode function) {
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode)visitStatements(function.statements);
        return new VoidFunctionNode(function.name, function.description, function.parameters, newBody, function.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitEvent(EventNode event) {
        StatementListNode newBody = (StatementListNode)visitStatements(event.statements);
        return new EventNode(event.event, newBody, event.token);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\visitors\TypeInferringVisitor.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.ASTNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.BinaryExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.BooleanExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.UnaryExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main.MainNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class TypeInferringVisitor extends DefaultVisitor {
    public MainNode analyze(MainNode main) {
        return (MainNode)main.accept(this);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitBooleanExpr(BooleanExpressionNode node) {
        return new BooleanExpressionNode(
                (NormalExpressionNode) node.left.accept(this),
                (NormalExpressionNode) node.right.accept(this),
                node.operator,
                node.token
        );
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitUnaryExpr(UnaryExpressionNode node) {
        NormalExpressionNode expr = (NormalExpressionNode) node.operand.accept(this);
        return new UnaryExpressionNode(node.operator, expr, expr.type, node.token);
    }

    @Override
    public ASTNode visitBinaryExpr(BinaryExpressionNode node) {
        NormalExpressionNode left = (NormalExpressionNode) node.left.accept(this);
        NormalExpressionNode right = (NormalExpressionNode) node.right.accept(this);

        VariableType resultType;
        if (left.type == VariableType.VAR || right.type == VariableType.VAR) {
            resultType = VariableType.VAR;
        } else if (left.type == right.type) {
            resultType = left.type;
        } else {
            throw new SemanticException(node.token, "Type mismatch in binary expression: left is " + left.type + ", right is " + right.type);
        }

        return new BinaryExpressionNode(left, right, node.operator, resultType, node.token);
    }


}
```

```java
            "Drops an item at a location.", "dropper", "Drop Item"),
    CHANGE_VELOCITY(5, true, "changeVelocity",

            "Sets the player's velocity vector (x, y, z).", "slime_block", "Change Velocity"),

            List.of(Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(LaunchTargetInputs.TARGET_LOCATION), Param.EXPR.withName(LaunchTargetInputs.STRENGTH)),
            "Launches the player toward a target location at a given speed.", "slime_ball", "Launch to Target"),
    SET_WEATHER(5, true, "setWeather",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Weather.class).withName(SetWeatherInputs.WEATHER)),
            "Sets the housing weather.", "water_bucket", "Set Player Weather"),
    SET_TIME(5, true, "setTime",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Time.class).withName(SetTimeInputs.TIME)),
            "Sets the world time.", "clock", "Set Player Time"),
    NAME_TAG_DISPLAY(5, true, "setNameTagDisplay",
            List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(NameTagInputs.DISPLAY)),
            "Shows or hides the player's name tag above their head.", "name_tag", "Toggle Nametag Display");

    public final int maxCount;
    public final boolean canBeUsed;
    public final String name;
    public final List<Param> params;
    public final String description;
    public final String texture;
    public final String displayName;

    AddAction(int maxCount, boolean canBeUsed, String name, List<Param> params,
              String description, String textureId, String displayName) {
        this.maxCount = maxCount;
        this.canBeUsed = canBeUsed;
        this.name = name;
        this.params = params;
        this.description = description;
        this.texture = textureId;
        this.displayName = displayName;
    }

    public static final Map<String, AddAction> BY_NAME = Arrays.stream(values())
            .filter(a -> a.canBeUsed)
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(a -> a.name, Function.identity()));

    public static AddAction searchByName(String name) { return BY_NAME.get(name); }

    public static AddAction requireByName(String name) {
        AddAction a = BY_NAME.get(name);
        if (a == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown AddAction name: " + name);
        return a;
    }
}
```
