```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CommandInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CustomMenuInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.FunctionInputs;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractSignEditScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AnvilScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class ActionBuilder {
    private final List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>();

    public ActionBuilder clickSlotAndWait(int s, boolean leftCLick) {
        actions.add(new SlotAction(s, leftCLick));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder customItem(String itemId) {
        assert Minecraft.getInstance().player != null;
        actions.add(new CreativeGiveAction(itemId));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SlotAction(1, true, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new CreativeGiveAction(null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder sendChatAndWait(String s) {
        actions.add(new ChatAction(s));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder chatInput(String string, int slot) {
        String capped = string.length() > StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT ? string.substring(0, StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT) : string;

        actions.add(new SlotAction(slot, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, false));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new ChatAction(capped));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder anvilInput(String string, int slot) {
        String capped = string.length() > StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT ? string.substring(0, StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT) : string;

        actions.add(new SlotAction(slot, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(AnvilScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new AnvilAction(capped));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder search(String text) {
        return search(text, null, true, null, null);
    }

    public ActionBuilder search(String text, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, ActionBuilder onFound, ActionBuilder onNotFound) {
        actions.add(new SearchAction(text, itemType, leftClick, onFound != null ? onFound.get() : null, onNotFound != null ? onNotFound.get() : null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder searchForAnvil(String text, String anvilText) {
        String capped = anvilText.length() > StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT ? anvilText.substring(0, StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT) : anvilText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, text, null, true,
                                     AnvilScreen.class,
                                     new ActionBuilder()
                    .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                    .append(new AnvilAction(capped))
                    .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                    .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                    .get(),
                                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder searchForChat(String text, String chatText) {
        String capped = chatText.length() > StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT ? chatText.substring(0, StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT) : chatText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, text, null, true,
                     ContainerScreen.class, false,
                     new ActionBuilder()
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .append(new ChatAction(capped))
                             .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .get(),
                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder signInput(String searchText, String signText) {
        String capped = signText.length() > StringLimits.SIGN_TEXT ? signText.substring(0, StringLimits.SIGN_TEXT) : signText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, searchText, null, true,
                                     AbstractSignEditScreen.class,
                                     new ActionBuilder()
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .append(new SignAction(capped))
                             .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .get(),
                                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoFunction(boolean hasUIOpened, String name, boolean leftClick) {
        if (hasUIOpened) {
            actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
            actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        }
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.FUNCTIONS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoCommand(boolean hasUIOpened, String name, boolean leftClick) {
        if (hasUIOpened) {
            actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
            actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        }
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.COMMANDS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction("/" + name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder onlyIf(boolean condition, Supplier<ActionBuilder> ifInside) {
        if (condition) {
            ActionBuilder branch = ifInside.get();
            this.actions.addAll(branch.actions);
        }
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder onlyIfElse(boolean condition, Supplier<ActionBuilder> ifInside, Supplier<ActionBuilder> elseInside) {
        ActionBuilder branch;

        if (condition) branch = ifInside.get();
        else branch = elseInside.get();

        this.actions.addAll(branch.actions);

        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder addAction(AddAction action, RestrictionAction restriction) {
        return this.clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6, true)
                   .search(action.displayName);
    }

    public ActionBuilder addCondition(AddCondition action, RestrictionCondition restriction) {
        return this.clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6, true)
                   .search(action.displayName);
    }

    public ActionBuilder closeAll() {
        actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder append(Action action) {
        this.actions.add(action);
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeFunctionIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search(name, null, false,
             new ActionBuilder()
                     .search(FunctionInputs.DELETE)
                     .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

             new ActionBuilder().empty() // Do nothing
        );
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeCommandIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search("/" + name, null, false,
                           new ActionBuilder()
                                   .search(CommandInputs.DELETE)
                                   .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

                           new ActionBuilder().empty() // Do nothing
                          );
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeMenuIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search(name, null, false,
                           new ActionBuilder()
                                   .search(CustomMenuInputs.DELETE)
                                   .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

                           new ActionBuilder().empty()
                          );
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoCustomMenu(String name, boolean leftClick) {
        actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder empty() {
        this.actions.add(new EmptyAction());
        return this;
    }

    public GroupAction get() {
        return new GroupAction(actions);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\HousingCheck.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ServerData;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.world.scores.Scoreboard;

public class HousingCheck {

    public static boolean isOnHypixel() {
        ServerData srv = Minecraft.getInstance().getCurrentServer();
        if (srv == null) return false;
        String ip = srv.ip.toLowerCase();
        return ip.contains("hypixel.net") || ip.contains("hypixel.io");
    }

    public static boolean isInHousing() {
        if (!isOnHypixel()) return false;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.level == null) return false;

        return hasHousingScoreboard(mc) && hasHousingFooter(mc);
    }

    private static boolean hasHousingScoreboard(Minecraft mc) {
        Scoreboard sb = mc.level.getScoreboard();

        return sb.getObjectives().stream().anyMatch(obj -> {
            String name = obj.getName().toLowerCase();
            String display = obj.getDisplayName().getString().toLowerCase();
            return name.contains("housing") || display.contains("housing");
        });
    }

    private static boolean hasHousingFooter(Minecraft mc) {
        try {
            var tabList = mc.gui.getTabList();
            for (var f : tabList.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
                if (!Component.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType())) continue;
                f.setAccessible(true);
                Component c = (Component) f.get(tabList);
                if (c != null && c.getString().toLowerCase().contains("you are in")) return true;
            }
            return false;
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\MessageUtils.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.MutableComponent;

public class MessageUtils {

    public static void rawLogToChat(String message) {
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player != null) {
            Minecraft.getInstance().player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal(message), false);
        }
    }

    private static void sendPrefixedMultiline(Object message, String prefixText,
                                              ChatFormatting prefixColor,
                                              ChatFormatting bodyColor) {
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return;
        String text = String.valueOf(message).replace("\t", "    ");
        String[] lines = text.split("\n");
        MutableComponent full = Component.empty();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            Component prefix = Component.literal(prefixText).withStyle(prefixColor);
            Component body = Component.literal(lines[i]).withStyle(bodyColor);
            full.append(prefix).append(body);
            if (i < lines.length - 1) {
                full.append(Component.literal("\n"));
            }
        }
        Minecraft.getInstance().player.displayClientMessage(full, false);
    }

    public static void debugToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[NEO_HOUSE] ", ChatFormatting.AQUA, ChatFormatting.GRAY);
    }

    public static void errorToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[ERROR] ", ChatFormatting.RED, ChatFormatting.RED);
    }

    public static void warningToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[WARNING] ", ChatFormatting.YELLOW, ChatFormatting.YELLOW);
    }
}
```

# common\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\SequenceManager.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class SequenceManager {
    private static Action currentAction = null;

    public static void startAction(Action action) {
        currentAction = action;
    }

    public static void cancelAction() {
        currentAction = null;
    }

    public static void tick(Minecraft mc) {
        if (currentAction == null) return;

        boolean finished;
        try {
            finished = currentAction.run(mc);
        } catch (InterruptActionException e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
            currentAction = null;
            return;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Script aborted due to unexpected error: " + e);
            currentAction = null;
            return;
        }

        if (finished) {
            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Done!");
            currentAction = null;
        }
    }
}
```

# fabric\build.gradle

```gradle
apply plugin: 'dev.architectury.loom'
apply plugin: 'com.gradleup.shadow'
apply plugin: 'maven-publish'
apply plugin: 'architectury-plugin'

architectury {
    platformSetupLoomIde()
    fabric()
}

base {
    archivesName = "${mod_id}-fabric"
}

version = mod_version
group = mod_group_id
java.toolchain.languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)

configurations {
    common
    shadowCommon
    compileClasspath.extendsFrom common
    runtimeClasspath.extendsFrom common
    developmentFabric.extendsFrom common
}

loom {
    runs {
        client { client() }
        server { server() }
    }
}

dependencies {
    def mcVer    = rootProject.ext.active_mc_version
    def parchMc  = rootProject.ext.active_parch_mc
    def parchVer = rootProject.ext.active_parch_ver

    minecraft "com.mojang:minecraft:${mcVer}"
    if (parchVer && parchMc) {
        mappings loom.layered() {
            officialMojangMappings()
            parchment("org.parchmentmc.data:parchment-${parchMc}:${parchVer}@zip")
        }
    } else {
        mappings loom.layered() { officialMojangMappings() }
    }

    modImplementation "net.fabricmc:fabric-loader:${fabric_loader_version}"
    modImplementation "net.fabricmc.fabric-api:fabric-api:${rootProject.ext.active_fabric_api}"

    common(project(path: ':common', configuration: 'namedElements')) { transitive false }
    shadowCommon(project(path: ':common', configuration: 'transformProductionFabric')) { transitive false }
}

tasks.withType(JavaCompile).configureEach { options.encoding = 'UTF-8' }

// Fabric doesn't have loader-specific compat classes yet, but we keep the pattern consistent
// (no-op for now; add loader-specific compat dirs here if needed in the future)

processResources {
    def replaceProperties = [version: project.version, mod_id: mod_id, minecraft_version: rootProject.ext.active_mc_version]
    inputs.properties replaceProperties
    filesMatching('fabric.mod.json') {
        expand replaceProperties
    }
}

shadowJar {
    configurations = [project.configurations.shadowCommon]
    archiveClassifier = 'dev-shadow'
}

remapJar {
    input.set shadowJar.archiveFile
    dependsOn shadowJar
    archiveClassifier = null
}

jar {
    archiveClassifier = 'dev'
}

publishing {
    publications {
        register('mavenJava', MavenPublication) {
            artifact remapJar.archiveFile
        }
    }
    repositories {
        maven { url "file://${project.projectDir}/repo" }
    }
}
```

# fabric\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\ScreenEvents.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.WaitForAction;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public class ScreenEvents {

    private static final Set<WaitForAction> waitingActions = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    public static void watch(WaitForAction action) {
        waitingActions.add(action);
    }

    public static void onScreenOpened(Screen screen) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(screen, true)) action.markDone();
        }
    }

    public static void onScreenClosed(Screen screen) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(screen, false)) action.markDone();
        }
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllCommandsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllFunctionsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllMenusAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ScriptRunner;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Event;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Others;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.PermissionException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.HousingCheck;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.SequenceManager;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.StringArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.builder.LiteralArgumentBuilder;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.ClientCommandManager;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.ClientCommandRegistrationCallback;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.command.v2.FabricClientCommandSource;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class ClientCommandHandler {

    private static final ScriptRunner NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER = ScriptRunner.INSTANCE;

    // Defers screen opening to the next tick via TickDriver.
    // mc.execute() runs synchronously on the game thread, so it can't be used here —
    // the chat screen would close AFTER our setScreen, replacing it with null.
    private static int openScreen(java.util.function.Supplier<net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen> screenFactory) {
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(screenFactory.get());
        return 1;
    }

    public static void register() {
        ClientCommandRegistrationCallback.EVENT.register((dispatcher, registryAccess) -> {
            dispatcher.register(buildCommand("neohouse"));
            dispatcher.register(buildCommand("nh"));
        });
    }

    private static LiteralArgumentBuilder<FabricClientCommandSource> buildCommand(String name) {
        return ClientCommandManager.literal(name)
           .executes(ctx -> openScreen(() -> new HomeScreen(ClientCommandHandler::getScriptsDir)))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("files").executes(ctx -> openScreen(() -> new FileBrowserScreen(getScriptsDir()))))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("help").executes(ctx -> openScreen(() -> new HelpScreen(null))))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("config").executes(ctx -> openScreen(() -> new ConfigScreen(null))))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("nuke").executes(ctx -> {
               if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
               try {
                   return handleNuke();
               } catch (Exception e) {
                   MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                   return 0;
               }
           }))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("delete")
                 .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("functions").executes(ctx -> {
                     if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                     try {
                         return handleDeleteFunctions();
                     } catch (Exception e) {
                         MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                         return 0;
                     }
                 }))
                 .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("events").executes(ctx -> {
                     if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                     try {
                         return handleDeleteEvents();
                     } catch (Exception e) {
                         MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                         return 0;
                     }
                 }))
                 .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("commands").executes(ctx -> {
                     if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                     try {
                         return handleDeleteCommands();
                     } catch (Exception e) {
                         MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                         return 0;
                     }
                 }))
                 .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("menus").executes(ctx -> {
                     if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                     try {
                         return handleDeleteMenus();
                     } catch (Exception e) {
                         MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                         return 0;
                     }
                 }))
            )
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("copyitem").executes(ctx -> {
               Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
               if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return 0;

               ItemStack stack = mc.player.getMainHandItem();
               if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                   MessageUtils.errorToChat("You must be holding an item to copy its data.");
                   return 0;
               }

               net.minecraft.resources.RegistryOps<net.minecraft.nbt.Tag> _ops =
                       mc.level.registryAccess().createSerializationContext(net.minecraft.nbt.NbtOps.INSTANCE);
               net.minecraft.nbt.Tag fullNbt = net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack.CODEC.encodeStart(_ops, stack).getOrThrow();
               mc.keyboardHandler.setClipboard(fullNbt.toString());
               MessageUtils.debugToChat("Full item data copied to clipboard!");
               return 1;
           }))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("rerun").executes(ctx -> {
               if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;

               Path last = NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.getLastScript();
               if (last == null) {
                   MessageUtils.errorToChat("No script has been run yet this session.");
                   return 0;
               }

               try {
                   NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(last);
                   MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + last.getFileName());
                   return 1;
               } catch (Exception e) {
                   MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                   return 0;
               }
           }))
           .then(ClientCommandManager.literal("run")
                 .then(ClientCommandManager.argument("path", StringArgumentType.greedyString())
                       .executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat("No player context!");
                               return 0;
                           }

                           Path scriptFile = resolveScriptPath(StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "path"));
                           if (scriptFile == null)
                               return 0;

                           try {
                               NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(scriptFile);
                               MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + scriptFile.getFileName());
                               return 1;
                           } catch (Exception e) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.toString());
                               return 0;
                           }
                       })
                  )
            );
    }

    private static int handleNuke() {
        if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
            throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
        }
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy\nALL functions, events, commands and menus.\n(Use '/neohouse delete <section>' to delete a specific section)",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete")) {
                        throw new PermissionException("Nuke cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    }
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
                        throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
                    }
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();

                    ActionBuilder builder = new ActionBuilder()
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllFunctionsAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.COMMANDS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllCommandsAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllMenusAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.EVENT_ACTION);

                    for (Event event : Event.values()) {
                        builder.clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                               .append(new DeleteAllAction(10))
                               .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true);
                    }

                    SequenceManager.startAction(builder.closeAll().get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Nuking housing.");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteFunctions() {
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL functions.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                                                        .append(new DeleteAllFunctionsAction())
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all functions...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteCommands() {
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL commands.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.COMMANDS)
                                                        .append(new DeleteAllCommandsAction())
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all commands...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteEvents() {
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL event actions.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    ActionBuilder builder = new ActionBuilder()
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.EVENT_ACTION);
                    for (Event event : Event.values()) {
                        builder.clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                               .append(new DeleteAllAction(10))
                               .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true);
                    }
                    SequenceManager.startAction(builder.closeAll().get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all event actions...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteMenus() {
        TickDriver.openScreenNextTick(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL custom menus.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                        .closeAll()
                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                        .append(new DeleteAllMenusAction())
                        .closeAll()
                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all custom menus...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    public static Path getScriptsDir() {
        Path dir = Minecraft.getInstance().gameDirectory.toPath().resolve("neohouse-scripts");
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) {
            try {
                Files.createDirectories(dir);
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
        return dir;
    }

    private static Path resolveScriptPath(String raw) {
        String s = raw.trim();
        if ((s.startsWith("\"") && s.endsWith("\"")) || (s.startsWith("'") && s.endsWith("'"))) {
            s = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        }
        if (!s.contains(".")) s = s + ".nh";
        Path p = Paths.get(s);
        if (!p.isAbsolute()) p = getScriptsDir().resolve(p);
        String name = p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (!name.endsWith(".nh")) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Unsupported extension '" + name + "' — only .nh files are supported.");
            return null;
        }
        if (!Files.exists(p)) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Script not found: " + p);
            return null;
        }
        return p;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.platform;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.ScreenEvents;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.WaitForAction;
import net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader;

public class FabricPlatform implements Platform {

    @Override
    public boolean isModLoaded(String modId) {
        return FabricLoader.getInstance().isModLoaded(modId);
    }

    @Override
    public String getModVersion(String modId) {
        return FabricLoader.getInstance().getModContainer(modId)
                .map(c -> "v" + c.getMetadata().getVersion().getFriendlyString())
                .orElse("v?");
    }

    @Override
    public void watchForScreen(WaitForAction action) {
        ScreenEvents.watch(action);
    }
}
```

# fabric\src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\TickDriver.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.ScreenEvents;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.SequenceManager;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.event.lifecycle.v1.ClientTickEvents;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;

public class TickDriver {

    private static Screen previousScreen = null;
    private static Screen pendingScreen = null;

    public static void openScreenNextTick(Screen screen) {
        pendingScreen = screen;
    }

    public static void register() {
        ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register(TickDriver::onTick);
    }

    private static void onTick(Minecraft client) {
        if (pendingScreen != null) {
            client.setScreen(pendingScreen);
            pendingScreen = null;
        }

        Screen current = client.screen;
        if (current != previousScreen) {
            if (previousScreen != null) ScreenEvents.onScreenClosed(previousScreen);
            if (current != null) ScreenEvents.onScreenOpened(current);
            previousScreen = current;
        }
        SequenceManager.tick(client);
    }
}
```

```
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#

#

#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.

##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s
' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'
```

```gradle
apply plugin: 'dev.architectury.loom'
apply plugin: 'com.gradleup.shadow'
apply plugin: 'maven-publish'
apply plugin: 'idea'
apply plugin: 'architectury-plugin'

architectury {
    platformSetupLoomIde()
    neoForge()
}

base {
    archivesName = mod_id
}

version = mod_version
group = mod_group_id
java.toolchain.languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)

configurations {
    common
    shadowCommon
    compileClasspath.extendsFrom common
    runtimeClasspath.extendsFrom common
    developmentNeoForge.extendsFrom common
}

loom {
    runs {
        client { client() }
        server { server() }
    }
}

dependencies {
    def mcVer    = rootProject.ext.active_mc_version
    def parchMc  = rootProject.ext.active_parch_mc
    def parchVer = rootProject.ext.active_parch_ver

    minecraft "com.mojang:minecraft:${mcVer}"
    if (parchVer && parchMc) {
        mappings loom.layered() {
            officialMojangMappings()
            parchment("org.parchmentmc.data:parchment-${parchMc}:${parchVer}@zip")
        }
    } else {
        mappings loom.layered() { officialMojangMappings() }
    }

    neoForge "net.neoforged:neoforge:${rootProject.ext.active_neo_version}"

    common(project(path: ':common', configuration: 'namedElements')) { transitive false }
    shadowCommon(project(path: ':common', configuration: 'transformProductionNeoForge')) { transitive false }
}

tasks.withType(JavaCompile).configureEach { options.encoding = 'UTF-8' }

def mcVer = rootProject.ext.active_mc_version
sourceSets.main.java.srcDir(
        mcVer in ['1.21.11'] ? 'src/compat/mc12111plus' :
        mcVer in ['1.21.9','1.21.10'] ? 'src/compat/mc1219plus' :
                'src/compat/mc1218minus'
)

processResources {
    def replaceProperties = [
            minecraft_version_range: rootProject.ext.active_mc_range,
            neo_version_range      : rootProject.ext.active_neo_range,
            loader_version_range   : loader_version_range,
            mod_id                 : mod_id,
            mod_name               : mod_name,
            mod_license            : mod_license,
            mod_version            : project.version,
            mod_authors            : mod_authors,
            mod_description        : mod_description
    ]
    inputs.properties replaceProperties
    filesMatching('META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml') {
        expand replaceProperties
    }
}

shadowJar {
    configurations = [project.configurations.shadowCommon]
    archiveClassifier = 'dev-shadow'
}

remapJar {
    input.set shadowJar.archiveFile
    dependsOn shadowJar
    archiveClassifier = null
}

jar {
    archiveClassifier = 'dev'
}

publishing {
    publications {
        register('mavenJava', MavenPublication) {
            artifact remapJar.archiveFile
        }
    }
    repositories {
        maven { url "file://${project.projectDir}/repo" }
    }
}
```

# neoforge\run\config\fml.toml

```toml
#Disables File Watcher. Used to automatically update config if its file has been modified.
disableConfigWatcher = false
#Should we control the window. Disabling this disables new GL features and can be bad for mods that rely on them.
earlyWindowControl = true
#Max threads for early initialization parallelism,  -1 is based on processor count
maxThreads = -1
#Enable NeoForge global version checking
versionCheck = true
#Default config path for servers
defaultConfigPath = "defaultconfigs"
#Disables Optimized DFU client-side - already disabled on servers
disableOptimizedDFU = true
#Early window provider
earlyWindowProvider = "fmlearlywindow"
#Early window width
earlyWindowWidth = 854
#Early window height
earlyWindowHeight = 480
#Early window framebuffer scale
earlyWindowFBScale = 1
#Early window starts maximized
earlyWindowMaximized = false
#Skip specific GL versions, may help with buggy graphics card drivers
earlyWindowSkipGLVersions = []
#Squir?
earlyWindowSquir = false
#Define dependency overrides below
#Dependency overrides can be used to forcibly remove a dependency constraint from a mod or to force a mod to load AFTER another mod
#Using dependency overrides can cause issues. Use at your own risk.
#Example dependency override for the mod with the id 'targetMod': dependency constraints (incompatibility clauses or restrictive version ranges) against mod 'dep1' are removed, and the mod will now load after the mod 'dep2'
#dependencyOverrides.targetMod = ["-dep1", "+dep2"]
dependencyOverrides = {}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NHConstants;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.WaitForAction;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ScreenEvent;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = NHConstants.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class ScreenEvents {
    private static final Set<WaitForAction> waitingActions = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    public static void watch(WaitForAction action) {
        waitingActions.add(action);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onOpening(ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(event.getNewScreen(), true)) {
                action.markDone();
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClosing(ScreenEvent.Closing event) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(event.getScreen(), false)) {
                action.markDone();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllCommandsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllFunctionsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllMenusAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ScriptRunner;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Event;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Others;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.PermissionException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.HousingCheck;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.SequenceManager;
import com.mojang.brigadier.CommandDispatcher;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.StringArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.builder.LiteralArgumentBuilder;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.commands.CommandSourceStack;
import net.minecraft.commands.Commands;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterClientCommandsEvent;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = NHConstants.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class ClientCommandHandler {

    private static final ScriptRunner NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER = ScriptRunner.INSTANCE;

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRegisterClientCommands(RegisterClientCommandsEvent event) {
        CommandDispatcher<CommandSourceStack> dispatcher = event.getDispatcher();
        dispatcher.register(buildCommand("neohouse"));
        dispatcher.register(buildCommand("nh"));
    }

    private static LiteralArgumentBuilder<CommandSourceStack> buildCommand(String name) {
        return Commands.literal(name)
                       .executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new HomeScreen(ClientCommandHandler::getScriptsDir));
                           return 1;
                       })
                       .then(Commands.literal("files").executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new FileBrowserScreen(getScriptsDir()));
                           return 1;
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("help").executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new HelpScreen(null));
                           return 1;
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("config").executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new ConfigScreen(null));
                           return 1;
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("nuke").executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           try {
                               return handleNuke();
                           } catch (Exception e) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                               return 0;
                           }
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("delete")
                                     .then(Commands.literal("functions").executes(ctx -> {

                                         if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                                         try {
                                             return handleDeleteFunctions();
                                         } catch (Exception e) {
                                             MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                                             return 0;
                                         }
                                     }))
                                     .then(Commands.literal("events").executes(ctx -> {
                                         if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                                         try {
                                             return handleDeleteEvents();
                                         } catch (Exception e) {
                                             MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                                             return 0;
                                         }
                                     }))
                                     .then(Commands.literal("commands").executes(ctx -> {
                                         if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                                         try {
                                             return handleDeleteCommands();
                                         } catch (Exception e) {
                                             MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                                             return 0;
                                         }
                                     }))
                                     .then(Commands.literal("menus").executes(ctx -> {
                                         if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                                         try {
                                             return handleDeleteMenus();
                                         } catch (Exception e) {
                                             MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                                             return 0;
                                         }
                                     }))
                            )
                       .then(Commands.literal("copyitem").executes(ctx -> {
                           Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
                           if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return 0;

                           ItemStack stack = mc.player.getMainHandItem();
                           if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat("You must be holding an item to copy its data.");
                               return 0;
                           }

                           net.minecraft.resources.RegistryOps<net.minecraft.nbt.Tag> _ops =
                                   mc.level.registryAccess().createSerializationContext(net.minecraft.nbt.NbtOps.INSTANCE);
                           net.minecraft.nbt.Tag fullNbt = net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack.CODEC.encodeStart(_ops, stack).getOrThrow();

                           String snbt = fullNbt.toString();

                           mc.keyboardHandler.setClipboard(snbt);

                           MessageUtils.debugToChat("Full item data copied to clipboard!");
                           return 1;
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("rerun").executes(ctx -> {
                           if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                           Path last = NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.getLastScript();
                           if (last == null) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat("No script has been run yet this session.");
                               return 0;
                           }
                           try {
                               NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(last);
                               MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + last.getFileName());
                               return 1;
                           } catch (Exception e) {
                               MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                               return 0;
                           }
                       }))
                       .then(Commands.literal("run")
                             .then(Commands.argument("path", StringArgumentType.greedyString())
                                   .executes(ctx -> {
                                       if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) {
                                           MessageUtils.errorToChat("No player context!");
                                           return 0;
                                       }
                                       Path scriptFile = resolveScriptPath(StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "path"));
                                       if (scriptFile == null) return 0;
                                       try {
                                           NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(scriptFile);
                                           MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + scriptFile.getFileName());
                                           return 1;
                                       } catch (Exception e) {
                                           MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                                           return 0;
                                       }
                                   })
                              )
                        );
    }

    private static int handleNuke() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
            throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
        }
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy\nALL functions, events, commands and menus.\n(Use '/neohouse delete <section>' to delete a specific section)",
                "",
                null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete")) {
                        throw new PermissionException("Nuke cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    }
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
                        throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
                    }
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();

                    ActionBuilder builder = new ActionBuilder()
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllFunctionsAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.COMMANDS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllCommandsAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                            .append(new DeleteAllMenusAction())
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.EVENT_ACTION);

                    for (Event event : Event.values()) {
                        builder.clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                               .append(new DeleteAllAction(10))
                               .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true);
                    }

                    SequenceManager.startAction(builder.closeAll().get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Nuking housing.");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteFunctions() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL functions.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                                                        .append(new DeleteAllFunctionsAction())
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all functions...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteCommands() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL commands.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.COMMANDS)
                                                        .append(new DeleteAllCommandsAction())
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all commands...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteEvents() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL event actions.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    ActionBuilder builder = new ActionBuilder()
                            .closeAll()
                            .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.EVENT_ACTION);
                    for (Event event : Event.values()) {
                        builder.clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                               .append(new DeleteAllAction(10))
                               .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true);
                    }
                    SequenceManager.startAction(builder.closeAll().get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all event actions...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    private static int handleDeleteMenus() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy ALL custom menus.",
                "", null,
                typed -> {
                    if (!typed.equals("Delete"))
                        throw new PermissionException("Cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                    if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing.");
                    SequenceManager.cancelAction();
                    SequenceManager.startAction(new ActionBuilder()
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                                                        .append(new DeleteAllMenusAction())
                                                        .closeAll()
                                                        .get());
                    MessageUtils.debugToChat("Deleting all custom menus...");
                }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

    public static Path getScriptsDir() {
        Path dir = Minecraft.getInstance().gameDirectory.toPath().resolve("neohouse-scripts");
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) {
            try {
                Files.createDirectories(dir);
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
        return dir;
    }

    private static String buildItemLiteral(String id, String customName, int count) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("{ id = \"").append(id).append("\"");
        if (customName != null) {
            sb.append(", name = \"").append(customName.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")).append("\"");
        }
        if (count != 1) {
            sb.append(", count = ").append(count);
        }
        sb.append(" }");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static Path resolveScriptPath(String raw) {
        String s = raw.trim();
        if ((s.startsWith("\"") && s.endsWith("\"")) || (s.startsWith("'") && s.endsWith("'"))) {
            s = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        }

        // auto-add .nh if no extension
        if (!s.contains(".")) s = s + ".nh";

        Path p = Paths.get(s);
        if (!p.isAbsolute()) {
            p = getScriptsDir().resolve(p);
        }

        String name = p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (!name.endsWith(".nh")) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Unsupported extension '" + name + "' — only .nh files are supported.");
            return null;
        }
        if (!Files.exists(p)) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Script not found: " + p);
            return null;
        }
        return p;
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.platform;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.ScreenEvents;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.WaitForAction;
import net.neoforged.fml.ModList;

public class NeoForgePlatform implements Platform {
    @Override
    public boolean isModLoaded(String modId) {
        return ModList.get().isLoaded(modId);
    }

    @Override
    public String getModVersion(String modId) {
        return ModList.get()
                .getModContainerById(modId)
                .map(c -> "v" + c.getModInfo().getVersion())
                .orElse("v?");
    }

    @Override
    public void watchForScreen(WaitForAction action) {
        ScreenEvents.watch(action);
    }
}
```
