# README.md

```md
# Neo House
## Introduction

Hello! Neo House is a project that acts as a replacement over Housing Editor. The issues with Housing Editor is that it isn't quite up to date anymore.
It also depends on other mods like chattriggers, and relies on an external website to be used properly. I liked the scratch-like UI it had, but I would
rather have something closer to code. HTSL is a good program to use Housing Editor with a coding language, however I felt like it missed a couple things
that it could have added.

I therefore decided to code my own version of Housing Editor as its standalone mod, along with a coding language and (probably) a syntax highlighter on Visual Studio Code!

## Versions

Currently, NeoHouse supports all 1.21.x versions (1.21 to 1.21.11) with NeoForge and Fabric.

```

# report.md

```md
# NeoHouse — Diagnostic Report

---

## 1. Code Smells

### `Config.java` is a dead file
`Config.java` registers an empty `ModConfigSpec` with NeoForge but never declares any config fields. All actual configuration lives in `NeoHouseConfig.java` (manual JSON). The two systems coexist without interacting. `Config.java` should be deleted; it currently registers a no-op `ModConfigEvent` listener and introduces a misleading parallel to `NeoHouseConfig`.

### `ScriptRunner.sourceNeedsCreativeMode` — text scanning instead of AST
`ScriptRunner` determines whether a script needs creative mode by doing `source.contains(action.name + "(")` on the raw source string after compilation. This means:
- It can false-positive on comments or string literals containing the action name
- It runs against the original source, not the preprocessed+expanded version
- It fires before imports are resolved

The right fix: check which `AddAction` values with `ITEM_LITERAL` params are actually emitted by the `CodeGenerator`, not which keywords appear in text.

### Silent config load failure in `NeoHouseConfig`
`NeoHouseConfig.load()` wraps everything in a try-catch that discards all exceptions (including `JsonParseException`, `IOException`, and `ClassCastException`). A corrupt or outdated config file silently falls back to defaults with no user notification. At minimum the catch should log a warning.

### Implicit global auto-promotion in `ScopeCheckingVisitor`
When a variable reference is not found in any scope, `ScopeCheckingVisitor.resolveOrDeclareGlobal` silently promotes it to a global `VAR`. A typo in a variable name creates a brand-new undeclared global with no warning. This should at least emit a warning, and ideally be an error unless the variable has an explicit `var` type declaration.

### Reflection in `AnvilAction`
`AnvilAction` accesses `AnvilScreen`'s private `name` field via `setAccessible(true)`. This breaks silently on obfuscated builds or mapping updates and throws a wrapped `RuntimeException` that drops the original cause. If this field is accessible another way (e.g. mixin or accessor interface), that would be far more robust.

### Duplicate enum-to-enum conversion in `CodeGenerator.toHolder`
`CodeGenerator.toHolder` converts `compiler.enums.Holder` to `constants.Holder` with a switch that maps each variant 1:1. Two enums exist for the same concept because one lives in the compiler layer and one in the game-mapping layer. Sharing a single `Holder` enum (or making `CodeGenerator` import the compiler one directly) would eliminate this boilerplate.

### `ConditionCallNode` missing from `AddCondition` list
`AddCondition` lists 22 conditions, but one (`VARIABLE`) and one (`PLACEHOLDER`) are handled as `BooleanExpressionNode` rather than `ConditionCallNode` inside `CodeGenerator.generateConditionCall`. The `default` fallthrough throws `IllegalStateException` at code-generation time rather than at parse time — a late error for something that could be caught earlier.

### `LinkedHashMap<WaitForAction, Object>` as a set
`ScreenEvents` uses `LinkedHashMap<WaitForAction, Object>` with null values to emulate an ordered set. Use `LinkedHashSet<WaitForAction>` instead.

### `VoidReturnNode` in `generateStatement` emits an Exit action inconsistently
In `generateStatement`, a `VoidReturnNode` inside a non-`NONE` context generates an Exit action. But `FunctionParamLoweringVisitor` and `ReturnPlacementVisitor` should already have normalized all returns before code generation. The runtime context-switch at generation time is a workaround for possibly-incomplete normalization and makes the statement generator non-uniform.

---

## 2. Features That Should Be Removed

### `Config.java`
As noted above — completely empty, no purpose.

### Commented-out trig functions in `BNF.bnf`
Lines 63–72 of `BNF.bnf` have `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `sqrt`, `nroot`, `pow`, and `|x|` commented out. These are in `const_expr`, which is only evaluated at compile time. Either implement them (they're useful for computing spawn coordinates, angles, etc.) or remove the comment block. Dead commented-out grammar is confusing.

### TODO comments in `HomeScreen.java`
Two TODO comments reference e4mc and Wurst detection (`//TODO You know e4mc exists, right?` and `//TODO You know, maybe don't use cheats...`). These are half-formed ideas that have been sitting in the source tree. Either implement them as hints or delete them.

---

## 3. Features That Should Be Added

### Find & Replace in `CodeEditorScreen`
The editor has no search capability. Ctrl+F for find and Ctrl+H for replace are standard and would be heavily used when working with long scripts. The `SyntaxEditorWidget` would need a search overlay.

### Go-to-line shortcut
Ctrl+G to jump to a specific line number would complement the line-number gutter already present.

### Parser error recovery
The parser currently stops at the first error. Adding basic panic-mode recovery (skip to the next statement or top-level declaration boundary) would allow reporting multiple errors per compile, which is a significant quality-of-life improvement for iterative development.

### `cancel` keyword restricted to events
`cancel` maps to Hypixel's `CANCEL_EVENT` which is only meaningful inside an event handler. The `ActionRestrictionVisitor` probably already enforces this at code-generation time, but the parser and scope checker don't reject it in function/command bodies early, leading to a late error message.

### Undo history in the editor
`SyntaxEditorWidget` inherits from Minecraft's `EditBox`, which has no undo stack. Users can lose work if they accidentally overwrite a large block. A simple circular buffer of text snapshots triggered on edit would suffice.

### Runtime loop construct
The language has `repeat(N)` which is compile-time unrolled. There is no runtime loop. Hypixel Housing supports "loop" functions (periodic tick execution), but the language has no way to express "do this N times at runtime" — all loops must be manually unrolled at compile time or modeled as loop functions. A `while`-style construct that desugars into trigger-function recursion would be useful, though Hypixel's action limits constrain how deep it can go.

### Warning system alongside errors
Currently `CompilingException` is thrown on the first problem. A warning list (non-fatal) would let the compiler report auto-promoted globals, unreachable code, or deprecated usage without aborting compilation.

### File browser: rename and create new file
`FileBrowserScreen` can browse and open files, but there is no in-UI way to rename or create a new `.nh` file without going to the OS file manager.

### Syntax theme hot-reload
Changing the syntax theme in `ConfigScreen` requires closing and re-opening the editor. The editor could listen for config changes and re-tokenize on theme switch.

---

## 4. Features That Should Be Modified

### `ScriptRunner` creative-mode detection
Replace the raw-string scan with a post-compilation AST walk (or a flag emitted by `CodeGenerator`) that records whether any item-related action was actually emitted. See §1 for details.

### `NeoHouseConfig` error handling
Silent failure on config load should at minimum push a message to the Minecraft chat (via `MessageUtils.errorToChat`) when the JSON is malformed, so users know their settings were not applied.

### `WaitForAction` timeout
The 200-tick (10 second) timeout is hardcoded. Heavy scripts navigating deep menus can legitimately exceed this. Expose it in `NeoHouseConfig`.

### `overrideExisting` config description
The `ConfigScreen` tooltip says "When running a script, recreate existing functions, events, commands and menus from scratch. Disable to skip items that already exist." The distinction between what "already exists" means for events (has content in slot 10) vs. functions (name search returns a result) is not surfaced. The tooltip should note that this affects code generation strategy, not just whether items are skipped.

### `ActionCountSplittingVisitor` naming
Functions it creates to absorb overflow actions are named with internal conventions that may conflict with user-defined names. The naming scheme for generated helper functions should be clearly separate (e.g. use a prefix like `__split_` that the parser rejects as a user name).

### `deriveConditionalActionCtx` in `CodeGenerator`
This method manually manipulates enum name strings (`name.replace("EVENT_", "EVENT_CONDITION_")`). This is fragile and couples `CodeGenerator` to the naming convention of `RestrictionAction`. Encoding the nested-context equivalent directly in the `RestrictionAction` enum (e.g. a `conditionalVariant()` method) would be cleaner.

### `BNF.bnf` — `name` production excludes digits
The `name` production only allows `[a-z] | [A-Z] | '_'`, meaning identifiers cannot contain digits. This is more restrictive than Housing's actual naming rules (which allow digits after the first character). At minimum the grammar should match what the lexer actually accepts.

### `TypedFunctionNode` is unused in code generation
`TypedFunctionNode` (functions that return a value) exists in the AST and is handled by `ScopeCheckingVisitor` and return checkers, but `CodeGenerator.generate` only handles `VoidFunctionNode`. Typed functions are lowered/inlined earlier in the pipeline, which means any typed function that survives to code generation would silently be skipped. This should be explicitly verified (assert or error) rather than left as a silent gap.

---

## 5. Refactor Areas

### `DefaultVisitor.java` — boilerplate tree transformation
`DefaultVisitor` must manually implement identity-transform visit methods for every AST node type (currently 28+ methods). Every time a new node type is added, `DefaultVisitor` must be updated or it silently returns null. Consider generating this class from the AST node hierarchy via annotation processing, or switching to a record-based AST where structural copying is derivable.

### `CodeGenerator` two-pass override branching
The `generate` method has an `if (override)` block for Pass 1 followed by a second loop for Pass 2. The `generateXxx` vs `generateXxxIfAbsent` method pairs duplicate the structure of every top-level entity type. Extracting a `TopLevelStrategy` interface (with `createShell()` and `fillBody()` methods) would centralize this duplication.

### Visitor chain in `NHCompiler` — hard-coded linear sequence
The 16-visitor pipeline in `NHCompiler.compile` is written as a sequence of local variable declarations and method calls. Adding, removing, or reordering a visitor requires editing this method and being careful about what state each visitor depends on. Expressing the chain as a `List<VisitorPass>` with named steps would make the pipeline easier to test in isolation and easier to document.

### `AddAction` / `AddCondition` enums — data in code
These enums encode 45 actions and 22 conditions with per-entry field data (max counts, param kinds, display names). As the action list grows, the enums grow unwieldy. A data-driven approach (JSON or a dedicated resource file read at startup) would separate the Housing API surface from compiler logic.

### `RestrictionAction` / `RestrictionCondition` — combinatorial enum
`RestrictionAction` encodes 40+ variants covering every event type, their conditional sub-contexts, menu contexts, etc. The naming convention (`EVENT_CONDITION_DEATH`, etc.) is load-bearing but brittle. Replacing this with a composite context object (`ExecutionContext { EventType event; boolean inConditional; boolean inMenu; }`) would make the restriction rules explicit and testable without string manipulation.

### `NeoHouseConfig` — manual JSON instead of NeoForge config system
`NeoHouseConfig` manually reads/writes a JSON file in `.minecraft/neohouse/`. The mod already pulls in NeoForge which provides a robust config system (TOML-based, with hot-reload support, validation, and UI integration). Migrating to NeoForge config would eliminate `NeoHouseConfig.load()`, `NeoHouseConfig.save()`, and the silent-failure trap.

### `Preprocessor` — `define` at both preprocessor and AST level
The `#define NAME = value` directive is processed by `Preprocessor` as text substitution, but there is also a `DefinitionNode` in the AST (with its own `DefinitionNode` class and `DeclarationCollectorVisitor` handling). It's unclear whether these are the same feature at different stages or two separate mechanisms. The duplication should be resolved: either definitions are purely preprocessor-level (and `DefinitionNode` is removed), or they are purely AST-level (and the preprocessor text substitution is removed).

---

## 6. Unhandled / Mishandled Exceptions

| Location | Issue |
|---|---|
| `NeoHouseConfig.load()` | Catches all exceptions and discards them silently. Malformed config files reset to defaults with no feedback. |
| `AnvilAction` | Catches `Exception` from reflection and rethrows as `RuntimeException`, losing the original cause type and stack frame. |
| `ScriptRunner.runScript(Path)` | `CompilingException` and `PermissionException` are declared, but the callers in `CodeEditorScreen.saveAndRun()` catch generic `Exception` and route to `MessageUtils.errorToChat`. This hides the structured error data (token, line, column) that `CompilingException` carries. |
| `CodeEditorScreen.checkErrors()` | The outer `catch (Exception e)` after `catch (CompilingException e)` swallows unexpected runtime exceptions as `"Internal error: " + e.getMessage()`. `getMessage()` can return null, resulting in `"Internal error: null"` with no further context. Should use `e.toString()` or include the class name. |
| `WaitForAction` | Times out after 200 ticks and throws `InterruptActionException`. The exception is caught inside `SequenceManager` but callers that invoke `SequenceManager.startAction` have no way to react to a timeout. The timeout should surface as a user-visible message. |
| `ScopeCheckingVisitor.resolveOrDeclareGlobal` | Silently auto-promotes unknown identifiers to global VAR (see §1). This is a form of silent semantic failure that should be a warning or error. |
| `CodeGenerator.generateStatement` | `default -> throw new IllegalStateException(...)` is correct, but this exception is unchecked and will bubble up to `CodeEditorScreen.checkErrors()` as the generic `catch (Exception e)` case, producing an unhelpful "Internal error" message. |
| `Preprocessor` | Circular import detection throws a `CompilingException` with a null token. The error message reads "Circular import detected", which doesn't tell the user which file is the cycle root. |
| `Parser` | Throws `ParsingException` on first syntax error with no recovery. All subsequent errors are lost. |

---

## 7. Grammar of the Language

### Overview
NeoHouse scripts compile to Hypixel Housing action sequences. The language is **statically-typed** with four primitive types (`long`, `double`, `string`, `bool`) plus `var` (dynamic / Housing's untyped variable). The type system is shallow: types influence operator checking but all Housing variables are strings at runtime.

### Type System
- `long` and `double` for numeric work; `var` for Housing's native variable references
- `bool` is a first-class literal but not a `var` type (Housing doesn't have boolean variables)
- Type widening (`long → double`, `long → string`, etc.) should be clarified in the grammar — it happens implicitly in `TypeInferringVisitor` but isn't described in `BNF.bnf`
- The `var [N]` array type appears in the grammar and AST but there is no evidence that runtime array operations are fully implemented

### Control Flow
- **`if / else`** — maps to Hypixel's `CONDITIONAL` action (max 25 per function)
- **`repeat(N)`** — compile-time unrolling, not a runtime loop; `N` must be a constant expression
- **`random { ... }`** — maps to Hypixel's `RANDOM` action; each brace block is an equal-probability branch
- No `while`, `for`, or `do-while` — intentional because Housing has no runtime looping primitive

### Variable Scopes
- `p.name` — player variable (per-player, persists across sessions)
- `g.name` — global variable (shared across all players)
- `t[teamName].name` — team variable (shared within a team)
- Local (stack) variables exist syntactically (`long x;`) but are lowered to global or player variables by the compiler pipeline since Housing has no concept of local scope

### Functions
- `function name(params) { }` — void function; params are lowered to global variables by `FunctionParamLoweringVisitor`
- `function Type name(params) { }` — typed (returning) function; return value is communicated through a generated global variable
- `event EventName { }` — event handler; restricted action set depending on event type
- `command name [self|target] (priority, listed) { }` — slash command handler
- `menu name(rows) { slot N: (item) { } }` — custom inventory menu
- Loop functions are named functions registered with a tick delay

### Expressions
- Standard arithmetic: `+ - * / %`, bitwise ops, shifts
- Comparison: `== != < > <= >=`
- Logical: `&&` (AND), `||` (OR) — Housing maps these to MATCH_ANY flag on `CONDITIONAL`
- Unary: `-`, `!` (not), `++`, `--` (prefix/postfix), `(long)`, `(double)`, `(string)` casts
- Placeholders: `ph.player.health`, `ph.date.unix`, `ph.random.whole(1,100)`, etc. — read-only game state values
- No string interpolation — string values must be `+`-concatenated

### Known Grammar Issues
1. **`name` production excludes digits** — identifiers cannot contain `[0-9]` at any position, which is more restrictive than the Hypixel Housing naming rules
2. **`const_expr` trig functions commented out** — the grammar references math functions that aren't implemented
3. **`bool` type** — `bool` is listed as a `base_type` but `VariableType.BOOL` can't be stored in a Housing variable; scripts that try to assign a bool expression to `p.x` should be a type error
4. **No string escape sequences** — `char` in `BNF.bnf` is defined as "any character except `"` or `\n`". There is no `\n`, `\t`, `\\`, or `\"` escape sequence described
5. **`random` body semantics** — the grammar allows any statements inside each `random` branch, but Hypixel gives each branch equal probability. There is no syntax to weight branches
6. **`cancel` keyword** — semantically valid only inside event handlers, but the grammar permits it anywhere a statement is valid

---

## 8. UI Design

### Strengths
- Consistent dark theme (`0xCC0E0E14` background, `0xEE1A1A2A` header) across all screens
- Transparent background lets the game world show through (immersive, appropriate for an in-game tool)
- Section dividers in `ConfigScreen` provide clear grouping
- Dirty indicator (`●`) and orange filename in `CodeEditorScreen` are clear and minimal
- The info `(i)` button in `CodeEditorScreen` opens help without leaving the editor context
- Footer action bar in `FileBrowserScreen` (select then act) prevents accidental double-tap actions
- Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+S works in the editor
- Hint system in `HomeScreen` provides personality without being intrusive

### Issues and Recommendations

**`FileBrowserScreen`**
- No way to create, rename, or delete files from within the UI
- No path breadcrumb — if scripts can be nested in subdirectories, navigation history is not visible
- No keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter to open) — everything requires mouse clicks
- Empty state (no `.nh` files found) shows nothing; a "Create new script" prompt would be more helpful

**`CodeEditorScreen`**
- No find/replace — critical for scripts with repetitive patterns
- No go-to-line — the gutter shows numbers but you can't jump to a specific line
- Error indicator currently only highlights the error token. Long scripts need the error to also be visible in the scrollbar/gutter as a marker when the error line is off-screen
- No syntax highlighting for keywords inside string literals (not a priority, but noted)
- The `Save & Run` button compiles twice: once for the live error check, once during `save()`. The compiled result from `checkErrors()` is thrown away. The button could reuse the last clean compile result

**`ConfigScreen`**
- The theme preview is hardcoded (`renderPreview`). If new syntax token types are added, the preview must be manually updated
- No validation feedback on the `clickDelay` text field (non-numeric input is silently ignored on save)
- The `< Back` button and the red `X` button do the same thing (both call `closeAndSave()`). One of them should be removed

**`HelpScreen`**
- Static document with no search
- Keyboard shortcut list is incomplete (Ctrl+S is mentioned implicitly via "Save" button, but Ctrl+S is not documented anywhere visible)

**`InputDialogScreen`**
- The confirm dialog ("Unsaved changes. Discard?") uses OK/Cancel terminology. A more specific label like "Discard changes" / "Keep editing" would be clearer

**General**
- No loading/progress indicator when running a long script — the UI gives no feedback that the script is executing (the action runner works in the background, but there's no spinner or status line)
- Escape key dismisses suggestions in the editor but also triggers the "unsaved changes" dialog if nothing is focused — the key handling priority could be made clearer
- No confirmation before `Save & Run` — saving and immediately executing is a destructive action if the script modifies Housing state

```

```toml
#Disables File Watcher. Used to automatically update config if its file has been modified.
disableConfigWatcher = false
#Should we control the window. Disabling this disables new GL features and can be bad for mods that rely on them.
earlyWindowControl = true
#Max threads for early initialization parallelism,  -1 is based on processor count
maxThreads = -1
#Enable NeoForge global version checking
versionCheck = true
#Default config path for servers
defaultConfigPath = "defaultconfigs"
#Disables Optimized DFU client-side - already disabled on servers
disableOptimizedDFU = true
#Early window provider
earlyWindowProvider = "fmlearlywindow"
#Early window width
earlyWindowWidth = 854
#Early window height
earlyWindowHeight = 480
#Early window framebuffer scale
earlyWindowFBScale = 1
#Early window starts maximized
earlyWindowMaximized = false
#Skip specific GL versions, may help with buggy graphics card drivers
earlyWindowSkipGLVersions = []
#Squir?
earlyWindowSquir = false
#Define dependency overrides below
#Dependency overrides can be used to forcibly remove a dependency constraint from a mod or to force a mod to load AFTER another mod
#Using dependency overrides can cause issues. Use at your own risk.
#Example dependency override for the mod with the id 'targetMod': dependency constraints (incompatibility clauses or restrictive version ranges) against mod 'dep1' are removed, and the mod will now load after the mod 'dep2'
#dependencyOverrides.targetMod = ["-dep1", "+dep2"]
dependencyOverrides = {}

```

# run\config\neoforge-client.toml

```toml
#EXPERIMENTAL: Enable the NeoForge block rendering pipeline - fixes the lighting of custom models.
experimentalForgeLightPipelineEnabled = false
#When enabled, NeoForge will show any warnings that occurred during loading.
showLoadWarnings = true
#A config option mainly for developers. Logs out configuration values that do not have translations when running a client in a development environment.
logUntranslatedConfigurationWarnings = true
#Configures how many bits are used for the depth buffer when stenciling has been enabled by a mod. Set to true for 24+8 bits and to false for 32+8 bits. Setting to true will slightly reduce VRAM usage, but risks introducing visual artifacts.
reducedDepthStencilFormat = false

```

# run\config\neoforge-common.toml

```toml
#A config option mainly for developers. Logs out modded item tags that do not have translations when running on integrated server. Format desired is tag.item.<namespace>.<path> for the translation key. Defaults to SILENCED.
#Allowed Values: SILENCED, DEV_SHORT, DEV_VERBOSE, PROD_SHORT, PROD_VERBOSE
logUntranslatedItemTagWarnings = "SILENCED"
#A config option mainly for developers. Logs out modded tags that are using the 'forge' namespace when running on integrated server. Defaults to DEV_SHORT.
#Allowed Values: SILENCED, DEV_SHORT, DEV_VERBOSE, PROD_SHORT, PROD_VERBOSE
logLegacyTagWarnings = "DEV_SHORT"
#Set this to true to enable showing debug information about attributes on an item when advanced tooltips is on.
attributeAdvancedTooltipDebugInfo = true

```

# run\config\neoforge-server.toml

```toml
#Set this to true to remove any BlockEntity that throws an error in its update method instead of closing the server and reporting a crash log. BE WARNED THIS COULD SCREW UP EVERYTHING USE SPARINGLY WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DAMAGES.
removeErroringBlockEntities = false
#Set this to true to remove any Entity (Note: Does not include BlockEntities) that throws an error in its tick method instead of closing the server and reporting a crash log. BE WARNED THIS COULD SCREW UP EVERYTHING USE SPARINGLY WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DAMAGES.
removeErroringEntities = false
#Set this to true to check the entire entity's collision bounding box for ladders instead of just the block they are in. Causes noticeable differences in mechanics so default is vanilla behavior. Default: false.
fullBoundingBoxLadders = false
#The permission handler used by the server. Defaults to neoforge:default_handler if no such handler with that name is registered.
permissionHandler = "neoforge:default_handler"
#Set this to true to enable advertising the dedicated server to local LAN clients so that it shows up in the Multiplayer screen automatically.
advertiseDedicatedServerToLan = true

```

# run\config\neohouse-common.toml

```toml
#Whether to log the dirt block on common setup
logDirtBlock = true
#A magic number
# Default: 42
# Range: > 0
magicNumber = 42
#What you want the introduction message to be for the magic number
magicNumberIntroduction = "The magic number is... "
#A list of items to log on common setup.
items = ["minecraft:iron_ingot"]

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AnvilScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;

public class AnvilAction extends Action {
    private final String name;
    private Field nameField;

    public AnvilAction(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        try {
            nameField = AnvilScreen.class.getDeclaredField("name");
            nameField.setAccessible(true);
        } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("AnvilScreen.name field not found — mapping mismatch?", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!(mc.screen instanceof AnvilScreen anvil)) throw new InterruptActionException("Not in anvil screen.");

        EditBox edit;
        try {
            edit = (EditBox) nameField.get(anvil);
        } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot access anvil name field", e);
        }

        if (edit == null || edit.getValue() == null || edit.getValue().isEmpty()) return false;

        edit.setValue(name);
        anvil.getMenu().setItemName(name);
        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(anvil.getMenu().containerId, 2, 0, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        return true;
    }
}

```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\ChatAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.player.LocalPlayer;

public class ChatAction extends Action {
    private final String message;

    public ChatAction(String message) {
        this.message = message;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        LocalPlayer player = mc.player;
        if (player != null) {
            player.connection.sendChat(message);
            return true;
        }

        throw new InterruptActionException("An unexpected error occurred, could not type in chat.");
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\CheckSlotEmptyAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;

/**
 * Runs ifEmpty if the given slot has no item, otherwise runs ifOccupied.
 */
public class CheckSlotEmptyAction extends Action {
    private final int   slotIndex;
    private final Action ifEmpty;
    private final Action ifOccupied;
    private Action active = null;

    public CheckSlotEmptyAction(int slotIndex, Action ifEmpty, Action ifOccupied) {
        this.slotIndex   = slotIndex;
        this.ifEmpty     = ifEmpty;
        this.ifOccupied  = ifOccupied;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (active == null) {
            AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
            if (menu == null || menu.slots.size() <= slotIndex) return true;
            active = menu.slots.get(slotIndex).hasItem() ? ifOccupied : ifEmpty;
        }
        if (active.run(mc)) { active = null; return true; }
        return false;
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class ClientMessageAction extends Action {
    private final String message;
    private final boolean isWarning;

    public ClientMessageAction(String message, boolean isWarning) {
        this.message   = message;
        this.isWarning = isWarning;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (isWarning) MessageUtils.warningToChat(message);
        else           MessageUtils.debugToChat(message);
        return true;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\CreativeGiveAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.TagParser;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ServerboundSetCreativeModeSlotPacket;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.util.Optional;

public class CreativeGiveAction extends Action {
    private final String rawItemData;

    public CreativeGiveAction(String rawItemData) {
        this.rawItemData = rawItemData;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.getConnection() == null || mc.level == null) return true;

        if (!mc.player.isCreative()) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Player must be in creative mode to give items.");
        }

        ItemStack finalStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;

        if (rawItemData != null && !rawItemData.isBlank()) {
            try {
                CompoundTag nbt = TagParser.parseTag(rawItemData);
                Optional<ItemStack> parsedStack = ItemStack.parse(mc.level.registryAccess(), nbt);

                finalStack = parsedStack.filter(stack -> !stack.isEmpty()).orElse(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } catch (CommandSyntaxException e) {
                throw new InterruptActionException("Tried to get an item with invalid data.");
            }
        }

        int creativeSlot = mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() - 29; // hotbar 8th slot
        mc.getConnection().send(new ServerboundSetCreativeModeSlotPacket(creativeSlot, finalStack.copy()));
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;

public class DeleteAllAction extends Action {
    private final int slotIndex;
    private boolean waiting = false;
    private final WaitForAction waitFor;
    private final WaitTicksAction waitTicks;

    public DeleteAllAction(int slotIndex) {
        this.slotIndex = slotIndex;
        this.waitFor = new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true);
        this.waitTicks = new WaitTicksAction(1);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (waiting) {
            if (!waitFor.run(mc) || !waitTicks.run(mc)) {
                return false;
            }
            waitTicks.reset();
            waitFor.reset();
            waiting = false;
        }

        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        Slot s = menu.slots.get(slotIndex);

        if (s.getItem().isEmpty()) return true;

        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(menu.containerId, slotIndex, 1, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        this.waiting = true;
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;

public class DeleteAllCommandsAction extends Action {
    private Action current = null;

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return true;
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        if (menu == null) return true;

        if (current == null) {
            if (menu.slots.size() <= 10 || !menu.slots.get(10).hasItem()) return true;
            String fullName = menu.slots.get(10).getItem().getHoverName().getString();
            // Command items in the list are shown as "/commandName"; strip the slash for removeCommandIfPresent
            String name = fullName.startsWith("/") ? fullName.substring(1) : fullName;
            current = new ActionBuilder().removeCommandIfPresent(name).get();
        }

        if (current.run(mc)) current = null;
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.List;

public class GroupAction extends Action {
    private final Iterator<Action> it;
    private Action current;

    public GroupAction(List<Action> actions) {
        this.it = actions.iterator();
        this.current = it.hasNext() ? it.next() : null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        while (current != null) {
            if (!current.run(mc)) return false;
            current = it.hasNext() ? it.next() : null;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\SearchAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;

public class SearchAction extends Action {
    private final int[] primarySlots;
    private final String targetName;
    private final Item itemType;
    private final boolean leftClick;
    private final boolean includePlayerInventory;
    private final Action onFound;
    private final Action onNotFound;
    private final boolean paged;
    private int searchMissTicks = 0;
    private static final int SEARCH_GRACE_TICKS = 6;

    private final WaitForAction waitForUI;
    private final WaitForAction waitForFound;
    private final WaitTicksAction waitTick = new WaitTicksAction(1);

    private enum Step {
        STEP_SEARCH,
        STEP_CLICK_BACKUP,
        STEP_WAIT_UI,
        STEP_WAIT_FOUND,
        STEP_FOUND,
        STEP_NOT_FOUND,
        STEP_DONE
    }

    private Step step = Step.STEP_SEARCH;

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, boolean includePlayerInventory, boolean paged, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, boolean waitForOpen, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this.primarySlots = primarySlots;
        this.targetName = targetName;
        this.paged = paged;
        this.itemType = itemType;
        this.leftClick = leftClick;
        this.includePlayerInventory = includePlayerInventory;
        this.onFound = onFound;
        this.onNotFound = onNotFound;
        this.waitForUI = new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true);
        this.waitForFound = new WaitForAction(waitForAfterClick, waitForOpen);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, boolean waitForOpen, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, waitForAfterClick, waitForOpen, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Class<? extends Screen> waitForAfterClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, waitForAfterClick, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(int[] primarySlots, String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(primarySlots, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, boolean includePlayerInventory, boolean paged,  Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(null, targetName, itemType, leftClick, includePlayerInventory, paged, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    public SearchAction(String targetName, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, Action onFound, Action onNotFound) {
        this(null, targetName, itemType, leftClick, false, true, ContainerScreen.class, true, onFound, onNotFound);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return true;
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = mc.player.containerMenu;
        if (menu == null) return true;

        int[] slots = primarySlots;
        if (slots == null) {
            slots = menu.slots.stream()
                    .filter(s -> includePlayerInventory || !(s.container instanceof Inventory))
                    .mapToInt(s -> s.index)
                    .toArray();
        }

        if (step == Step.STEP_SEARCH) {
            boolean found = false;

            for (int idx : slots) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= menu.slots.size()) continue;

                Slot s = menu.getSlot(idx);
                if (s.hasItem()
                    && s.getItem().getHoverName().getString().equals(targetName)
                    && (itemType == null || s.getItem().getItem() == itemType)
                    && mc.gameMode != null) {

                    mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(
                            menu.containerId,
                            idx,
                            leftClick ? 0 : 1,
                            ClickType.PICKUP,
                            mc.player
                                                         );

                    step = Step.STEP_WAIT_FOUND;
                    searchMissTicks = 0;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!found) {
                searchMissTicks++;
                if (searchMissTicks >= SEARCH_GRACE_TICKS) {
                    searchMissTicks = 0;
                    step = Step.STEP_CLICK_BACKUP;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_CLICK_BACKUP) {
            Slot arrow = menu.getSlot(slots[slots.length - 1]);
            if (arrow.hasItem() && mc.gameMode != null) {
                mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(menu.containerId, arrow.index, 0, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
                step = Step.STEP_WAIT_UI;
            } else {
                step = Step.STEP_NOT_FOUND;
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_WAIT_UI) {
            if (waitForUI.run(mc) && waitTick.run(mc)) {
                step = Step.STEP_SEARCH;
                searchMissTicks = 0;
                waitForUI.reset();
                waitTick.reset();
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_WAIT_FOUND) {
            if (waitForFound.run(mc) && waitTick.run(mc)) {
                step = Step.STEP_FOUND;
                waitForFound.reset();
                waitTick.reset();
            }
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_FOUND) {
            if (onFound == null || onFound.run(mc)) step = Step.STEP_DONE;
        }
        else if (step == Step.STEP_NOT_FOUND) {
            if (onNotFound == null || onNotFound.run(mc)) step = Step.STEP_DONE;
            if (onNotFound == null) throw new InterruptActionException("Could not find item called '" + targetName + "'.");
        }
        else {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractSignEditScreen;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;

public class SignAction extends Action {
    private final String text;
    private static final Field MESSAGES_FIELD;

    static {
        Field found = null;
        for (Field f : AbstractSignEditScreen.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            if (f.getType() == String[].class) {
                f.setAccessible(true);
                found = f;
                break;
            }
        }
        MESSAGES_FIELD = found;
    }

    public SignAction(String text) {
        this.text = text;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!(mc.screen instanceof AbstractSignEditScreen sign))
            throw new InterruptActionException("Not in sign edit screen.");

        if (MESSAGES_FIELD == null)
            throw new InterruptActionException("Could not locate sign messages field via reflection.");

        try {
            String[] msgs = (String[]) MESSAGES_FIELD.get(sign);
            if (msgs != null && msgs.length > 0) msgs[0] = text;
        } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Could not write sign text: " + e.getMessage());
        }

        sign.onClose();
        return true;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\SlotAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.ClickType;

public class SlotAction extends Action {
    private final int slotIndex;
    private final boolean leftClick;
    private final boolean fromEnd;

    public SlotAction(int slotIndex, boolean leftClick) {
        this(slotIndex, leftClick, false);
    }

    public SlotAction(int slotIndex, boolean leftClick, boolean fromEnd) {
        this.slotIndex = slotIndex;
        this.leftClick = leftClick;
        this.fromEnd = fromEnd;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.gameMode == null || mc.player == null) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("An unexpected error occurred, could not click a slot.");
        }

        int newIndex = fromEnd ? mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() - 1 - slotIndex : slotIndex;
        if (mc.player.containerMenu.slots.size() <= newIndex) throw new InterruptActionException("Tried clicking a slot that doesn't exist.");
        mc.gameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick(mc.player.containerMenu.containerId, newIndex, leftClick ? 0 : 1, ClickType.PICKUP, mc.player);
        return true;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\actions\actiontypes\WaitForAction.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.ScreenEvents;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;

public class WaitForAction extends Action {
    private static final int TIMEOUT_TICKS = 200;

    private final Class<? extends Screen> screenClass;
    private final boolean waitForOpen;
    private boolean done = false;
    private boolean registered = false;
    private int ticksWaited = 0;

    public WaitForAction(Class<? extends Screen> screenClass, boolean waitForOpen) {
        this.screenClass = screenClass;
        this.waitForOpen = waitForOpen;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!registered) {
            ScreenEvents.watch(this);
            registered = true;
        }
        if (done) return true;
        if (++ticksWaited > TIMEOUT_TICKS) {
            throw new InterruptActionException("Timed out waiting for UI screen to " + (waitForOpen ? "open" : "close") + ".");
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean matchesScreen(Screen screen, boolean isOpening) {
        return isOpening == waitForOpen && screen != null && screenClass.isAssignableFrom(screen.getClass());
    }

    public void markDone() {
        this.done = true;
    }

    public void reset() {
        this.done = false;
        this.registered = false;
        this.ticksWaited = 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class WaitTicksAction extends Action {
    private int ticks;
    private int ticksRemaining;

    public WaitTicksAction(int ticks) {
        this.ticks = ticks;
        this.ticksRemaining = ticks;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean run(Minecraft mc) {
        if (ticksRemaining <= 0) return true;
        ticksRemaining--;
        return false;
    }

    public void reset() {
        ticksRemaining = ticks;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.actions;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouse;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.WaitForAction;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ScreenEvent;

import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid= NeoHouse.MOD_ID, bus=EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME, value= Dist.CLIENT)
public class ScreenEvents {
    private static final Set<WaitForAction> waitingActions = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    public static void watch(WaitForAction action) {
        waitingActions.add(action);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onOpening(ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(event.getNewScreen(), true)) {
                action.markDone();
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClosing(ScreenEvent.Closing event) {
        for (WaitForAction action : waitingActions) {
            if (action.matchesScreen(event.getScreen(), false)) {
                action.markDone();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.FileBrowserScreen;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.SequenceManager;
import net.minecraft.client.KeyMapping;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.InputEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterKeyMappingsEvent;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = NeoHouse.MOD_ID, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class CancelKeybind {

    private static final String CATEGORY = "key.categories.neohouse";

    public static final KeyMapping CANCEL_KEY = new KeyMapping(
            "key.neohouse.cancel",
            GLFW.GLFW_KEY_K,
            CATEGORY
    );

    public static final KeyMapping FILES_KEY = new KeyMapping(
            "key.neohouse.files",
            GLFW.GLFW_KEY_O,
            CATEGORY
    );

    public static void registerKeys(RegisterKeyMappingsEvent event) {
        event.register(CANCEL_KEY);
        event.register(FILES_KEY);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onKey(InputEvent.Key event) {
        if (event.getAction() != GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();

        if (CANCEL_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            SequenceManager.cancelAction();
            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Cancelled.");
        }

        if (FILES_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            if (mc.player != null && mc.screen == null) {
                mc.setScreen(new FileBrowserScreen(ClientCommandHandler.getScriptsDir()));
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllCommandsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllFunctionsAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.DeleteAllMenusAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.NHCompiler;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ScriptRunner;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Event;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Others;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.PermissionException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.HousingCheck;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.SequenceManager;
import com.mojang.brigadier.CommandDispatcher;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.StringArgumentType;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.commands.CommandSourceStack;
import net.minecraft.commands.Commands;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterClientCommandsEvent;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = NeoHouse.MOD_ID, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class ClientCommandHandler {

    private static final ScriptRunner NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER = new ScriptRunner(new NHCompiler());
    private static Path lastRunScript = null;

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRegisterClientCommands(RegisterClientCommandsEvent event) {
        CommandDispatcher<CommandSourceStack> dispatcher = event.getDispatcher();

        dispatcher.register(
            Commands.literal("neohouse")
            .executes(ctx -> {
                if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new HomeScreen(ClientCommandHandler::getScriptsDir));
                return 1;
            })
            .then(Commands.literal("files").executes(ctx -> {
                if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new FileBrowserScreen(getScriptsDir()));
                return 1;
            }))
            .then(Commands.literal("help").executes(ctx -> {
                if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new HelpScreen(null));
                return 1;
            }))
            .then(Commands.literal("config").executes(ctx -> {
                if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new ConfigScreen(null));
                return 1;
            }))
            .then(Commands.literal("nuke").executes(ctx -> {
                if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                try {
                    return handleNuke();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                    return 0;
                }
            }))
            .then(Commands.literal("delete")
                .then(Commands.literal("functions").executes(ctx -> {

                    if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                    try {
                        return handleDeleteFunctions();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                        return 0;
                    }
                }))
                .then(Commands.literal("events").executes(ctx -> {
                    if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                    try {
                        return handleDeleteEvents();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                        return 0;
                    }
                }))
                .then(Commands.literal("commands").executes(ctx -> {
                    if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                    try {
                        return handleDeleteCommands();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                        return 0;
                    }
                }))
                .then(Commands.literal("menus").executes(ctx -> {
                    if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                    try {
                        return handleDeleteMenus();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                        return 0;
                    }
                }))
            )
                    .then(Commands.literal("copyitem").executes(ctx -> {
                        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
                        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return 0;

                        ItemStack stack = mc.player.getMainHandItem();
                        if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                            MessageUtils.errorToChat("You must be holding an item to copy its data.");
                            return 0;
                        }

                        net.minecraft.nbt.Tag fullNbt = stack.save(mc.level.registryAccess());

                        String snbt = fullNbt.toString();

                        mc.keyboardHandler.setClipboard(snbt);

                        MessageUtils.debugToChat("Full item data copied to clipboard!");
                        return 1;
                    }))
            .then(Commands.literal("run")
                .then(Commands.literal("latest").executes(ctx -> {
                    if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return 0;
                    if (lastRunScript == null) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat("No script has been run yet this session.");
                        return 0;
                    }
                    try {
                        NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(lastRunScript);
                        MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + lastRunScript.getFileName());
                        return 1;
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                        return 0;
                    }
                }))
                .then(Commands.argument("path", StringArgumentType.greedyString())
                    .executes(ctx -> {
                        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) {
                            MessageUtils.errorToChat("No player context!");
                            return 0;
                        }
                        Path scriptFile = resolveScriptPath(StringArgumentType.getString(ctx, "path"));
                        if (scriptFile == null) return 0;
                        try {
                            lastRunScript = scriptFile;
                            NH_SCRIPT_RUNNER.runScript(scriptFile);
                            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + scriptFile.getFileName());
                            return 1;
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
                            return 0;
                        }
                    })
                )
            )
        );
    }

    private static int handleNuke() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
            throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
        }
        mc.setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
            "Type \"Delete\" to permanently destroy\nALL functions, events, commands and menus.\n(Use '/neohouse delete <section>' to delete a specific section)",
            "",
            null,
            typed -> {
                if (!typed.equals("Delete")) {
                    throw new PermissionException("Nuke cancelled — you didn't type \"Delete\".");
                }
                if (!HousingCheck.isInHousing()) {
                    throw new PermissionException("You must be in Hypixel Housing to nuke.");
                }
                SequenceManager.cancelAction();

                ActionBuilder builder = new ActionBuilder()
                        .closeAll()
                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                        .append(new DeleteAllFunctionsAction())
                        .closeAll()
                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.COMMANDS)
                        .append(new DeleteAllCommandsAction())
                        .closeAll()
                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                        .append(new DeleteAllMenusAction())
                        .closeAll()
                        .sendChatAndWait(com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands.EVENT_ACTION);

                for (Event event : Event.values()) {
                    builder.clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                           .append(new DeleteAllAction(10))
                           .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true);
                }

                SequenceManager.startAction(builder.closeAll().get());
                MessageUtils.debugToChat("Nuking housing.");
            }
        ));
        return 1;
    }

                SequenceManager.cancelAction();

    public static void setLastRunScript(Path p) { lastRunScript = p; }

    public static Path getScriptsDir() {
        Path dir = Minecraft.getInstance().gameDirectory.toPath().resolve("neohouse-scripts");
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) {
            try {
                Files.createDirectories(dir);
            } catch (IOException ignored) {}
        }
        return dir;
    }

    private static String buildItemLiteral(String id, String customName, int count) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("{ id = \"").append(id).append("\"");
        if (customName != null) {
            sb.append(", name = \"").append(customName.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")).append("\"");
        }
        if (count != 1) {
            sb.append(", count = ").append(count);
        }
        sb.append(" }");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static Path resolveScriptPath(String raw) {
        String s = raw.trim();
        if ((s.startsWith("\"") && s.endsWith("\"")) || (s.startsWith("'") && s.endsWith("'"))) {
            s = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        }

        // auto-add .nh if no extension
        if (!s.contains(".")) s = s + ".nh";

        Path p = Paths.get(s);
        if (!p.isAbsolute()) {
            p = getScriptsDir().resolve(p);
        }

        String name = p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (!name.endsWith(".nh")) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Unsupported extension '" + name + "' — only .nh files are supported.");
            return null;
        }
        if (!Files.exists(p)) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Script not found: " + p);
            return null;
        }
        return p;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.BinaryOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

public class BinaryExpressionNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final BinaryOperator operator;
    public final NormalExpressionNode left;
    public final NormalExpressionNode right;

    public BinaryExpressionNode(final NormalExpressionNode left, final NormalExpressionNode right, final BinaryOperator operator, VariableType type, final Token token) {
        super(type);
        this.left = left;
        this.right = right;
        this.operator = operator;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitBinaryExpr(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "BinaryExpressionNode[operator=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", left=" + left + ", right=" + right + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "BExpr[op=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", l=" + left.toShortString() + ", r=" + right.toShortString() + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class ConstantNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final ConstantValue value;

    public ConstantNode(final ConstantValue value, VariableType type, final Token token) {
        super(type);
        this.value = value;
        this.token = token;

        if (value instanceof StringValue str) {
            if (str.value.length() > 256) {
                throw new SemanticException(token, "The constant '" + str.value + "' is too long.");
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitConstant(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "ConstantNode[value=" + value + ", type=" + type + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Const[v=" + value.toShortString() + ", type=" + type + "]";
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.constants;

import java.util.List;

public final class DoubleArrayValue implements ConstantArray {
    public final List<Double> value;
    public DoubleArrayValue(final List<Double> value) { this.value = List.copyOf(value); }
    public Object getValue() { return value; }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(value.get(i).toString());
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.size(); i++) {
            double v = value.get(i);
            ret.append(String.format("%.2f", v));
            if (i < value.size() - 1) ret.append(",");
        }
        return ret.toString();
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\expr\LogicalExpressionNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.LogicalOperator;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class LogicalExpressionNode extends ConditionExpressionNode {
    public final LogicalOperator operator;
    public final List<ExpressionNode> conditions;

    public LogicalExpressionNode(final List<ExpressionNode> conditions, final LogicalOperator operator, final Token token) {
        super(VariableType.BOOL);
        if (conditions == null || conditions.isEmpty())
            this.conditions = new ArrayList<>();
        else
            this.conditions = new ArrayList<>(conditions);

        this.operator = operator;
        this.token = token;
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitLogicalExpr(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder("LogicalExpressionNode[operator=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", conditions=[");
        for (int i = 0; i < conditions.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(conditions.get(i).toString());
            if (i < conditions.size() - 1)
                ret.append(", ");
        }
        ret.append("]]");
        return ret.toString();
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder("LExpr[op=" + operator + ", type=" + type + ", conds=[");
        for (int i = 0; i < conditions.size(); i++) {
            ret.append(conditions.get(i).toShortString());
            if (i < conditions.size() - 1)
                ret.append(", ");
        }
        ret.append("]]");
        return ret.toString();
    }
}

```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.var;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.expr.NormalExpressionNode;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Holder;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.SemanticException;

public class VariableNode extends NormalExpressionNode {
    public final Holder holder;
    public final String name;
    public final String teamName;

    public VariableNode(final VariableType type, final Holder holder, final String name, final String teamName, final Token token) {
        super(type);

        this.type = type;
        this.holder = holder;
        this.name = name;
        this.teamName = teamName;
        this.token = token;

        if (name.length() > 16)
            throw new SemanticException(token, "The variable named '" + name + "' is too long.");
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitVariable(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "VariableNode[type=" + type + ", holder=" + holder + ", name=" + name + ", teamName=" + teamName + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "Var[type=" + type + ", hold=" + holder + ", name=" + name + ", tname=" + teamName + "]";
    }
}

```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\compiler\ast\main\StatementListNode.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ast.main;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.helpers.StringHelper;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.visitors.ASTVisitor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class StatementListNode extends StatementNode {
    public List<StatementNode> statements;

    public StatementListNode(final List<StatementNode> statements) {
        this.statements = new ArrayList<>();
        if (statements == null) return;

        for (StatementNode statement : statements) {
            if (statement instanceof StatementListNode s)
                this.statements.addAll(s.statements);
            else
                this.statements.add(statement);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public <T> T accept(ASTVisitor<T> visitor) {
        return visitor.visitStatements(this);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "StatementListNode[statements=" + statements + "]";
    }

    @Override
    public String toShortString() {
        return "StmtList[stmts=" + StringHelper.nodeListToString(statements) + "]";
    }
}

```
