```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.constants;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Param;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.actions.*;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/******************\
 *   ADD ACTION   *
\******************/

public enum AddAction {
    CONDITIONAL(25, false, "_", List.of(), "", "redstone", "Conditional"),
    CANCEL_EVENT(1,  false, "_", List.of(), "", "tnt", "Cancel Event"),
    CHANGE_GROUP(1, true, "setGroup",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(PlayerGroupInputs.GROUP), Param.BOOL.withName(PlayerGroupInputs.DEMOTION_PROTECTION)),
            "Sets the player's group/rank. demote=true allows lower rank.", "player_head", "Change Player's Group"),
    KILL(1, true, "kill", List.of(),
            "Kills the player instantly.", "iron_bars", "Kill Player"),
    FULL_HEAL(5, true, "heal", List.of(),
            "Fully restores the player's health and hunger.", "golden_apple", "Full Heal"),
    TITLE(5, true, "title",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(TitleInputs.TITLE), Param.STRING.withName(TitleInputs.SUBTITLE), Param.longRange(0, 3).withName(TitleInputs.FADEIN), Param.longRange(0, 10).withName(TitleInputs.STAY), Param.longRange(0, 3).withName(TitleInputs.FADEOUT)),
            "Shows title/subtitle. fadeIn, stay, fadeOut are in ticks.", "book", "Display Title"),
    ACTION_BAR(5, true, "actionBar",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(ActionBarInputs.MESSAGE)),
            "Displays a message in the player's action bar.", "writable_book", "Display Action Bar"),
    CLEAR_INVENTORY(1, true, "clearInventory", List.of(),
            "Removes all items from the player's inventory.", "stone", "Reset Inventory"),
    MAX_HEALTH(5, true, "setMaxHealth",
            List.of(Param.EXPR.withName(MaxHealthInputs.MAX_HEALTH), Param.enumOf(RestrictedOperator.class).withName(MaxHealthInputs.MODE), Param.BOOL.withName(MaxHealthInputs.HEAL_ON_CHANGE)),
            "Changes max health. Operator: SET/ADD/MULTIPLY. heal=true heals to new max.", "dandelion", "Change Max Health"),
    PARKOUR_CHECKPOINT(1, true, "triggerParkourCheckpoint", List.of(),
            "Sets the player's current position as a parkour checkpoint.", "light_weighted_pressure_plate", "Parkour Checkpoint"),
    GIVE_ITEM(40, true, "giveItem",
            List.of(Param.ITEM.withName(GiveItemInputs.ITEM), Param.BOOL.withName(GiveItemInputs.ALLOW_MULTIPLE), Param.enumOf(InventorySlots.class).withName(GiveItemInputs.INVENTORY_SLOT), Param.BOOL.withName(GiveItemInputs.REPLACE_ITEM)),
            "Gives an item to the player. Args: item literal, allowMultiple, targetSlot, replace.", "chest", "Give Item"),
    REMOVE_ITEM(40, true, "removeItem",
            List.of(Param.ITEM.withName(RemoveItemInputs.ITEM)),
            "Removes an item from the player's inventory.", "cauldron", "Remove Item"),
    CHAT_MESSAGE(20, true, "message",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(ChatMessageInputs.MESSAGE)),
            "Sends a chat message to the player.", "map", "Send a Chat Message"),
    APPLY_POTION(22, true, "applyPotion",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Potion.class).withName(ApplyPotionInputs.EFFECT), Param.longRange(1, 2_592_000).withName(ApplyPotionInputs.DURATION), Param.longRange(1, 10).withName(ApplyPotionInputs.LEVEL), Param.BOOL.withName(ApplyPotionInputs.OVERRIDE), Param.BOOL.withName(ApplyPotionInputs.SHOW_ICON)),
            "Applies a potion. Args: type, duration, amplifier, ambient, showParticles.", "potion", "Apply Potion Effect"),
    CLEAR_POTION(5, true, "clearPotion", List.of(),
            "Removes all active potion effects from the player.", "glass_bottle", "Clear All Potion Effects"),
    GIVE_XP(5, true, "giveXp",
            List.of(Param.longRange(1, Integer.MAX_VALUE).withName(GiveExperienceInputs.LEVELS)),
            "Awards XP levels to the player.", "experience_bottle", "Give Experience Levels"),
    SEND_LOBBY(1, true, "sendLobby",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Lobby.class).withName(SendLobbyInputs.LOCATION)),
            "Sends the player to a Hypixel lobby.", "bookshelf", "Send to Lobby"),
    VARIABLE(25, false, "_", List.of(), "", "feather", "Change Variable"),
    TELEPORT(5, true, "teleport",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(TeleportInputs.LOCATION), Param.BOOL.withName(TeleportInputs.PREVENT_TELEPORT_INSIDE_BLOCKS)),
            "Teleports the player to a named location or custom coords.", "ender_pearl", "Teleport Player"),
    FAIL_PARKOUR(1, true, "failParkour",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(FailParkourInputs.REASON)),
            "Fails the player's current parkour run with a reason message.", "light_weighted_pressure_plate", "Fail Parkour"),
    PLAY_SOUND(25, true, "playSound",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Sound.class).withName(PlaySoundInputs.SOUND), Param.doubleRange(0D, 2D).withName(PlaySoundInputs.VOLUME), Param.doubleRange(0D, 2D).withName(PlaySoundInputs.PITCH), Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(PlaySoundInputs.LOCATION)),
            "Plays a sound. Args: sound, volume, pitch, location.", "note_block", "Play Sound"),
    COMPASS_TARGET(5, true, "setCompassTarget",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(CompassTargetInputs.LOCATION)),
            "Points the player's compass at a named location.", "compass", "Set Compass Target"),
    SET_GAME_MODE(1, true, "setGamemode",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Gamemode.class).withName(GamemodeInputs.GAMEMODE)),
            "Changes the player's game mode (SURVIVAL/CREATIVE/ADVENTURE/SPECTATOR).", "daylight_detector", "Set Gamemode"),
    CHANGE_HEALTH(5, true, "setHealth",
            List.of(Param.EXPR.withName(HealthInputs.HEALTH), Param.enumOf(RestrictedOperator.class).withName(HealthInputs.MODE)),
            "Changes the player's health. Operators: SET/ADD/MULTIPLY.", "apple", "Change Health"),
    CHANGE_HUNGER(5, true, "setHunger",
            List.of(Param.EXPR.withName(HungerInputs.LEVEL), Param.enumOf(RestrictedOperator.class).withName(HungerInputs.MODE)),
            "Changes the player's hunger level. Operators: SET/ADD/MULTIPLY.", "cooked_beef", "Change Hunger Level"),
    RANDOM(25, false, "_", List.of(), "", "ender_chest", "Random Action"),
    TRIGGER_FUNCTION(10, false, "_", List.of(), "", "activator_rail", "Trigger Function"),
    APPLY_LAYOUT(5, true, "applyLayout",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(LayoutInputs.LAYOUT)),
            "Applies a saved inventory layout to the player.", "iron_axe", "Apply Inventory Layout"),
    EXIT(1, false, "_", List.of(), "", "bedrock", "Exit"),
    ENCHANT_HELD_ITEM(25, true, "enchantItem",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Enchant.class).withName(EnchantHeldInputs.ENCHANTMENT), Param.longRange(1, 10).withName(EnchantHeldInputs.LEVEL)),
            "Enchants the held item. Args: enchantment name, level.", "enchanted_book", "Enchant Held Item"),
    PAUSE(30, true, "pause",
            List.of(Param.longRange(1, 6_000).withName(PauseInputs.TICKS)),
            "Pauses execution of this function for N ticks.", "red_bed", "Pause Execution"),
    SET_TEAM(1, true, "setTeam",
            List.of(Param.STRING.withName(TeamInputs.TEAM)),
            "Assigns the player to a named team.", "oak_sign", "Set Player Team"),
    DISPLAY_MENU(10, true, "displayMenu",
                 List.of(Param.STRING.withName(DisplayMenuInputs.MENU)),
                 "Opens a housing inventory menu for the player.", "chest", "Display Menu"),
    CLOSE_MENU(1, true, "closeMenu", List.of(),
                 "Closes the current menu.", "chest", "Close Menu"),
    DROP_ITEM(5, true, "dropItem",
            List.of(Param.ITEM.withName(DropItemInputs.ITEM), Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(DropItemInputs.LOCATION), Param.BOOL.withName(DropItemInputs.DROP_NATURALLY), Param.BOOL.withName(DropItemInputs.PREVENT_MERGE), Param.longRange(1, 18_000).withName(DropItemInputs.DESPAWN_DURATION), Param.longRange(0, 18_000).withName(DropItemInputs.PICKUP_DELAY), Param.BOOL.withName(DropItemInputs.PRIORITIZE_PLAYER), Param.BOOL.withName(DropItemInputs.FALLBACK_INVENTORY)),
            "Drops an item at a location.", "dropper", "Drop Item"),
    CHANGE_VELOCITY(5, true, "changeVelocity",
            List.of(Param.EXPR.withName(ChangeVelocityInputs.X_DIRECTION), Param.EXPR.withName(ChangeVelocityInputs.Y_DIRECTION), Param.EXPR.withName(ChangeVelocityInputs.Z_DIRECTION)),
            "Sets the player's velocity vector (x, y, z).", "slime_block", "Change Velocity"),
    LAUNCH_TO_TARGET(5, true, "launchToTarget",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Teleport.class).withName(LaunchTargetInputs.TARGET_LOCATION), Param.EXPR.withName(LaunchTargetInputs.STRENGTH)),
            "Launches the player toward a target location at a given speed.", "slime_ball", "Launch to Target"),
    SET_WEATHER(5, true, "setWeather",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Weather.class).withName(SetWeatherInputs.WEATHER)),
            "Sets the housing weather.", "water_bucket", "Set Player Weather"),
    SET_TIME(5, true, "setTime",
            List.of(Param.enumOf(Time.class).withName(SetTimeInputs.TIME)),
            "Sets the world time.", "clock", "Set Player Time"),
    NAME_TAG_DISPLAY(5, true, "setNameTagDisplay",
            List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(NameTagInputs.DISPLAY)),
            "Shows or hides the player's name tag above their head.", "name_tag", "Toggle Nametag Display");

    public final int maxCount;
    public final boolean canBeUsed;
    public final String name;
    public final List<Param> params;
    public final String description;
    public final ResourceLocation texture;
    public final String displayName;

    AddAction(int maxCount, boolean canBeUsed, String name, List<Param> params,
              String description, String textureId, String displayName) {
        this.maxCount = maxCount;
        this.canBeUsed = canBeUsed;
        this.name = name;
        this.params = params;
        this.description = description;
        this.texture = ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace(textureId);
        this.displayName = displayName;
    }

    public static final Map<String, AddAction> BY_NAME = Arrays.stream(values())
            .filter(a -> a.canBeUsed)
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(a -> a.name, Function.identity()));

    public static AddAction searchByName(String name) { return BY_NAME.get(name); }

    public static AddAction requireByName(String name) {
        AddAction a = BY_NAME.get(name);
        if (a == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown AddAction name: " + name);
        return a;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.constants;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.Param;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.conditions.*;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/*********************\
 *   ADD CONDITION   *
 \********************/

public enum AddCondition {
    PORTAL_TYPE(true, "inPortalType",
                List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(PortalTypeInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(PortalType.class).withName(PortalTypeInputs.PORTAL_TYPE)),
                "True if the player is in the given portal type.", "end_portal_frame", "Portal Type"),
    PVP_ENABLED(true, "isPvpEnabled",
                List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(PvpEnabledInputs.INVERT)),
                "True if PvP is currently enabled in the housing.", "iron_sword", "PvP Enabled"),
    DAMAGE_CAUSE(true, "isDamageCause",
                 List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(DamageCauseInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(DamageCause.class).withName(DamageCauseInputs.CAUSE)),
                 "True if the damage cause matches the given value.", "diamond_sword", "Damage Cause"),
    DAMAGE_AMOUNT(true, "isDamageAmount",
                  List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(DamageAmountInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Comparator.class).withName(DamageAmountInputs.COMPARATOR), Param.EXPR.withName(DamageAmountInputs.COMPARE_VALUE)),
                  "True if the damage amount matches the comparator.", "golden_sword", "Damage Amount"),
    BLOCK_TYPE(true, "isBlockType",
               List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(BlockTypeInputs.INVERT), Param.ITEM.withName(BlockTypeInputs.ITEM), Param.BOOL.withName(BlockTypeInputs.MATCH_TYPE_ONLY)),
               "True if the broken block matches the given type.", "grass_block", "Block Type"),
    IS_ITEM(true, "isItem",
            List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(IsItemInputs.INVERT), Param.ITEM.withName(IsItemInputs.ITEM), Param.enumOf(WhatCheck.class).withName(IsItemInputs.WHAT_TO_CHECK), Param.enumOf(WhereCheck.class).withName(IsItemInputs.WHERE_TO_CHECK), Param.enumOf(AmountCheck.class).withName(IsItemInputs.REQUIRED_AMOUNT)),
            "True if the item matches the criteria.", "chest", "Is Item"),
    FISHING_ENVIRONMENT(true, "isFishingEnvironment",
                        List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(FishingEnvironmentInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(FishingEnvironment.class).withName(FishingEnvironmentInputs.ENVIRONMENT)),
                        "True if the player is fishing in the given environment.", "water_bucket", "Fishing Environment"),
    GROUP(true, "isGroup",
          List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(GroupInputs.INVERT), Param.STRING.withName(GroupInputs.REQUIRED_GROUP), Param.BOOL.withName(GroupInputs.INCLUDE_HIGHER)),
          "True if the player is in the given group.", "player_head", "Required Group"),
    VARIABLE(false, "_", List.of(), "", "feather", "Variable Requirement"),
    PERMISSION(true, "hasPermission",
               List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(PermissionInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Permission.class).withName(PermissionInputs.PERMISSION)),
               "True if the player has the given permission.", "filled_map", "Required Permission"),
    REGION(true, "inRegion",
           List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(RegionInputs.INVERT), Param.STRING.withName(RegionInputs.REGION)),
           "True if the player is inside the named region.", "grass_block", "Within Region"),
    HAS_ITEM(true, "hasItem",
             List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(HasItemInputs.INVERT), Param.ITEM.withName(HasItemInputs.ITEM), Param.enumOf(WhatCheck.class).withName(HasItemInputs.WHAT_TO_CHECK), Param.enumOf(WhereCheck.class).withName(HasItemInputs.WHERE_TO_CHECK), Param.enumOf(AmountCheck.class).withName(HasItemInputs.REQUIRED_AMOUNT)),
             "True if the player has an item matching criteria in their inventory.", "chest", "Has Item"),
    DOING_PARKOUR(true, "doingParkour",
                  List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(DoingParkourInputs.INVERT)),
                  "True if the player is currently on a parkour run.", "light_weighted_pressure_plate", "Doing Parkour"),
    POTION(true, "hasPotion",
           List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(EffectInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Potion.class).withName(EffectInputs.EFFECT)),
           "True if the player has the given potion effect active.", "potion", "Has Potion Effect"),
    SNEAKING(true, "isSneaking",
             List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(SneakingInputs.INVERT)),
             "True if the player is currently sneaking.", "hay_block", "Player Sneaking"),
    FLYING(true, "isFlying",
           List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(FlyingInputs.INVERT)),
           "True if the player is currently flying.", "feather", "Player Flying"),
    HEALTH(true, "hasHealth",
           List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(HealthInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Comparator.class).withName(HealthInputs.COMPARATOR), Param.EXPR.withName(HealthInputs.COMPARE_VALUE)),
           "True if the player's health matches the comparator.", "apple", "Player Health"),
    MAX_HEALTH(true, "hasMaxHealth",
               List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(MaxHealthInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Comparator.class).withName(MaxHealthInputs.COMPARATOR), Param.EXPR.withName(MaxHealthInputs.COMPARE_VALUE)),
               "True if the player's max health matches the comparator.", "golden_apple", "Max Player Health"),
    HUNGER(true, "hasHunger",
           List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(HungerInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Comparator.class).withName(HungerInputs.COMPARATOR), Param.EXPR.withName(HungerInputs.COMPARE_VALUE)),
           "True if the player's hunger matches the comparator.", "cooked_beef", "Player Hunger"),
    GAME_MODE(true, "hasGamemode",
              List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(GamemodeInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Gamemode.class).withName(GamemodeInputs.GAMEMODE)),
              "True if the player is in the given game mode.", "daylight_detector", "Required Gamemode"),
    PLACEHOLDER(false, "_", List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(PlaceholderInputs.INVERT), Param.enumOf(Placeholder.class).withName(PlaceholderInputs.PLACEHOLDER), Param.enumOf(Comparator.class).withName(PlaceholderInputs.COMPARATOR), Param.EXPR.withName(PlaceholderInputs.COMPARE_VALUE)), "", "sign", "Placeholder Number Requirement"),
    TEAM(true, "hasTeam",
         List.of(Param.BOOL.withName(TeamInputs.INVERT), Param.STRING.withName(TeamInputs.REQUIRED_TEAM)),
         "True if the player is in the given team.", "player_head", "Required Team");

    public static final Map<String, AddCondition> BY_NAME = Arrays.stream(values())
                                                                  .filter(a -> a.canBeUsed)
                                                                  .collect(Collectors.toMap(a -> a.name, Function.identity()));
    public final boolean canBeUsed;
    public final String name;
    public final List<Param> params;
    public final String description;
    public final ResourceLocation texture;
    public final String displayName;

    AddCondition(boolean canBeUsed, String name, List<Param> params,
                 String description, String textureId, String displayName) {
        this.canBeUsed = canBeUsed;
        this.name = name;
        this.params = params;
        this.description = description;
        this.texture = ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace(textureId);
        this.displayName = displayName;
    }

    public static AddCondition searchByName(String name) {
        return BY_NAME.get(name);
    }

    public static AddCondition requireByName(String name) {
        AddCondition a = BY_NAME.get(name);
        if (a == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown AddCondition name: " + name);
        return a;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\constants\Event.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.constants;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.PageSlot;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public enum Event {
    JOIN("onJoin",               new PageSlot(0, 10), "Fires when a player joins the housing.",                     "oak_door"),
    QUIT("onQuit",               new PageSlot(0, 11), "Fires when a player leaves the housing.",                    "dark_oak_door"),
    DEATH("onDeath",             new PageSlot(0, 12), "Fires when the player dies.",                                "bone"),
    KILL("onKill",               new PageSlot(0, 13), "Fires when the player kills another player.",                "diamond_sword"),
    RESPAWN("onRespawn",         new PageSlot(0, 14), "Fires when the player respawns after death.",                "apple"),
    GROUP_CHANGE("onGroupChange",      new PageSlot(0, 15), "Fires when the player's group/rank changes.",          "paper"),
    PVP_STATE_CHANGE("onPvpStateChange", new PageSlot(0, 16), "Fires when PvP is toggled on or off.",              "iron_sword"),
    FISH_CAUGHT("onFishCaught",        new PageSlot(0, 19), "Fires when the player catches a fish.",               "fishing_rod"),
    ENTER_PORTAL("onEnterPortal",      new PageSlot(0, 20), "Fires when the player enters a portal.",              "obsidian"),
    DAMAGE("onDamage",           new PageSlot(0, 21), "Fires when the player takes any damage.",                    "lava_bucket"),
    BLOCK_BREAK("onBlockBreak",        new PageSlot(0, 22), "Fires when the player breaks a block.",               "grass_block"),
    START_PARKOUR("onStartParkour",    new PageSlot(0, 23), "Fires when the player starts a parkour run.",         "light_weighted_pressure_plate"),
    END_PARKOUR("onEndParkour",        new PageSlot(0, 24), "Fires when the player completes a parkour run.",      "light_weighted_pressure_plate"),
    DROP_ITEM("onDropItem",            new PageSlot(0, 25), "Fires when the player drops an item.",                "dropper"),
    PICK_UP_ITEM("onPickUpItem",       new PageSlot(0, 28), "Fires when the player picks up an item.",             "hopper"),
    CHANGE_HELD_ITEM("onChangeHeldItem", new PageSlot(0, 29), "Fires when the player's held item slot changes.",   "book"),
    TOGGLE_SNEAK("onToggleSneak",      new PageSlot(0, 30), "Fires when the player starts or stops sneaking.",     "hay_block"),
    TOGGLE_FLIGHT("onToggleFlight",    new PageSlot(0, 31), "Fires when the player starts or stops flying.",       "feather");

    public final String name;
    public final PageSlot pageSlot;
    public final String description;
    public final ResourceLocation texture;

    Event(String name, PageSlot pageSlot, String description, String textureId) {
        this.name = name;
        this.pageSlot = pageSlot;
        this.description = description;
        this.texture = ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace(textureId);
    }

    private static final Map<String, Event> BY_NAME = Arrays.stream(values())
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(e -> e.name, Function.identity()));

    public static Event fromName(String name) { return BY_NAME.get(name); }

    public int getPage()   { return this.pageSlot.page; }
    public int getSlotID() { return this.pageSlot.slotID; }
}

```

```java
    DATE_MINUTE_TIMEZONE("dateMinuteTimezone",VariableType.LONG,List.of(VariableType.STRING),"date.minute.timezone","Minute in the given timezone."),
    DATE_SECONDS_TIMEZONE("dateSecondsTimezone",VariableType.LONG,List.of(VariableType.STRING),"date.seconds.timezone","Seconds in the given timezone."),
    DATE_UNIX("dateUnix",               VariableType.LONG,   List.of(), "date.unix",              "Current Unix timestamp in seconds."),
    DATE_UNIX_MS("dateUnixMs",          VariableType.LONG,   List.of(), "date.unix.ms",           "Current Unix timestamp in milliseconds."),
    RANDOM_WHOLE("randomWhole",         VariableType.LONG,   List.of(), "random.whole",           "A random whole number (full range)."),
    RANDOM_WHOLE_CAPPED("randomWholeCapped",VariableType.LONG,List.of(VariableType.LONG),"random.whole","Random integer from 0 to max. Input: max."),
    RANDOM_WHOLE_RANGED("randomWholeRanged",VariableType.LONG,List.of(VariableType.LONG,VariableType.LONG),"random.whole","Random integer in [min, max]. Inputs: min, max."),
    RANDOM_DECIMAL("randomDecimal",     VariableType.DOUBLE, List.of(), "random.decimal",         "A random decimal between 0.0 and 1.0."),
    RANDOM_DECIMAL_CAPPED("randomDecimalCapped",VariableType.DOUBLE,List.of(VariableType.DOUBLE),"random.decimal","Random decimal 0.0 to max. Input: max."),
    RANDOM_DECIMAL_RANGED("randomDecimalRanged",VariableType.DOUBLE,List.of(VariableType.DOUBLE,VariableType.DOUBLE),"random.decimal","Random decimal in [min, max]. Inputs: min, max.");

    public final String name;
    public final VariableType type;
    public final List<VariableType> constTypes;
    public final String inGameName;
    public final String description;

    Placeholder(String name, VariableType type, List<VariableType> constTypes,
                String inGameName, String description) {
        this.name = name;
        this.type = type;
        this.constTypes = constTypes;
        this.inGameName = inGameName;
        this.description = description;
    }

    public static final Map<String, Placeholder> BY_NAME = Arrays.stream(values())
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(a -> a.name, Function.identity()));

    public static Placeholder searchByName(String name) { return BY_NAME.get(name); }

    public static Placeholder requireByName(String name) {
        Placeholder a = BY_NAME.get(name);
        if (a == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Placeholder name: " + name);
        return a;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.constants;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public enum RestrictionAction {
    NONE              (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    CONDITIONAL       (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),

    MENU              (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.EXIT)),
    MENU_CONDITIONAL  (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.RANDOM)),

    EVENT_JOIN             (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_QUIT             (onlyAllow(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.VARIABLE, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.TRIGGER_FUNCTION, AddAction.PAUSE)),
    EVENT_DEATH            (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_KILL             (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_RESPAWN          (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_GROUP_CHANGE     (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.CHANGE_GROUP, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_PVP_STATE_CHANGE (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_FISH_CAUGHT      (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_ENTER_PORTAL     (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_DAMAGE           (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_BLOCK_BREAK      (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_START_PARKOUR    (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_END_PARKOUR      (block(AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_DROP_ITEM        (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_PICK_UP_ITEM     (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CHANGE_HELD_ITEM (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_TOGGLE_SNEAK     (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_TOGGLE_FLIGHT    (block(AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),

    EVENT_CONDITION_JOIN             (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_QUIT             (onlyAllow(AddAction.VARIABLE, AddAction.TRIGGER_FUNCTION, AddAction.EXIT, AddAction.PAUSE)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_DEATH            (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_KILL             (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_RESPAWN          (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_GROUP_CHANGE     (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.CHANGE_GROUP, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_PVP_STATE_CHANGE (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_FISH_CAUGHT      (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_ENTER_PORTAL     (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_DAMAGE           (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_BLOCK_BREAK      (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_START_PARKOUR    (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_END_PARKOUR      (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.CANCEL_EVENT, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_DROP_ITEM        (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_PICK_UP_ITEM     (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_CHANGE_HELD_ITEM (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_TOGGLE_SNEAK     (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU)),
    EVENT_CONDITION_TOGGLE_FLIGHT    (block(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, AddAction.KILL, AddAction.SEND_LOBBY, AddAction.RANDOM, AddAction.CLOSE_MENU));

    private final Set<AddAction> blockedActions;

    RestrictionAction(Set<AddAction> blockedActions) {
        this.blockedActions = blockedActions;
    }

    public boolean isAllowed(AddAction action) {
        return !blockedActions.contains(action);
    }

    public RestrictionAction conditionalVariant() {
        String n = name();
        if (n.startsWith("EVENT_") && !n.startsWith("EVENT_CONDITION_")) {
            return RestrictionAction.valueOf(n.replace("EVENT_", "EVENT_CONDITION_"));
        }
        if (this == MENU) return MENU_CONDITIONAL;
        return CONDITIONAL;
    }

    public RestrictionCondition conditionContext() {
        String n = name();
        if (n.startsWith("EVENT_CONDITION_")) n = n.replace("EVENT_CONDITION_", "EVENT_");
        try {
            return RestrictionCondition.valueOf(n);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return RestrictionCondition.NONE;
        }
    }

    private static Set<AddAction> block(AddAction... actions) {
        return Set.of(actions);
    }

    private static Set<AddAction> onlyAllow(AddAction... allowed) {
        Set<AddAction> allowedSet = Set.of(allowed);
        return Arrays.stream(AddAction.values())
                .filter(a -> !allowedSet.contains(a))
                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet());
    }
}
```

```java
    private final List<AddCondition> allowedConditions;
    RestrictionCondition(List<AddCondition> allowedConditions) {
        this.allowedConditions = allowedConditions;
    }

    public boolean isAllowed(AddCondition condition) {
        return allowedConditions.contains(condition);
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\exceptions\CompilingException.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.lexer.Token;

public class CompilingException extends RuntimeException {
    public final Token errorToken;

    public CompilingException(Token token, String message) {
        super(token == null ? message : "An error occurred while compiling at '" + token.text + "', at line " + token.line + " & col " + token.column + ": " + message + "\n" + token.lineContent + "\n" + arrowText(token));
        this.errorToken = token;
    }

    private static String arrowText(Token token) {
        int indent = token.column - token.text.length() - 1;
        int length = token.text.length();
        if (indent < 0) indent = 0;
        return " ".repeat(indent) + "^".repeat(length);
    }
}

```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\factories\ActionFactory.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.factories;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.actions.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;


public class ActionFactory {

    public static Action addActionConditional(RestrictionAction state, boolean matchAny, Action conditions, Action ifs, Action elses, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddAction.CONDITIONAL)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add action 'Conditional' here.");

        return new ActionBuilder()
                .addAction(AddAction.CONDITIONAL, state)
                .onlyIf(matchAny, () ->  new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(ConditionInputs.MATCH_ANY)
                )
                .onlyIf(conditions != null, () ->  new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(ConditionInputs.CONDITIONS)
                        .append(conditions)
                        .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true)
                )
                .onlyIf(ifs != null, () ->  new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(ConditionInputs.IF)
                        .append(ifs)
                        .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true)
                )
                .onlyIf(elses != null, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(ConditionInputs.ELSE)
                        .append(elses)
                        .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H6, true)
                )
                .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
                )
                .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
                .get();
    }

    public static Action addActionChangeGroup(RestrictionAction state, String groupName, boolean demotionProtection, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddAction.CHANGE_GROUP)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add action 'Change Group' here.");

        return new ActionBuilder()
                .addAction(AddAction.CHANGE_GROUP, state)

    public static Action addActionTitle(RestrictionAction state, String title, String subtitle, int fadeIn, int stay, int fadeOut, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddAction.TITLE)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add action 'Title' here.");

        if (subtitle == null || subtitle.trim().isEmpty()) finalSubTitle = "&l";
        else finalSubTitle = subtitle;

                .addAction(AddAction.TITLE, state)
                .onlyIf(!finalTitle.equals("Hello World!"), () -> new ActionBuilder()

                .onlyIf(fadeOut != 1, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .searchForAnvil(TitleInputs.FADEOUT, String.valueOf(fadeOut))
                )
                .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
                )
                .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
                .get();
    }

    public static Action addActionVariable(RestrictionAction state, Holder holder, String variable, String teamName, Operator operator, String value, boolean automaticUnset, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddAction.VARIABLE)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add action 'Variable' here.");

        return new ActionBuilder()
            .addAction(AddAction.VARIABLE, state)
            .onlyIf(holder == Holder.GLOBAL, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                .search(SetVariableInputs.HOLDER)
            )
            .onlyIf(holder == Holder.TEAM, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .search(SetVariableInputs.HOLDER)
                    .search(SetVariableInputs.HOLDER)
            )
            .onlyIf(holder == Holder.TEAM && teamName != null && !teamName.trim().isEmpty() && !teamName.equals("None"), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .search(SetVariableInputs.TEAM)
                    .search(teamName)
            )
            .onlyIf(!variable.equals("Kills"), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .searchForChat(SetVariableInputs.VARIABLE, variable)
            )
            .onlyIf(operator != Operator.INCREMENT, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .search(SetVariableInputs.OPERATION)
                    .search(operator.displayName, null, true, null,
                            operator.requiresToggle ? new ActionBuilder()
                                    .search(Operator.ADVANCED_OPERATIONS.displayName)
                                    .search(operator.displayName) : null)
            )
            .onlyIf(!value.equals("1"), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .searchForAnvil(SetVariableInputs.VALUE, value)
            )
            .onlyIf(automaticUnset, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .search(SetVariableInputs.AUTOMATIC_UNSET)
            )
            .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                    .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
            )
            .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
            .get();
    }

                .onlyIf(!dropNaturally, () -> new ActionBuilder()

                .onlyIf(fallbackToInventory, () -> new ActionBuilder()
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.factories;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;

public class ConditionFactory {
    public static Action addConditionGroup(RestrictionCondition state, boolean invert, String group, boolean includeHigherGroups, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddCondition.GROUP)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add condition 'Group' here.");

        return new ActionBuilder()
                .addCondition(AddCondition.GROUP, state)
                .onlyIf(invert, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(GroupInputs.INVERT)
                )
                .onlyIf(group != null, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(GroupInputs.REQUIRED_GROUP)
                        .search(group)
                )
                .onlyIf(includeHigherGroups, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(GroupInputs.INCLUDE_HIGHER)
                )
                .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
                )
                .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
                .get();
    }

    public static Action addConditionVariable(RestrictionCondition state, boolean invert, Holder holder, String teamName, String variable, Comparator comparator, String value, String fallback, String note) {
        if (!state.isAllowed(AddCondition.VARIABLE)) throw new InterruptActionException("Cannot add condition 'Variable' here.");

        return new ActionBuilder()
                .addCondition(AddCondition.VARIABLE, state)
                .onlyIf(invert, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(VariableInputs.INVERT)
                )
                .onlyIf(holder == Holder.GLOBAL, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(VariableInputs.HOLDER)
                )
                .onlyIf(holder == Holder.TEAM, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(VariableInputs.HOLDER)
                        .search(VariableInputs.HOLDER)
                        .onlyIf(teamName != null && !teamName.equals("None"), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .search(VariableInputs.TEAM)
                                .search(teamName)
                        )
                )
                .onlyIf(variable != null && !variable.trim().isEmpty() && !variable.equals("Kills"), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .searchForChat(VariableInputs.VARIABLE, variable)
                )
                .onlyIf(comparator != null && comparator != Comparator.EQUAL, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(VariableInputs.COMPARATOR)
                        .search(comparator.displayName)
                )
                .onlyIf(value != null && !value.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .searchForAnvil(VariableInputs.COMPARE_VALUE, value)
                )
                .onlyIf(fallback != null && !fallback.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .searchForAnvil(VariableInputs.FALLBACK_VALUE, fallback)
                )
                .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
                )
                .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
                .get();

                .onlyIf(invert, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(IsItemInputs.INVERT)
                )
                .onlyIf(!snbtData.isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(IsItemInputs.ITEM)
                        .customItem(snbtData)
                )
                .onlyIf(whatCheck != null && whatCheck != WhatCheck.METADATA, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(IsItemInputs.WHAT_TO_CHECK)
                )
                .onlyIf(whereCheck != null && whereCheck != WhereCheck.ANYWHERE, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(IsItemInputs.WHERE_TO_CHECK)
                        .search(whereCheck.displayName)
                )
                .onlyIf(amountCheck != null && amountCheck != AmountCheck.ANY, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .search(IsItemInputs.REQUIRED_AMOUNT)
                )
                .onlyIf(note != null && !note.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .chatInput(note, Others.GENERAL_NOTE_H4)
                )
                .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_GO_BACK_H4, true)
                .get();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.factories;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Commands;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Event;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Others;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CommandInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CustomMenuInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.FunctionInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.ActionBuilder;

public class MovementFactory {
    public static Action goToFunction(boolean hasUIOpen, String name) {
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .onlyIf(hasUIOpen, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .closeAll()
                )
                .sendChatAndWait(Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                .search(name)
                .get();
    }

    public static Action goToEvent(Event event) {
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .closeAll()
                .sendChatAndWait(Commands.EVENT_ACTION)
                .clickSlotAndWait(event.getSlotID(), true)
                .get();
    }

    public static Action exit(boolean hasUIOpen) {
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .onlyIf(hasUIOpen, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .closeAll()
                )
                .get();
    }


    // Creates (or recreates) a command with the given settings, ending with an open screen.
    public static Action goAndRecreateCommand(String name, boolean targeted, int priority, boolean listed) {
        boolean needsConfigure = targeted || priority != 0 || !listed;
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .closeAll()
                .sendChatAndWait(Commands.COMMANDS)
                .removeCommandIfPresent(name)
                .anvilInput(name, Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6)
                .onlyIf(needsConfigure, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .gotoCommand(true, name, false)
                        .onlyIf(targeted, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .search(CommandInputs.MODE))
                        .onlyIf(priority != 0, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .signInput(CommandInputs.GROUP_PRIORITY, String.valueOf(priority)))
                        .onlyIf(!listed, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .search(CommandInputs.LISTED))
                )
                .get();
    }

    // Creates (or recreates) a custom menu with the given name and row count.
    public static Action goAndRecreateMenu(String name, int rows) {
        String rowsLabel = rows == 1 ? "1 Row" : rows + " Rows";
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .closeAll()
                .sendChatAndWait(Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS)
                .removeMenuIfPresent(name)
                .anvilInput(name, Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6)
                .onlyIf(rows != 1, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .gotoCustomMenu(name, true)
                        .search(CustomMenuInputs.CHANGE_SIZE)
                        .search(rowsLabel)
                )
                .get();
    }

    // Navigates to a menu's slot editing grid (Edit Menu Elements screen).
    public static Action goToMenuGrid(String menuName) {
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .gotoCustomMenu(menuName, true)
                .search(CustomMenuInputs.EDIT_ELEMENTS)
                .get();
    }

    // Goes to and deletes the function (if any) and recreates it.
    public static Action goAndRecreateFunction(String functionName, String description, Integer iconItemID, boolean automaticExecution, int loopTime) {
        return new ActionBuilder()
                .closeAll()
                .sendChatAndWait(Commands.FUNCTIONS)
                .removeFunctionIfPresent(functionName)
                .anvilInput(functionName, Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6)
                .onlyIf((description != null && !description.trim().isEmpty()) || iconItemID != null || automaticExecution, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                        .gotoFunction(true, functionName, false)
                        .onlyIf(description != null && !description.trim().isEmpty(), () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .searchForChat(FunctionInputs.DESCRIPTION, description)
                        )
                        .onlyIf(iconItemID != null, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .search(FunctionInputs.ICON)
                                .clickSlotAndWait(iconItemID, true)
                        )
                        .onlyIf(automaticExecution, () -> new ActionBuilder()
                                .searchForAnvil(FunctionInputs.AUTOMATIC_EXECUTION, String.valueOf(loopTime))
                        )
                        .gotoFunction(true, functionName, true)
                       )
                .get();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

public class NeoHouseConfig {
    public static final NeoHouseConfig INSTANCE = new NeoHouseConfig();

    public int     clickDelay                 = 2;
    public boolean showArgumentHints          = true;
    public boolean showArgumentRecommendations = true;
    public boolean autoIndent                  = true;
    public boolean overrideExisting            = true;
    public String  syntaxTheme                = SyntaxTheme.VSCODE_DARK.name();
    public String  uiTheme                   = UITheme.DARK_BLUE.name();
    public String  uiOpacity                 = UIOpacity.DEFAULT.name();

    private static boolean loaded = false;
    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();

    private NeoHouseConfig() {}

    public static NeoHouseConfig get() {
        if (!loaded) { load(); loaded = true; }
        return INSTANCE;
    }

    private static Path configPath() {
        return Minecraft.getInstance().gameDirectory.toPath().resolve("neohouse-config.json");
    }

    public static void load() {
        Path path = configPath();
        if (!Files.exists(path)) { INSTANCE.save(); return; }
        try {
            String json = Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            JsonObject obj = JsonParser.parseString(json).getAsJsonObject();
            if (obj.has("clickDelay"))               INSTANCE.clickDelay                 = obj.get("clickDelay").getAsInt();
            if (obj.has("showArgumentHints"))          INSTANCE.showArgumentHints          = obj.get("showArgumentHints").getAsBoolean();
            if (obj.has("showArgumentRecommendations")) INSTANCE.showArgumentRecommendations = obj.get("showArgumentRecommendations").getAsBoolean();
            if (obj.has("autoIndent"))                 INSTANCE.autoIndent                  = obj.get("autoIndent").getAsBoolean();
            if (obj.has("overrideExisting"))           INSTANCE.overrideExisting            = obj.get("overrideExisting").getAsBoolean();
            if (obj.has("syntaxTheme"))                INSTANCE.syntaxTheme                 = obj.get("syntaxTheme").getAsString();
            if (obj.has("uiTheme"))                    INSTANCE.uiTheme                     = obj.get("uiTheme").getAsString();
            if (obj.has("uiOpacity"))                  INSTANCE.uiOpacity                   = obj.get("uiOpacity").getAsString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            MessageUtils.warningToChat("Config load failed (" + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + "): " + e.getMessage() + ". Using defaults.");
        }
    }

    public void save() {
        JsonObject obj = new JsonObject();
        obj.addProperty("clickDelay",                 clickDelay);
        obj.addProperty("showArgumentHints",          showArgumentHints);
        obj.addProperty("showArgumentRecommendations", showArgumentRecommendations);
        obj.addProperty("autoIndent",                  autoIndent);
        obj.addProperty("overrideExisting",            overrideExisting);
        obj.addProperty("syntaxTheme",                 syntaxTheme);
        obj.addProperty("uiTheme",                    uiTheme);
        obj.addProperty("uiOpacity",                  uiOpacity);
        try {
            Files.writeString(configPath(), GSON.toJson(obj), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (IOException ignored) {}
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse;

public enum SyntaxTheme {
    VSCODE_DARK("VS Code Dark",
                0xFF569CD6,  // keyword
                0xFF4EC9B0,  // type
                0xFFB5CEA8,  // number
                0xFFCE9178,  // string
                0xFF6A9955,  // comment
                0xFF608B4E,  // note
                0xFFDCDCAA,  // action
                0xFFD4D4D4,  // plain
                0xFF4DAAFF,  // playerVar
                0xFFD4A0FF,  // globalVar
                0xFFFF9966,  // teamVar
                0xFF4FC1FF,  // phVar
                0xFF9CDCFE   // phNameValid
    ),
    MONOKAI("Monokai",
            0xFFF92672,  // keyword
            0xFF66D9E8,  // type
            0xFFAE81FF,  // number
            0xFFE6DB74,  // string
            0xFF75715E,  // comment
            0xFF75715E,  // note
            0xFFA6E22E,  // action
            0xFFF8F8F2,  // plain
            0xFFA6E22E,  // playerVar
            0xFFAE81FF,  // globalVar
            0xFFFD971F,  // teamVar
            0xFF66D9E8,  // phVar
            0xFF66D9E8   // phNameValid
    ),
    SOLARIZED_DARK("Solarized Dark",
                   0xFF268BD2, // keyword (blue)
                   0xFFB58900, // type (yellow)
                   0xFFD33682, // number (magenta)
                   0xFF2AA198, // string (cyan)
                   0xFF586E75, // comment
                   0xFF657B83, // note
                   0xFF859900, // action (green)
                   0xFFEEE8D5, // plain
                   0xFFCB4B16, // playerVar (orange)
                   0xFF6C71C4, // globalVar (violet)
                   0xFFDC322F, // teamVar (red)
                   0xFF268BD2, // phVar
                   0xFF2AA198  // phNameValid
    ),
    DRACULA("Dracula",
            0xFFFF79C6, // keyword (pink)
            0xFF8BE9FD, // type (cyan)
            0xFFBD93F9, // number (purple)
            0xFFF1FA8C, // string (yellow)
            0xFF6272A4, // comment
            0xFF6272A4, // note
            0xFF50FA7B, // action (green)
            0xFFF8F8F2, // plain
            0xFFFFB86C, // playerVar (orange)
            0xFFBD93F9, // globalVar
            0xFFFF5555, // teamVar (red)
            0xFF8BE9FD, // phVar
            0xFF50FA7B  // phNameValid
    ),
    ONE_DARK("One Dark",
             0xFFC678DD, // keyword (purple)
             0xFFE5C07B, // type (yellow)
             0xFFD19A66, // number (orange)
             0xFF98C379, // string (green)
             0xFF5C6370, // comment
             0xFF5C6370, // note
             0xFF61AFEF, // action (blue)
             0xFFABB2BF, // plain
             0xFFE06C75, // playerVar (red)
             0xFFC678DD, // globalVar
             0xFFD19A66, // teamVar
             0xFF56B6C2, // phVar (cyan)
             0xFF98C379  // phNameValid
    ),
    NORD("Nord",
         0xFF81A1C1, // keyword
         0xFF8FBCBB, // type
         0xFFB48EAD, // number
         0xFFA3BE8C, // string
         0xFF4C566A, // comment
         0xFF434C5E, // note
         0xFF88C0D0, // action
         0xFFD8DEE9, // plain
         0xFFEBCB8B, // playerVar
         0xFFB48EAD, // globalVar
         0xFFBF616A, // teamVar
         0xFF81A1C1, // phVar
         0xFF8FBCBB  // phNameValid
    );

    public final String displayName;
    public final int keyword, type, number, string, comment, note, action, plain;
    public final int playerVar, globalVar, teamVar, phVar, phNameValid;

    SyntaxTheme(String displayName,
                int keyword, int type, int number, int string,
                int comment, int note, int action, int plain,
                int playerVar, int globalVar, int teamVar, int phVar, int phNameValid) {
        this.displayName = displayName;
        this.keyword = keyword;
        this.type = type;
        this.number = number;
        this.string = string;
        this.comment = comment;
        this.note = note;
        this.action = action;
        this.plain = plain;
        this.playerVar = playerVar;
        this.globalVar = globalVar;
        this.teamVar = teamVar;
        this.phVar = phVar;
        this.phNameValid = phNameValid;
    }

    public static SyntaxTheme byId(String id) {
        for (SyntaxTheme t : values()) if (t.name().equals(id)) return t;
        return VSCODE_DARK;
    }

    public SyntaxTheme next() {
        SyntaxTheme[] vals = values();
        return vals[(ordinal() + 1) % vals.length];
    }

    public SyntaxTheme prev() {
        SyntaxTheme[] vals = values();
        return vals[(ordinal() + vals.length - 1) % vals.length];
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\ui\CodeEditorScreen.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UIOpacity;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UITheme;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.NHCompiler;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ScriptRunner;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.CompilingException;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

public class CodeEditorScreen extends Screen {
    private static final ScriptRunner RUNNER  = new ScriptRunner(new NHCompiler());
    private static final NHCompiler   CHECKER = new NHCompiler();

    private static final int HEADER_H = 28;

    private final Path   filePath;
    private final Screen parent;

    private String  savedContent  = null; // null = not yet loaded
    private String  pendingContent = null; // set before showing confirm dialog

    private SyntaxEditorWidget editor;
    private Button             saveBtn;

    public CodeEditorScreen(Path filePath, Screen parent) {
        super(Component.literal("Edit: " + filePath.getFileName()));
        this.filePath = filePath;
        this.parent   = parent;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        int rx = this.width - 6;
        int bh = 18;
        int by = (HEADER_H - bh) / 2;

        saveBtn = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Save"), btn -> save())
                .bounds(rx - 186, by, 46, bh).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Save & Run"), btn -> saveAndRun())
                .bounds(rx - 136, by, 76, bh).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Close"), btn -> onClose())
                .bounds(rx - 56, by, 56, bh).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("(i)").withStyle(ChatFormatting.AQUA), btn ->
                        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new HelpScreen(this)))
                .bounds(6, by, 24, bh).build());

        editor = new SyntaxEditorWidget(4, HEADER_H + 2, this.width - 8, this.height - HEADER_H - 5);
        editor.setOnChange(() -> { checkErrors(); updateSaveBtn(); });

        String content;
        if (pendingContent != null) {
            content        = pendingContent;
            pendingContent = null;
        } else {
            try {
                content = Files.readString(filePath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                content = "";
                MessageUtils.errorToChat("Could not load file: " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        editor.setValue(content);

        if (savedContent == null) {
            savedContent = editor.getValue(); // first load
        }

        addRenderableWidget(editor);
        setInitialFocus(editor);
        checkErrors();
        updateSaveBtn();
    }

    private boolean isDirty() {
        return editor != null && !editor.getValue().equals(savedContent);
    }

    private void updateSaveBtn() {
        if (saveBtn != null) saveBtn.active = isDirty();
    }

    private void checkErrors() {
        try {
            CHECKER.compile(editor.getValue(), filePath.getParent());
            editor.clearError();
        } catch (CompilingException e) {
            if (e.errorToken != null) {
                int line0     = e.errorToken.line - 1;
                int colStart0 = e.errorToken.column - e.errorToken.text.length() - 1;
                editor.setError(line0, Math.max(0, colStart0), e.errorToken.text.length(), e.getMessage());
            } else {
                editor.setError(-1, -1, 0, e.getMessage());
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            editor.setError(-1, -1, 0, "Internal error: " + e);
        }
    }

    private void save() {
        try {
            Files.writeString(filePath, editor.getValue(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            savedContent = editor.getValue();
            updateSaveBtn();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Save failed: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void saveAndRun() {
        save();
        discard();
        try {
            RUNNER.runScript(filePath);
            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + filePath.getFileName());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
        }
    }

    private void discard() {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(parent);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int key, int scan, int mods) {
        if (key == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE && editor != null && editor.hasSuggestions()) {
            editor.dismissSuggestions();
            return true;
        }
        if ((mods & GLFW.GLFW_MOD_CONTROL) != 0 && key == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_S) {
            save();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(key, scan, mods);
    }

    @Override
    public void onClose() {
        if (isDirty()) {
            pendingContent = editor.getValue();
            Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                    "Unsaved changes. Discard?",
                    this,
                    () -> {
                        pendingContent = null;
                        discard();
                    }
            ));
        } else {
            discard();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        UITheme t   = UITheme.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiTheme);
        UIOpacity o = UIOpacity.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiOpacity);
        g.fill(0, 0, this.width, this.height, t.bgTop(o.bgAlpha));
        g.fill(0, 0, this.width, HEADER_H,    t.panel(o.panelAlpha));
        g.fill(0, HEADER_H, this.width, HEADER_H + 1, t.accent());

        boolean dirty = isDirty();
        String indicator = dirty ? "● " : "";
        int indicatorColor = dirty ? 0xFFFF9944 : t.accent();
        g.drawString(this.font, indicator, 36, (HEADER_H - 8) / 2, indicatorColor, false);
        int nameX = 36 + (dirty ? font.width("● ") : 0);
        g.drawString(this.font, filePath.getFileName().toString(), nameX, (HEADER_H - 8) / 2,
                dirty ? 0xFFDDCCBB : 0xFFCCCCCC, false);

        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {}

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}

```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\ui\ConfigScreen.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.SyntaxTheme;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UIOpacity;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UITheme;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Checkbox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

public class ConfigScreen extends Screen {

    private static final int PAD     = 10;
    private static final int HEADER_H = 28;
    private static final int ROW_H    = 24;
    private static final int LABEL_W  = 220;
    private static final int BOX_W    = 60;
    private static final int BOX_H    = 14;

    private static final String[] INT_KEYS    = { "clickDelay" };
    private static final String[] INT_LABELS  = { "Delay after click (ticks):" };
    private static final String[] INT_TIPS    = { "How long to wait after each UI click (in game ticks). Lower = faster but may miss clicks." };

    private static final String[] BOOL_KEYS   = { "showArgumentHints", "showArgumentRecommendations", "autoIndent", "overrideExisting" };
    private static final String[] BOOL_LABELS = { "Show argument hints:", "Show argument recommendations:", "Auto-indent on Enter:", "Override existing on run:" };
    private static final String[] BOOL_TIPS   = {
        "Show the expected argument types when writing inside function calls.",
        "Show autocomplete suggestions for string argument values.",
        "Automatically match the indentation of the previous line on Enter.",
        "When running a script, recreate existing functions, events, commands and menus from scratch. Disable to skip items that already exist.",
    };

    private final EditBox[]  intBoxes  = new EditBox[INT_KEYS.length];
    private final Checkbox[] boolBtns  = new Checkbox[BOOL_KEYS.length];
    private SyntaxTheme activeTheme;
    private UITheme     activeUITheme;
    private UIOpacity   activeOpacity;
    private Button      themePrev, themeNext;
    private Button      uiThemePrev, uiThemeNext;
    private Button      opacityPrev, opacityNext;

    private static final int PREVIEW_H = 80;

    private final Screen parent;

    public ConfigScreen(Screen parent) {
        super(Component.literal("NeoHouse Config"));
        this.parent = parent;
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        NeoHouseConfig cfg = NeoHouseConfig.get();
        int widgetX = PAD + LABEL_W;
        int row = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < INT_KEYS.length; i++, row++) {
            int boxY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - BOX_H) / 2;
            EditBox box = new EditBox(font, widgetX, boxY, BOX_W, BOX_H, Component.empty());
            box.setMaxLength(5);
            box.setValue(switch (INT_KEYS[i]) {
                case "clickDelay" -> String.valueOf(cfg.clickDelay);
                default -> "";
            });
            intBoxes[i] = box;
            addRenderableWidget(box);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < BOOL_KEYS.length; i++, row++) {
            boolean initial = switch (BOOL_KEYS[i]) {
                case "showArgumentHints"           -> cfg.showArgumentHints;
                case "showArgumentRecommendations" -> cfg.showArgumentRecommendations;
                case "autoIndent"                  -> cfg.autoIndent;
                case "overrideExisting"            -> cfg.overrideExisting;
                default -> true;
            };
            int cbY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - BOX_H) / 2;
            boolBtns[i] = addRenderableWidget(Checkbox.builder(Component.empty(), font)
                    .pos(widgetX, cbY)
                    .selected(initial)
                    .build());
        }

        // Appearance section
        activeTheme   = SyntaxTheme.byId(cfg.syntaxTheme);
        activeUITheme = UITheme.byId(cfg.uiTheme);
        activeOpacity = UIOpacity.byId(cfg.uiOpacity);

        int arrowR = widgetX + 16 + 80 + 4;

        int themeRowY   = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - BOX_H) / 2; row++;
        int uiThemeRowY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - BOX_H) / 2; row++;
        int opacityRowY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - BOX_H) / 2;

        themePrev   = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("<"), b -> activeTheme   = activeTheme.prev()  ).bounds(widgetX, themeRowY,   16, BOX_H).build());
        themeNext   = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(">"), b -> activeTheme   = activeTheme.next()  ).bounds(arrowR,  themeRowY,   16, BOX_H).build());
        uiThemePrev = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("<"), b -> activeUITheme = activeUITheme.prev()).bounds(widgetX, uiThemeRowY, 16, BOX_H).build());
        uiThemeNext = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(">"), b -> activeUITheme = activeUITheme.next()).bounds(arrowR,  uiThemeRowY, 16, BOX_H).build());
        opacityPrev = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("<"), b -> activeOpacity = activeOpacity.prev()).bounds(widgetX, opacityRowY, 16, BOX_H).build());
        opacityNext = addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(">"), b -> activeOpacity = activeOpacity.next()).bounds(arrowR,  opacityRowY, 16, BOX_H).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("< Back"), b -> closeAndSave())
                .bounds(PAD, 5, 52, 18).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("X").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), b -> closeAndSave())
                .bounds(this.width - PAD - 18, 5, 18, 18).build());
    }

    @Override
    public void onClose() { closeAndSave(); }

    private void closeAndSave() {
        save();
        minecraft.setScreen(parent);
    }

    private void save() {
        NeoHouseConfig cfg = NeoHouseConfig.get();
        for (int i = 0; i < INT_KEYS.length; i++) {
            try {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(intBoxes[i].getValue().trim());
                if (val < 0) val = 0;
                if (INT_KEYS[i].equals("clickDelay")) cfg.clickDelay = val;
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < BOOL_KEYS.length; i++) {
            switch (BOOL_KEYS[i]) {
                case "showArgumentHints"           -> cfg.showArgumentHints          = boolBtns[i].selected();
                case "showArgumentRecommendations" -> cfg.showArgumentRecommendations = boolBtns[i].selected();
                case "autoIndent"                  -> cfg.autoIndent                  = boolBtns[i].selected();
                case "overrideExisting"            -> cfg.overrideExisting            = boolBtns[i].selected();
            }
        }
        cfg.syntaxTheme = activeTheme.name();
        cfg.uiTheme     = activeUITheme.name();
        cfg.uiOpacity   = activeOpacity.name();
        cfg.save();
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        UITheme t = activeUITheme;
        UIOpacity o = activeOpacity;
        g.fillGradient(0, 0, width, height, t.bgTop(o.bgAlpha), t.bgBottom(o.bgAlpha));
        g.fill(0, 0, width, HEADER_H, t.panel(o.panelAlpha));
        g.drawString(font, "NeoHouse — Config", PAD + 56, 9, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        g.fill(0, HEADER_H, width, HEADER_H + 1, t.accent());

        int row = 0;
        String hoveredTip = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < INT_KEYS.length; i++, row++) {
            int labelY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - 9) / 2;
            g.drawString(font, INT_LABELS[i], PAD, labelY, 0xFFCCCCCC);
            if (mouseX >= PAD && mouseX < PAD + LABEL_W && mouseY >= labelY - 2 && mouseY < labelY + 11)
                hoveredTip = INT_TIPS[i];
        }

        // Section divider
        int divY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H - 2;
        g.fill(PAD, divY, width - PAD, divY + 1, t.divider());

        for (int i = 0; i < BOOL_KEYS.length; i++, row++) {
            int labelY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - 9) / 2;
            g.drawString(font, BOOL_LABELS[i], PAD, labelY, 0xFFCCCCCC);
            if (mouseX >= PAD && mouseX < PAD + LABEL_W && mouseY >= labelY - 2 && mouseY < labelY + 11)
                hoveredTip = BOOL_TIPS[i];
        }

        // Section divider before appearance
        int divY2 = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H - 2;
        g.fill(PAD, divY2, width - PAD, divY2 + 1, t.divider());

        int nameX = (PAD + LABEL_W) + 16 + 4;

        int syntaxThemeLabelY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - 9) / 2; row++;
        g.drawString(font, "Syntax theme:", PAD, syntaxThemeLabelY, 0xFFCCCCCC);
        g.drawCenteredString(font, activeTheme.displayName, nameX + 36, syntaxThemeLabelY, 0xFFFFFFFF);

        int uiThemeLabelY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - 9) / 2; row++;
        g.drawString(font, "UI theme:", PAD, uiThemeLabelY, 0xFFCCCCCC);
        g.drawCenteredString(font, activeUITheme.displayName, nameX + 36, uiThemeLabelY, 0xFFFFFFFF);

        int opacityLabelY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + (ROW_H - 9) / 2; row++;
        g.drawString(font, "UI opacity:", PAD, opacityLabelY, 0xFFCCCCCC);
        g.drawCenteredString(font, activeOpacity.displayName, nameX + 36, opacityLabelY, 0xFFFFFFFF);

        // Syntax theme preview
        int previewY = HEADER_H + 6 + row * ROW_H + 4;
        int previewW = Math.min(320, width - 2 * PAD);
        renderPreview(g, PAD, previewY, previewW);

        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);

        if (hoveredTip != null) {
            g.renderTooltip(font, font.split(Component.literal(hoveredTip), 180), mouseX, mouseY);
        }
    }

    private void renderPreview(GuiGraphics g, int x, int y, int w) {
        g.fill(x, y, x + w, y + PREVIEW_H, 0xFF1A1A1A);
        g.renderOutline(x, y, w, PREVIEW_H, activeUITheme.accent());

        int lineY   = y + 7;
        int spacing = 10;
        int left    = x + 8;

        drawCodeLine(g, left, lineY, activeTheme.comment, "// Comment");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left, lineY, activeTheme.keyword, "function ", activeTheme.plain, "greet() {");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left + 8, lineY, activeTheme.keyword, "if ", activeTheme.plain, "(", activeTheme.playerVar, "p", activeTheme.plain, ".", activeTheme.playerVar, "hp ", activeTheme.plain, "<= ", activeTheme.number, "10", activeTheme.plain, ") {");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left + 16, lineY, activeTheme.action, "message", activeTheme.plain, "(", activeTheme.string, "\"Low HP!\"", activeTheme.plain, ");");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left + 8, lineY, activeTheme.plain, "}");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left + 8, lineY, activeTheme.globalVar, "g", activeTheme.plain, ".", activeTheme.globalVar, "score", activeTheme.plain, " += ", activeTheme.number, "1", activeTheme.plain, ";");
        lineY += spacing;
        drawCodeLine(g, left, lineY, activeTheme.plain, "}");
    }

    private void drawCodeLine(GuiGraphics g, int x, int y, Object... parts) {
        int cx = x;
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i += 2) {
            int color = (int) parts[i];
            String text = (String) parts[i + 1];
            g.drawString(font, text, cx, y, color);
            cx += font.width(text);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {}

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}
```
