# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\ui\FileBrowserScreen.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UIOpacity;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UITheme;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.NHCompiler;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.ScriptRunner;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.utils.MessageUtils;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SimpleSoundInstance;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

public class FileBrowserScreen extends Screen {
    private static final ScriptRunner RUNNER = new ScriptRunner(new NHCompiler());

    private static final int PAD      = 8;
    private static final int HEADER_H = 50;
    private static final int FOOTER_H = 30;
    private static final int ROW_H    = 22;
    private static final int BTN_H    = 16;
    private static final int SB_W     = 4;
    private static final int SB_PAD   = 3;

    private static final String[] FILE_LABELS   = { "Edit", "Run", "Rename", "Move", "Delete", "Reveal" };
    private static final String[] FOLDER_LABELS = { "Open", "Rename", "Delete" };

    private final Path   rootPath;
    private final Screen parent;
    private Path currentPath;
    private final List<Path> entries = new ArrayList<>();

    private int selectedIdx  = -1;
    private int scrollOffset = 0;

    private boolean sbDragging      = false;
    private int     sbDragStartY;
    private int     sbDragStartOffset;

    private long lastClickMs   = 0;
    private Path lastClickPath = null;

    public FileBrowserScreen(Path rootPath) {
        this(rootPath, null);
    }

    public FileBrowserScreen(Path rootPath, Screen parent) {
        super(Component.literal("NeoHouse Files"));
        this.rootPath    = rootPath;
        this.parent      = parent;
        this.currentPath = rootPath;
    }

    // ── lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        loadEntries();
        rebuildAll();
    }

    private void loadEntries() {
        entries.clear();
        try (Stream<Path> stream = Files.list(currentPath)) {
            stream.sorted(Comparator.<Path, Boolean>comparing(p -> !Files.isDirectory(p))
                                    .thenComparing(p -> p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase()))
                  .forEach(entries::add);
        } catch (IOException ignored) {}
        scrollOffset = 0;
        selectedIdx  = -1;
    }

    private void rebuildAll() {
        clearWidgets();

        // ── Header row 1: title area + Config + X ──────────────────────────
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(
                Component.literal("X").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), b -> onClose())
                .bounds(this.width - PAD - 18, 5, 18, 18).build());

        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Config"), b -> openConfig())
                .bounds(this.width - PAD - 18 - 4 - 54, 5, 54, 18).build());

        // ── Header row 2: Back + create buttons ────────────────────────────
        if (currentPath.equals(rootPath)) {
            addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("< Back"), b -> goBack())
                    .bounds(PAD, 28, 60, 16).build());
        } else {
            addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("< Back"), b -> navigateUp())
                    .bounds(PAD, 28, 60, 16).build());
        }
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("+ File"), b -> newFile())
                .bounds(PAD + 64, 28, 60, 16).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("+ Folder"), b -> newFolder())
                .bounds(PAD + 64 + 64, 28, 80, 16).build());

        // ── Footer: action buttons for selected entry ───────────────────────
        if (selectedIdx >= 0 && selectedIdx < entries.size()) {
            Path    entry  = entries.get(selectedIdx);
            boolean isDir  = Files.isDirectory(entry);
            String[] labels = isDir ? FOLDER_LABELS : FILE_LABELS;
            int x    = this.width - PAD;
            int btnY = this.height - FOOTER_H + (FOOTER_H - BTN_H) / 2;
            for (int j = labels.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                String lbl = labels[j];
                int w = Math.max(46, font.width(lbl) + 10);
                x -= (w + 4);
                int idx = j;
                addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal(lbl), b -> {
                    Minecraft.getInstance().getSoundManager().play(
                            SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK, 1.0f));
                    handleBtnClick(entry, isDir, idx);
                }).bounds(x, btnY, w, BTN_H).build());
            }
        }
    }

    // ── rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {}

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        UITheme t   = UITheme.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiTheme);
        UIOpacity o = UIOpacity.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiOpacity);
        g.fillGradient(0, 0, width, height, t.bgTop(o.bgAlpha), t.bgBottom(o.bgAlpha));

        // Header panel
        g.fill(0, 0, width, HEADER_H, t.panel(o.panelAlpha));
        g.fill(0, HEADER_H - 1, width, HEADER_H, t.accent());

        g.drawString(font, "NeoHouse  File Browser", PAD, 8, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        String rel = rootPath.equals(currentPath)
                ? "/"
                : "/" + rootPath.relativize(currentPath).toString().replace('\\', '/') + "/";
        g.drawString(font, rel, PAD, 19, t.muted());

        // Footer panel
        g.fill(0, height - FOOTER_H, width, height, t.panel(o.bgAlpha));
        g.fill(0, height - FOOTER_H, width, height - FOOTER_H + 1, t.accent());
        renderFooterInfo(g, t);

        renderList(g, mouseX, mouseY);
        renderScrollbar(g, t);

        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);

        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
            g.drawCenteredString(font, "(empty folder)", width / 2,
                    HEADER_H + (height - HEADER_H - FOOTER_H) / 2 - 4, t.accent());
        }
    }

    private void renderFooterInfo(GuiGraphics g, UITheme t) {
        int textY = height - FOOTER_H + (FOOTER_H - 8) / 2;
        if (selectedIdx >= 0 && selectedIdx < entries.size()) {
            Path    entry = entries.get(selectedIdx);
            boolean isDir = Files.isDirectory(entry);
            int color = isDir ? 0xFFFFCC55 : 0xFFCCCCCC;
            String prefix = isDir ? "▶  " : "   ";
            g.drawString(font, prefix + entry.getFileName(), PAD, textY, color, false);
        } else {
            g.drawString(font, "Click a file or folder",
                    PAD, textY, t.divider(), false);
        }
    }

    private void renderScrollbar(GuiGraphics g, UITheme t) {
        int total   = entries.size();
        int maxRows = maxVisibleRows();
        if (total <= maxRows) return;

        int trackX = width - SB_W - SB_PAD;
        int trackY = HEADER_H;
        int trackH = height - HEADER_H - FOOTER_H - 2;
        g.fill(trackX, trackY, trackX + SB_W, trackY + trackH, 0x22FFFFFF);

        int maxOff  = total - maxRows;
        int thumbH  = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / total);
        int thumbY  = trackY + (maxOff > 0 ? (trackH - thumbH) * scrollOffset / maxOff : 0);
        int thumbColor = sbDragging ? 0xCCDDDDDD : (0x77000000 | (t.muted() & 0xFFFFFF));
        g.fill(trackX, thumbY, trackX + SB_W, thumbY + thumbH, thumbColor);
    }

    private void renderList(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int listBottom = height - FOOTER_H - 2;
        int maxRows    = maxVisibleRows();
        int end        = Math.min(scrollOffset + maxRows, entries.size());

        for (int i = scrollOffset; i < end; i++) {
            int rowY = HEADER_H + (i - scrollOffset) * ROW_H;
            if (rowY + ROW_H > listBottom) break;

            Path    entry    = entries.get(i);
            boolean isDir    = Files.isDirectory(entry);
            boolean hover    = mouseY >= rowY && mouseY < rowY + ROW_H && mouseX < width - SB_W - SB_PAD - 1;
            boolean selected = (i == selectedIdx);

            UITheme t   = UITheme.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiTheme);
            int bg = selected ? t.accentTint(0x44) : hover ? 0x22FFFFFF : (i % 2 == 0 ? 0x0BFFFFFF : 0);
            g.fill(0, rowY, width - SB_W - SB_PAD - 1, rowY + ROW_H, bg);
            g.fill(0, rowY + ROW_H - 1, width - SB_W - SB_PAD - 1, rowY + ROW_H, t.accentTint(0x18));

            int textY  = rowY + (ROW_H - 8) / 2;
            int nameX  = PAD + 4;

            if (isDir) {
                g.drawString(font, "▶", nameX, textY, selected ? 0xFFFFBB44 : 0xFFAA7722, false);
                nameX += font.width("▶ ");
                g.drawString(font, entry.getFileName().toString(), nameX, textY,
                        selected ? 0xFFFFDD66 : 0xFFFFCC55, false);
            } else {
                nameX += font.width("  ");
                String name = entry.getFileName().toString();
                int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
                if (dot > 0) {
                    String base = name.substring(0, dot);
                    String ext  = name.substring(dot);
                    int nameColor = selected ? 0xFFEEEEEE : 0xFFCCCCCC;
                    g.drawString(font, base, nameX, textY, nameColor, false);
                    g.drawString(font, ext, nameX + font.width(base), textY,
                            selected ? t.muted() : t.accent(), false);
                } else {
                    g.drawString(font, name, nameX, textY, selected ? 0xFFEEEEEE : 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ── input ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mx, double my, int button) {
        // Scrollbar interaction
        if (button == 0) {
            int total   = entries.size();
            int maxRows = maxVisibleRows();
            if (total > maxRows) {
                int trackX = width - SB_W - SB_PAD;
                int trackY = HEADER_H;
                int trackH = height - HEADER_H - FOOTER_H - 2;
                if (mx >= trackX - 2 && mx <= trackX + SB_W + 2) {
                    int maxOff = total - maxRows;
                    int thumbH = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / total);
                    int thumbY = trackY + (maxOff > 0 ? (trackH - thumbH) * scrollOffset / maxOff : 0);
                    if (my >= thumbY && my < thumbY + thumbH) {
                        sbDragging        = true;
                        sbDragStartY      = (int) my;
                        sbDragStartOffset = scrollOffset;
                    } else if (my >= trackY && my < trackY + trackH) {
                        int newOff = (int) ((my - trackY - thumbH / 2.0) * maxOff / (trackH - thumbH));
                        scrollOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOff, newOff));
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Delegate to registered widgets (header + footer buttons)
        if (super.mouseClicked(mx, my, button)) return true;

        // Row click (list area only)
        if (my >= HEADER_H && my < height - FOOTER_H) {
            int maxRows = maxVisibleRows();
            int end     = Math.min(scrollOffset + maxRows, entries.size());

            for (int i = scrollOffset; i < end; i++) {
                int rowY = HEADER_H + (i - scrollOffset) * ROW_H;
                if (my < rowY || my >= rowY + ROW_H) continue;

                Path    entry  = entries.get(i);
                boolean isDir  = Files.isDirectory(entry);
                long    now    = System.currentTimeMillis();
                boolean dbl    = entry.equals(lastClickPath) && (now - lastClickMs) < 400;
                lastClickMs   = now;
                lastClickPath = entry;

                if (dbl) {
                    if (isDir) navigateInto(entry);
                    else editFile(entry);
                } else {
                    selectedIdx = (selectedIdx == i) ? -1 : i;
                    rebuildAll();
                }
                return true;
            }

            // Clicked empty list space — deselect
            if (selectedIdx != -1) {
                selectedIdx = -1;
                rebuildAll();
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mx, double my, int button, double dx, double dy) {
        if (sbDragging && button == 0) {
            int total   = entries.size();
            int maxRows = maxVisibleRows();
            if (total > maxRows) {
                int trackH = height - HEADER_H - FOOTER_H - 2;
                int thumbH = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / total);
                int maxOff = total - maxRows;
                int slideH = trackH - thumbH;
                if (slideH > 0) {
                    int delta = (int) (my - sbDragStartY);
                    scrollOffset = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOff,
                            sbDragStartOffset + delta * maxOff / slideH));
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mx, my, button, dx, dy);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mx, double my, int button) {
        if (sbDragging && button == 0) { sbDragging = false; return true; }
        return super.mouseReleased(mx, my, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double scrollX, double scrollY) {
        int maxOff = Math.max(0, entries.size() - maxVisibleRows());
        if      (scrollY > 0 && scrollOffset > 0)     scrollOffset--;
        else if (scrollY < 0 && scrollOffset < maxOff) scrollOffset++;
        return true;
    }

    // ── actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void handleBtnClick(Path entry, boolean isDir, int idx) {
        if (isDir) {
            switch (idx) {
                case 0 -> navigateInto(entry);
                case 1 -> renameEntry(entry);
                case 2 -> deleteEntry(entry);
            }
        } else {
            switch (idx) {
                case 0 -> editFile(entry);
                case 1 -> runFile(entry);
                case 2 -> renameEntry(entry);
                case 3 -> moveFile(entry);
                case 4 -> deleteEntry(entry);
                case 5 -> openInExplorer(entry);
            }
        }
    }

    private void goBack() {
        if (parent != null) minecraft.setScreen(parent);
        else onClose();
    }

    private void navigateUp() {
        if (!currentPath.equals(rootPath)) {
            currentPath = currentPath.getParent();
            loadEntries();
            rebuildAll();
        }
    }

    private void navigateInto(Path dir) {
        currentPath = dir;
        loadEntries();
        rebuildAll();
    }

    private void editFile(Path file) {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new CodeEditorScreen(file, this));
    }

    private void runFile(Path file) {
        onClose();
        try {
            com.drakou111.neohouse.ClientCommandHandler.setLastRunScript(file);
            RUNNER.runScript(file);
            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Running: " + file.getFileName());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
        }
    }

    private void renameEntry(Path entry) {
        String current = entry.getFileName().toString();
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Rename \"" + current + "\" to:", current, this,
                newName -> {
                    if (!newName.isEmpty() && !newName.equals(current)) {
                        try { Files.move(entry, entry.getParent().resolve(newName)); }
                        catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Rename failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
                    }
                }
        ));
    }

    private void moveFile(Path file) {
        String relPath = rootPath.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/');
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Move to:", relPath, this,
                newPath -> {
                    if (!newPath.isEmpty()) {
                        if (!newPath.endsWith(".nh")) newPath += ".nh";
                        Path target = rootPath.resolve(newPath);
                        try {
                            Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
                            Files.move(file, target, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                        } catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Move failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
                    }
                }
        ));
    }

    private void deleteEntry(Path entry) {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "Delete \"" + entry.getFileName() + "\"?", this,
                () -> {
                    try { deleteRecursive(entry); }
                    catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Delete failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
                }
        ));
    }

    private void deleteRecursive(Path path) throws IOException {
        if (Files.isDirectory(path)) {
            try (Stream<Path> s = Files.list(path)) {
                for (Path child : s.toList()) deleteRecursive(child);
            }
        }
        Files.deleteIfExists(path);
    }

    private void openInExplorer(Path file) {
        try { new ProcessBuilder("explorer", file.getParent().toString()).start(); }
        catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Explorer failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
    }

    private void newFile() {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "New file name:", "new.nh", this,
                name -> {
                    Path target = currentPath.resolve(name);
                    if (Files.exists(target)) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("\"" + name + "\" already exists."); return; }
                    try { Files.createFile(target); }
                    catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Create failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
                }
        ));
    }

    private void newFolder() {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new InputDialogScreen(
                "New folder name:", "folder", this,
                name -> {
                    Path target = currentPath.resolve(name);
                    if (Files.exists(target)) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("\"" + name + "\" already exists."); return; }
                    try { Files.createDirectories(target); }
                    catch (IOException e) { MessageUtils.errorToChat("Create failed: " + e.getMessage()); }
                }
        ));
    }

    private void openConfig() {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new ConfigScreen(this));
    }

    private int maxVisibleRows() {
        return Math.max(1, (height - HEADER_H - FOOTER_H - 2) / ROW_H);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\ui\HelpScreen.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UIOpacity;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UITheme;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.ActionParamKind;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.compiler.enums.VariableType;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.AddAction;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.AddCondition;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Event;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.Placeholder;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW;

import java.util.*;

public class HelpScreen extends Screen {

    private static final int PAD       = 8;
    private static final int HEADER_H  = 28;
    private static final int TAB_BTN_H = 20;
    private static final int CONTENT_Y = HEADER_H + TAB_BTN_H + 2;
    private static final int LINE_H    = 11;
    private static final int ICON_SIZE = 8;
    private static final int ICON_PAD  = ICON_SIZE + 3;
    private static final int SB_W      = 4;
    private static final int SB_PAD    = 3;

    private static final int COL_H = 0xFFFFCC55; // header
    private static final int COL_C = 0xFF88CCFF; // signature / code
    private static final int COL_T = 0xFFCCCCCC; // normal text
    private static final int COL_D = 0xFF888888; // dim

    private enum Tab {
        OVERVIEW("Overview"),
        ACTIONS("Actions"),
        CONDITIONS("Conditions"),
        EVENTS("Events"),
        PLACEHOLDERS("Placeholders");

        final String label;
        Tab(String label) { this.label = label; }
    }

    private record HelpLine(int color, String text, ResourceLocation icon) {
        HelpLine(int color, String text) { this(color, text, null); }
    }

    private record TabButton(Tab tab, int x, int w) {}

    private static final Map<Tab, List<HelpLine>> TAB_LINES;
    static {
        Map<Tab, List<HelpLine>> m = new EnumMap<>(Tab.class);
        m.put(Tab.OVERVIEW,     buildOverview());
        m.put(Tab.ACTIONS,      buildActions());
        m.put(Tab.CONDITIONS,   buildConditions());
        m.put(Tab.EVENTS,       buildEvents());
        m.put(Tab.PLACEHOLDERS, buildPlaceholders());
        TAB_LINES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(m);
    }

    private static List<HelpLine> buildOverview() {
        List<HelpLine> l = new ArrayList<>();
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_H, "Overview"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "NeoHouse is a scripting language that compiles to Hypixel Housing actions."));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "Write scripts in .nh files, then run them with the file browser or /neohouse run."));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));

        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_H, "Commands"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse                        — open home screen"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse help                   — open this help screen"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse files                  — open file browser"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse run <file>             — compile & run a script"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse run latest             — re-run last script"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse config                 — open config screen"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse delete functions       — delete all functions"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse delete events          — delete all event actions"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse delete commands        — delete all commands"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse delete menus           — delete all custom menus"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  /neohouse nuke                   — delete everything"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));

        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_H, "Variable Types"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  long   — whole numbers"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  double — decimal numbers"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  string — text"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));

        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_H, "Language Basics"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "  Define variables:"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "    long counter;"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "  Conditions:"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "    if (playerHealth < 5.0) { kill(); }"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "    if (isPvpEnabled(true)) { ... } else { ... }"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "  Random blocks:"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "    random [ { kill(); }  { heal(); } ]"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_T, "  Actions called directly:"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "    message(\"Hello\");"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));

        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_H, "Operators"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  + - * /   arithmetic"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  == != < <= > >=   comparison"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  && ||   logical"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  = += -= *= /=   assignment"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, "  (long) (double) (string)   casts"));
        l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));

        return l;
    }

    private static String kindStr(ActionParamKind k) {
        return switch (k) {
            case STRING_LITERAL    -> "string";
            case BOOL_LITERAL      -> "bool";
            case LONG_LITERAL      -> "int";
            case DOUBLE_LITERAL    -> "float";
            case NORMAL_EXPRESSION -> "expr";
            case ITEM_LITERAL      -> "item";
        };
    }

    private static String typeStr(VariableType t) {
        return switch (t) {
            case STRING -> "string";
            case LONG   -> "int";
            case DOUBLE -> "float";
            case BOOL   -> "bool";
            case VAR    -> "var";
        };
    }

    private static List<HelpLine> buildActions() {
        List<HelpLine> l = new ArrayList<>();
        for (AddAction a : AddAction.values()) {
            if (!a.canBeUsed) continue;
            StringBuilder sig = new StringBuilder(a.name).append("(");
            for (int i = 0; i < a.params.size(); i++) {
                if (i > 0) sig.append(", ");
                sig.append(kindStr(a.params.get(i).kind()));
            }
            sig.append(")");
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, sig.toString(), a.texture));
            if (!a.description.isEmpty())
                l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, "    " + a.description));
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));
        }
        return l;
    }

    private static List<HelpLine> buildConditions() {
        List<HelpLine> l = new ArrayList<>();
        for (AddCondition c : AddCondition.values()) {
            if (!c.canBeUsed) continue;
            StringBuilder sig = new StringBuilder(c.name).append("(");
            for (int i = 0; i < c.params.size(); i++) {
                if (i > 0) sig.append(", ");
                sig.append(kindStr(c.params.get(i).kind()));
            }
            sig.append(")");
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, sig.toString(), c.texture));
            if (!c.description.isEmpty())
                l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, "    " + c.description));
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));
        }
        return l;
    }

    private static List<HelpLine> buildEvents() {
        List<HelpLine> l = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Event e : Event.values()) {
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, e.name, e.texture));
            if (!e.description.isEmpty())
                l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, "    " + e.description));
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));
        }
        return l;
    }

    private static List<HelpLine> buildPlaceholders() {
        List<HelpLine> l = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Placeholder p : Placeholder.values()) {
            StringBuilder sig = new StringBuilder(p.name);
            if (!p.constTypes.isEmpty()) {
                sig.append("(");
                for (int i = 0; i < p.constTypes.size(); i++) {
                    if (i > 0) sig.append(", ");
                    sig.append(typeStr(p.constTypes.get(i)));
                }
                sig.append(")");
            }
            sig.append(" : ").append(typeStr(p.type));
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_C, sig.toString()));
            if (!p.description.isEmpty())
                l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, "    " + p.description));
            l.add(new HelpLine(COL_D, ""));
        }
        return l;
    }

    private Tab activeTab = Tab.OVERVIEW;
    private final Map<Tab, Integer> scrollPos = new EnumMap<>(Tab.class);
    private List<TabButton> tabButtons = Collections.emptyList();

    private boolean sbDragging = false;
    private int sbDragStartY;
    private int sbDragStartScroll;

    private final Screen parent;

    public HelpScreen(Screen parent) {
        super(Component.literal("NeoHouse Help"));
        this.parent = parent;
        for (Tab t : Tab.values()) scrollPos.put(t, 0);
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("< Back"), b -> minecraft.setScreen(parent))
                .bounds(PAD, 5, 52, 18).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("X").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), b -> onClose())
                .bounds(this.width - PAD - 18, 5, 18, 18).build());

        List<TabButton> tabs = new ArrayList<>();
        int x = PAD;
        for (Tab t : Tab.values()) {
            int w = font.width(t.label) + 14;
            tabs.add(new TabButton(t, x, w));
            x += w + 2;
        }
        tabButtons = Collections.unmodifiableList(tabs);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        UITheme t   = UITheme.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiTheme);
        UIOpacity o = UIOpacity.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiOpacity);
        g.fillGradient(0, 0, this.width, this.height, t.bgTop(o.bgAlpha), t.bgBottom(o.bgAlpha));
        g.fill(0, 0, this.width, HEADER_H, t.panel(o.panelAlpha));
        g.drawString(this.font, "NeoHouse — Help", PAD + 56, 9, 0xFFFFFFFF);
        g.fill(0, HEADER_H, this.width, HEADER_H + 1, t.accent());

        int tabY = HEADER_H + 1;
        for (TabButton tb : tabButtons) {
            boolean active = tb.tab() == activeTab;
            boolean hover  = mouseX >= tb.x() && mouseX < tb.x() + tb.w()
                          && mouseY >= tabY    && mouseY < tabY + TAB_BTN_H;
            int bg = active ? t.highlight(0xFF) : hover ? t.panel(0xFF) : t.surface(0xFF);
            g.fill(tb.x(), tabY, tb.x() + tb.w(), tabY + TAB_BTN_H, bg);
            int labelX = tb.x() + (tb.w() - font.width(tb.tab().label)) / 2;
            int labelY = tabY + (TAB_BTN_H - 8) / 2;
            int textColor = active ? 0xFFFFFF88 : hover ? 0xFFCCCCCC : 0xFF888899;
            g.drawString(this.font, tb.tab().label, labelX, labelY, textColor, false);
            if (active)
                g.fill(tb.x(), tabY + TAB_BTN_H - 2, tb.x() + tb.w(), tabY + TAB_BTN_H, t.accent());
        }
        g.fill(0, tabY + TAB_BTN_H, this.width, tabY + TAB_BTN_H + 1, t.accent());

        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);

        List<HelpLine> lines = TAB_LINES.get(activeTab);
        int scroll  = clampScroll(lines);
        int listH   = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
        int maxRows = listH / LINE_H;
        int end     = Math.min(scroll + maxRows, lines.size());

        int contentRight = this.width - SB_W - SB_PAD - 2;
        g.enableScissor(0, CONTENT_Y, contentRight, this.height - 4);
        for (int i = scroll; i < end; i++) {
            HelpLine line = lines.get(i);
            int y     = CONTENT_Y + (i - scroll) * LINE_H;
            int textX = PAD;
            if (line.icon() != null && !line.text().isEmpty()) {
                renderIcon(g, line.icon(), PAD, y);
                textX = PAD + ICON_PAD;
            }
            g.drawString(this.font, line.text(), textX, y, line.color(), false);
        }
        g.disableScissor();

        renderScrollbar(g, lines, scroll, maxRows, t);
    }

    private void renderScrollbar(GuiGraphics g, List<HelpLine> lines, int scroll, int maxRows, UITheme t) {
        int total = lines.size();
        if (total <= maxRows) return;

        int trackX = this.width - SB_W - SB_PAD;
        int trackY = CONTENT_Y;
        int trackH = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
        g.fill(trackX, trackY, trackX + SB_W, trackY + trackH, 0x33FFFFFF);

        int maxOff = total - maxRows;
        int thumbH = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / total);
        int thumbY = trackY + (maxOff > 0 ? (trackH - thumbH) * scroll / maxOff : 0);
        int thumbColor = sbDragging ? 0xCCDDDDDD : (0x99000000 | (t.muted() & 0xFFFFFF));
        g.fill(trackX, thumbY, trackX + SB_W, thumbY + thumbH, thumbColor);
    }

    private int clampScroll(List<HelpLine> lines) {
        int listH   = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
        int maxRows = Math.max(1, listH / LINE_H);
        int max     = Math.max(0, lines.size() - maxRows);
        int cur     = scrollPos.get(activeTab);
        if (cur > max) { scrollPos.put(activeTab, max); return max; }
        if (cur < 0)   { scrollPos.put(activeTab, 0);   return 0; }
        return cur;
    }

    private void renderIcon(GuiGraphics g, ResourceLocation texture, int x, int y) {
        Item item = BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getValue(texture);
        if (item == Items.AIR) return;
        g.pose().pushPose();
        g.pose().translate(x, y, 0);
        g.pose().scale(0.5f, 0.5f, 1.0f);
        g.renderItem(new ItemStack(item), 0, 0);
        g.pose().popPose();
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {}

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (button == 0) {
            List<HelpLine> lines = TAB_LINES.get(activeTab);
            int scroll  = scrollPos.get(activeTab);
            int listH   = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
            int maxRows = Math.max(1, listH / LINE_H);
            if (lines.size() > maxRows) {
                int trackX = this.width - SB_W - SB_PAD;
                int trackY = CONTENT_Y;
                int trackH = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
                if (mouseX >= trackX - 2 && mouseX <= trackX + SB_W + 2) {
                    int maxOff = lines.size() - maxRows;
                    int thumbH = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / lines.size());
                    int thumbY = trackY + (maxOff > 0 ? (trackH - thumbH) * scroll / maxOff : 0);
                    if (mouseY >= thumbY && mouseY < thumbY + thumbH) {
                        sbDragging = true;
                        sbDragStartY = (int) mouseY;
                        sbDragStartScroll = scroll;
                    } else if (mouseY >= trackY && mouseY < trackY + trackH) {
                        int newScroll = (int) ((mouseY - trackY - thumbH / 2.0) * maxOff / (trackH - thumbH));
                        scrollPos.put(activeTab, Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOff, newScroll)));
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        int tabY = HEADER_H + 1;
        if (mouseY >= tabY && mouseY < tabY + TAB_BTN_H) {
            for (TabButton tb : tabButtons) {
                if (mouseX >= tb.x() && mouseX < tb.x() + tb.w()) {
                    activeTab = tb.tab();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double dx, double dy) {
        if (sbDragging && button == 0) {
            List<HelpLine> lines = TAB_LINES.get(activeTab);
            int listH   = this.height - CONTENT_Y - 4;
            int maxRows = Math.max(1, listH / LINE_H);
            int trackH  = listH;
            int thumbH  = Math.max(16, trackH * maxRows / lines.size());
            int maxOff  = lines.size() - maxRows;
            int slideH  = trackH - thumbH;
            if (slideH > 0) {
                int delta = (int) (mouseY - sbDragStartY);
                scrollPos.put(activeTab, Math.max(0, Math.min(maxOff, sbDragStartScroll + delta * maxOff / slideH)));
            }
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, dx, dy);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (sbDragging && button == 0) { sbDragging = false; return true; }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double scrollX, double scrollY) {
        int cur = scrollPos.get(activeTab);
        if (scrollY > 0 && cur > 0) scrollPos.put(activeTab, cur - 1);
        else if (scrollY < 0)       scrollPos.put(activeTab, cur + 1);
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int key, int scan, int mods) {
        int cur   = scrollPos.get(activeTab);
        List<HelpLine> lines = TAB_LINES.get(activeTab);
        switch (key) {
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_UP        -> { if (cur > 0) scrollPos.put(activeTab, cur - 1); return true; }
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_DOWN      -> { scrollPos.put(activeTab, cur + 1); return true; }
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP   -> { scrollPos.put(activeTab, Math.max(0, cur - 10)); return true; }
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_DOWN -> { scrollPos.put(activeTab, cur + 10); return true; }
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_HOME      -> { scrollPos.put(activeTab, 0); return true; }
            case GLFW.GLFW_KEY_END       -> { scrollPos.put(activeTab, lines.size()); return true; }
        }
        return super.keyPressed(key, scan, mods);
    }


    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.hint;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.util.Set;

public class HasItemHint implements HintProvider {
    private final String text;
    private final Set<String> items;
    private final int minCount;

    public HasItemHint(String text, Set<String> items, int minCount) {
        this.text     = text;
        this.items    = items;
        this.minCount = minCount;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldShow(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.player == null) return false;
        int count = 0;
        for (ItemStack stack : mc.player.getInventory().items) {
            if (stack.isEmpty()) continue;
            ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(stack.getItem());
            if (items.contains(id.getPath())) count += stack.getCount();
        }
        return count >= minCount;
    }

    @Override
    public String getText(Minecraft mc) {
        return text;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.hint;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public class InventoryUniquenessHint implements HintProvider {
    private final String text;
    private final int min;
    private final int max;

    public InventoryUniquenessHint(String text, int min, int max) {
        this.text = text;
        this.min  = min;
        this.max  = max;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldShow(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.player == null) return false;
        Set<String> unique = new HashSet<>();
        for (ItemStack stack : mc.player.getInventory().items) {
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) unique.add(stack.getItem().toString());
        }
        return unique.size() >= min && unique.size() <= max;
    }

    @Override
    public String getText(Minecraft mc) {
        return text;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.hint;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

public class PlayerCountHint implements HintProvider {
    private final String text;
    private final int min;
    private final int max;

    public PlayerCountHint(String text, int min, int max) {
        this.text = text;
        this.min  = min;
        this.max  = max;
    }

    public PlayerCountHint(String text, int exact) {
        this(text, exact, exact);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldShow(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.level == null) return false;
        int count = 0;
        for (var player : mc.level.players()) {
            if (player.isControlledByOrIsLocalPlayer()) count++;
            if (count > max) return false;
        }
        return count >= min;
    }

    @Override
    public String getText(Minecraft mc) {
        return text;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.hint;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

public class PositionHint implements HintProvider {
    private final String text;
    private final double minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ;

    public PositionHint(String text, double minX, double maxX, double minY, double maxY, double minZ, double maxZ) {
        this.text = text;
        this.minX = minX; this.maxX = maxX;
        this.minY = minY; this.maxY = maxY;
        this.minZ = minZ; this.maxZ = maxZ;
    }

    public PositionHint(String text, double min, double max, Direction.Axis axis) {
        this(text,
             axis == Direction.Axis.X ? min : -Double.MAX_VALUE,
             axis == Direction.Axis.X ? max :  Double.MAX_VALUE,
             axis == Direction.Axis.Y ? min : -Double.MAX_VALUE,
             axis == Direction.Axis.Y ? max :  Double.MAX_VALUE,
             axis == Direction.Axis.Z ? min : -Double.MAX_VALUE,
             axis == Direction.Axis.Z ? max :  Double.MAX_VALUE);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldShow(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc == null || mc.player == null) return false;
        Vec3 pos = mc.player.position();
        return pos.x() >= minX && pos.x() <= maxX
            && pos.y() >= minY && pos.y() <= maxY
            && pos.z() >= minZ && pos.z() <= maxZ;
    }

    @Override
    public String getText(Minecraft mc) {
        return text;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui.hint;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

import java.time.LocalTime;

public class TimeOfDayHint implements HintProvider {
    private final String text;
    private final int startHour;
    private final int endHour;

    public TimeOfDayHint(String text, int startHour, int endHour) {
        this.text      = text;
        this.startHour = startHour;
        this.endHour   = endHour;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldShow(Minecraft mc) {
        int hour = LocalTime.now().getHour();
        if (startHour <= endHour) {
            return hour >= startHour && hour < endHour;
        } else {
            return hour >= startHour || hour < endHour;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String getText(Minecraft mc) {
        return text;
    }
}
```

```java
public class HomeScreen extends Screen {

            new AlwaysShowHint("Subscribe to Drakou111"),

            new AlwaysShowHint("Off by one error."),

            new AlwaysShowHint("Skill issue."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("404: Hint not found."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("git push"),
            new AlwaysShowHint("Hello, World!"),
            new AlwaysShowHint("Have you tried turning it off and on again?"),
            new AlwaysShowHint("TODO: fix this later."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("The answer is 42."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("Don't dig straight down."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("The cake is a lie."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("Drink water."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("This is fine."),
            new AlwaysShowHint("To be continued...")
    );


    public HomeScreen(Supplier<Path> scriptsDir) {
        super(Component.literal("NeoHouse"));

    private static String getVersion() {
        return ModList.get().getModContainerById(NeoHouse.MOD_ID).map(c -> "v" + c.getModInfo().getVersion()).orElse("v?");
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        int cx = this.width / 2;
        int midY = this.height / 2;
        int btnW = 110;
        int btnH = 22;
        int gap = 10;
        int totalW = 3 * btnW + 2 * gap;
        int startX = cx - totalW / 2;
        int btnY = midY + 18;
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Files"), b -> openFiles()).bounds(startX, btnY, btnW, btnH).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Help"), b -> openHelp()).bounds(startX + btnW + gap, btnY, btnW, btnH).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(Component.literal("Config"), b -> openConfig()).bounds(startX + 2 * (btnW + gap), btnY, btnW, btnH).build());
        currentHint = getRandomHint();

    private HintProvider getRandomHint() {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        List<HintProvider> allowed = HINTS.stream().filter(h -> h.shouldShow(mc)).toList();
        return allowed.get(random.nextInt(allowed.size()));

        int cx = width / 2;
        int midY = height / 2;
        int cardW = Math.min(width - 60, 390);
        int cardH = 130;
        int cardX = cx - cardW / 2;
        int cardY = midY - 62;
        g.fill(cardX, cardY, cardX + cardW, cardY + cardH, 0x18FFFFFF);
        g.renderOutline(cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, t.accentTint(0x44));
        g.fill(cardX + 28, cardY, cardX + cardW - 28, cardY + 2, t.accent());
        int titleScale = 2;
        String title = "NeoHouse";
        int titleW = font.width(title) * titleScale;
        g.pose().pushPose();
        g.pose().scale(titleScale, titleScale, 1f);
        g.drawString(font, title, (cx - titleW / 2) / titleScale, (midY - 46) / titleScale, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);
        g.pose().popPose();
        g.drawCenteredString(font, "Housing Script Compiler", cx, midY - 24, t.muted());
        int divW = cardW - 48;
        g.fill(cx - divW / 2, midY - 10, cx + divW / 2, midY - 9, t.divider());
        String meta = getVersion() + " · by Drakou111 · " + BuildConstants.BUILD_DATE;
        g.drawCenteredString(font, meta, cx, midY - 4, t.accent());
        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
        g.drawCenteredString(font, currentHint.getText(minecraft), cx, height - 14, t.divider());
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
    }

    private void openFiles() {
        minecraft.setScreen(new FileBrowserScreen(scriptsDir.get(), this));
    }

    private void openHelp() {
        minecraft.setScreen(new HelpScreen(this));
    }

    private void openConfig() {
        minecraft.setScreen(new ConfigScreen(this));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() {
        return false;
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\ui\InputDialogScreen.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.ui;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UIOpacity;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.UITheme;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Button;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.components.EditBox;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;

import java.util.function.Consumer;

public class InputDialogScreen extends Screen {
    private static final int LINE_H   = 10;
    private static final int PAD      = 8;
    private static final int BTN_H    = 20;
    private static final int INPUT_H  = 18;
    private static final int MIN_W    = 200;
    private static final int TITLE_H  = 18;

    private final String   prompt;
    private final String   defaultValue;
    private final Screen   parent;
    private final Consumer<String> onConfirm;
    private final boolean  confirmOnly;
    private EditBox inputBox;

    private int dialogW;
    private int dialogH;

    public InputDialogScreen(String prompt, String defaultValue, Screen parent, Consumer<String> onConfirm) {
        super(Component.literal("Input"));
        this.prompt       = prompt;
        this.defaultValue = defaultValue;
        this.parent       = parent;
        this.onConfirm    = onConfirm;
        this.confirmOnly  = false;
    }

    public InputDialogScreen(String prompt, Screen parent, Runnable onConfirm) {
        super(Component.literal("Confirm"));
        this.prompt       = prompt;
        this.defaultValue = "";
        this.parent       = parent;
        this.onConfirm    = ignored -> onConfirm.run();
        this.confirmOnly  = true;
    }

    private String[] promptLines() { return prompt.split("\n", -1); }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        String[] lines  = promptLines();
        int promptH     = lines.length * LINE_H;

        dialogW = MIN_W;
        for (String l : lines) dialogW = Math.max(dialogW, this.font.width(l) + 2 * PAD + 4);
        dialogW = Math.min(dialogW, this.width - 40);

        if (confirmOnly) {
            dialogH = TITLE_H + PAD + promptH + PAD + BTN_H + PAD;
        } else {
            dialogH = TITLE_H + PAD + promptH + PAD + INPUT_H + PAD + BTN_H + PAD;
        }

        int x = (this.width  - dialogW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - dialogH) / 2;

        int afterPrompt = y + TITLE_H + PAD + promptH;

        if (!confirmOnly) {
            inputBox = new EditBox(this.font, x + PAD, afterPrompt + PAD, dialogW - 2 * PAD, INPUT_H, Component.empty());
            inputBox.setMaxLength(256);
            inputBox.setValue(defaultValue);
            addRenderableWidget(inputBox);
            setInitialFocus(inputBox);
        }

        int btnY   = confirmOnly ? afterPrompt + PAD : afterPrompt + PAD + INPUT_H + PAD;
        int btnW   = (dialogW - 3 * PAD) / 2;
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(
                Component.literal("✓ OK").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), btn -> confirm())
                .bounds(x + PAD, btnY, btnW, BTN_H).build());
        addRenderableWidget(Button.builder(
                Component.literal("✗ Cancel").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), btn -> cancel())
                .bounds(x + PAD * 2 + btnW, btnY, btnW, BTN_H).build());
    }

    @Override
    public void render(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        int x  = (this.width  - dialogW) / 2;
        int y  = (this.height - dialogH) / 2;
        int cx = x + dialogW / 2;

        if (parent != null) parent.render(g, -1, -1, partialTick);
        UITheme t   = UITheme.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiTheme);
        UIOpacity o = UIOpacity.byId(NeoHouseConfig.get().uiOpacity);
        g.fill(0, 0, this.width, this.height, o.dimAlpha << 24);

        // Dialog body
        g.fill(x, y, x + dialogW, y + dialogH, t.dialog(o.panelAlpha));
        g.renderOutline(x, y, dialogW, dialogH, t.accent());

        // Title bar
        String titleLabel = confirmOnly ? "Confirm" : "Input";
        g.fill(x, y, x + dialogW, y + TITLE_H, t.panel(0xFF));
        g.fill(x, y + TITLE_H - 1, x + dialogW, y + TITLE_H, t.accent());
        g.drawCenteredString(this.font, titleLabel, cx, y + (TITLE_H - 8) / 2, t.muted());

        // Prompt lines
        String[] lines = promptLines();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            g.drawCenteredString(this.font, lines[i], cx, y + TITLE_H + PAD + i * LINE_H, 0xFFCCCCCC);
        }

        super.render(g, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
    }

    @Override
    public void renderBackground(GuiGraphics g, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {}

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (keyCode == 257 || keyCode == 335) { confirm(); return true; }
        if (keyCode == 256) { cancel(); return true; }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void confirm() {
        Screen before = Minecraft.getInstance().screen;
        onConfirm.accept(inputBox != null ? inputBox.getValue().trim() : "");
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().screen == before) {
            Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(parent);
        }
    }

    private void cancel() {
        Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(parent);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPauseScreen() { return false; }
}

```
