# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\ActionBuilder.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouseConfig;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.actiontypes.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.*;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CommandInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.CustomMenuInputs;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.constants.others.FunctionInputs;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractSignEditScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AnvilScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.ContainerScreen;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class ActionBuilder {
    private final List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>();

    public ActionBuilder clickSlotAndWait(int s, boolean leftCLick) {
        actions.add(new SlotAction(s, leftCLick));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder customItem(String itemId) {
        assert Minecraft.getInstance().player != null;
        actions.add(new CreativeGiveAction(itemId));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SlotAction(1, true, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new CreativeGiveAction(null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder sendChatAndWait(String s) {
        actions.add(new ChatAction(s));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder chatInput(String string, int slot) {
        String capped = string.length() > StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT ? string.substring(0, StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT) : string;

        actions.add(new SlotAction(slot, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, false));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new ChatAction(capped));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder anvilInput(String string, int slot) {
        String capped = string.length() > StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT ? string.substring(0, StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT) : string;

        actions.add(new SlotAction(slot, true));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(AnvilScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new AnvilAction(capped));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder search(String text) {
        return search(text, null, true, null, null);
    }

    public ActionBuilder search(String text, Item itemType, boolean leftClick, ActionBuilder onFound, ActionBuilder onNotFound) {
        actions.add(new SearchAction(text, itemType, leftClick, onFound != null ? onFound.get() : null, onNotFound != null ? onNotFound.get() : null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder searchForAnvil(String text, String anvilText) {
        String capped = anvilText.length() > StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT ? anvilText.substring(0, StringLimits.ANVIL_TEXT) : anvilText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, text, null, true,
                                     AnvilScreen.class,
                                     new ActionBuilder()
                    .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                    .append(new AnvilAction(capped))
                    .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                    .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                    .get(),
                                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder searchForChat(String text, String chatText) {
        String capped = chatText.length() > StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT ? chatText.substring(0, StringLimits.CHAT_TEXT) : chatText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, text, null, true,
                     ContainerScreen.class, false,
                     new ActionBuilder()
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .append(new ChatAction(capped))
                             .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .get(),
                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder signInput(String searchText, String signText) {
        String capped = signText.length() > StringLimits.SIGN_TEXT ? signText.substring(0, StringLimits.SIGN_TEXT) : signText;
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, searchText, null, true,
                                     AbstractSignEditScreen.class,
                                     new ActionBuilder()
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .append(new SignAction(capped))
                             .append(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true))
                             .append(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay))
                             .get(),
                                     null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoFunction(boolean hasUIOpened, String name, boolean leftClick) {
        if (hasUIOpened) {
            actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
            actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        }
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.FUNCTIONS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoCommand(boolean hasUIOpened, String name, boolean leftClick) {
        if (hasUIOpened) {
            actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
            actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        }
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.COMMANDS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction("/" + name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder onlyIf(boolean condition, Supplier<ActionBuilder> ifInside) {
        if (condition) {
            ActionBuilder branch = ifInside.get();
            this.actions.addAll(branch.actions);
        }
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder onlyIfElse(boolean condition, Supplier<ActionBuilder> ifInside, Supplier<ActionBuilder> elseInside) {
        ActionBuilder branch;

        if (condition) branch = ifInside.get();
        else branch = elseInside.get();

        this.actions.addAll(branch.actions);

        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder addAction(AddAction action, RestrictionAction restriction) {
        return this.clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6, true)
                   .search(action.displayName);
    }

    public ActionBuilder addCondition(AddCondition action, RestrictionCondition restriction) {
        return this.clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_ADD_H6, true)
                   .search(action.displayName);
    }

    public ActionBuilder closeAll() {
        actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder append(Action action) {
        this.actions.add(action);
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeFunctionIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search(name, null, false,
             new ActionBuilder()
                     .search(FunctionInputs.DELETE)
                     .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

             new ActionBuilder().empty() // Do nothing
        );
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeCommandIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search("/" + name, null, false,
                           new ActionBuilder()
                                   .search(CommandInputs.DELETE)
                                   .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

                           new ActionBuilder().empty() // Do nothing
                          );
    }

    public ActionBuilder removeMenuIfPresent(String name) {
        return this.search(name, null, false,
                           new ActionBuilder()
                                   .search(CustomMenuInputs.DELETE)
                                   .clickSlotAndWait(Others.GENERAL_CONFIRM, true),

                           new ActionBuilder().empty()
                          );
    }

    public ActionBuilder gotoCustomMenu(String name, boolean leftClick) {
        actions.add(new CloseScreenAction());
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new ChatAction(Commands.CUSTOM_MENUS));
        actions.add(new WaitForAction(ContainerScreen.class, true));
        actions.add(new WaitTicksAction(NeoHouseConfig.get().clickDelay));
        actions.add(new SearchAction(null, name, null, leftClick, null, null));
        return this;
    }

    public ActionBuilder empty() {
        this.actions.add(new EmptyAction());
        return this;
    }

    public GroupAction get() {
        return new GroupAction(actions);
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\HousingCheck.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ServerData;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.world.scores.Scoreboard;

public class HousingCheck {

    public static boolean isOnHypixel() {
        ServerData srv = Minecraft.getInstance().getCurrentServer();
        if (srv == null) return false;
        String ip = srv.ip.toLowerCase();
        return ip.contains("hypixel.net") || ip.contains("hypixel.io");
    }

    public static boolean isInHousing() {
        if (!isOnHypixel()) return false;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.level == null) return false;

        return hasHousingScoreboard(mc) && hasHousingFooter(mc);
    }

    private static boolean hasHousingScoreboard(Minecraft mc) {
        Scoreboard sb = mc.level.getScoreboard();

        return sb.getObjectives().stream().anyMatch(obj -> {
            String name = obj.getName().toLowerCase();
            String display = obj.getDisplayName().getString().toLowerCase();
            return name.contains("housing") || display.contains("housing");
        });
    }

    private static boolean hasHousingFooter(Minecraft mc) {
        try {
            var tabList = mc.gui.getTabList();
            var footerField = tabList.getClass().getDeclaredField("footer");
            footerField.setAccessible(true);

            Component footer = (Component) footerField.get(tabList);
            return footer != null && footer.getString().toLowerCase().contains("you are in");
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.MutableComponent;

public class MessageUtils {

    public static void rawLogToChat(String message) {
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player != null) {
            Minecraft.getInstance().player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal(message), false);
        }
    }

    private static void sendPrefixedMultiline(Object message, String prefixText,
                                              ChatFormatting prefixColor,
                                              ChatFormatting bodyColor) {
        if (Minecraft.getInstance().player == null) return;
        String text = String.valueOf(message).replace("\t", "    ");
        String[] lines = text.split("\n");
        MutableComponent full = Component.empty();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            Component prefix = Component.literal(prefixText).withStyle(prefixColor);
            Component body = Component.literal(lines[i]).withStyle(bodyColor);
            full.append(prefix).append(body);
            if (i < lines.length - 1) {
                full.append(Component.literal("\n"));
            }
        }
        Minecraft.getInstance().player.displayClientMessage(full, false);
    }

    public static void debugToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[NEO_HOUSE] ", ChatFormatting.AQUA, ChatFormatting.GRAY);
    }

    public static void errorToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[ERROR] ", ChatFormatting.RED, ChatFormatting.RED);
    }

    public static void warningToChat(Object message) {
        sendPrefixedMultiline(message, "[WARNING] ", ChatFormatting.YELLOW, ChatFormatting.YELLOW);
    }
}
```

# src\main\java\com\drakou111\neohouse\utils\SequenceManager.java

```java
package com.drakou111.neohouse.utils;

import com.drakou111.neohouse.NeoHouse;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.actions.Action;
import com.drakou111.neohouse.exceptions.InterruptActionException;
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = NeoHouse.MOD_ID, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class SequenceManager {
    private static Action currentAction = null;

    public static void startAction(Action action) {
        currentAction = action;
    }

    public static void cancelAction() {
        currentAction = null;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
        if (currentAction == null) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();

        boolean finished;
        try {
            finished = currentAction.run(mc);
        } catch (InterruptActionException e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat(e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.toString());
            currentAction = null;
            return;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            MessageUtils.errorToChat("Script aborted due to unexpected error: " + e);
            currentAction = null;
            return;
        }

        if (finished) {
            MessageUtils.debugToChat("Done!");
            currentAction = null;
        }
    }
}
```

# src\main\templates\META-INF\neoforge.mods.toml

```toml
# This is an example neoforge.mods.toml file. It contains the data relating to the loading mods.
# There are several mandatory fields (#mandatory), and many more that are optional (#optional).
# The overall format is standard TOML format, v0.5.0.
# Note that there are a couple of TOML lists in this file.
# Find more information on toml format here:  https://github.com/toml-lang/toml
# The name of the mod loader type to load - for regular FML @Mod mods it should be javafml
modLoader="javafml" #mandatory

# A version range to match for said mod loader - for regular FML @Mod it will be the FML version. This is currently 2.
loaderVersion="${loader_version_range}" #mandatory

# The license for you mod. This is mandatory metadata and allows for easier comprehension of your redistributive properties.
# Review your options at https://choosealicense.com/. All rights reserved is the default copyright stance, and is thus the default here.
license="${mod_license}"

# A URL to refer people to when problems occur with this mod
#issueTrackerURL="https://change.me.to.your.issue.tracker.example.invalid/" #optional

# A list of mods - how many allowed here is determined by the individual mod loader
[[mods]] #mandatory

# The modid of the mod
modId="${mod_id}" #mandatory

# The version number of the mod
version="${mod_version}" #mandatory

# A display name for the mod
displayName="${mod_name}" #mandatory

# A URL to query for updates for this mod. See the JSON update specification https://docs.neoforged.net/docs/misc/updatechecker/
#updateJSONURL="https://change.me.example.invalid/updates.json" #optional

# A URL for the "homepage" for this mod, displayed in the mod UI
#displayURL="https://change.me.to.your.mods.homepage.example.invalid/" #optional

# A file name (in the root of the mod JAR) containing a logo for display
#logoFile="examplemod.png" #optional

# A text field displayed in the mod UI
#credits="" #optional

# A text field displayed in the mod UI
authors="${mod_authors}" #optional

# The description text for the mod (multi line!) (#mandatory)
description='''${mod_description}'''

# The [[mixins]] block allows you to declare your mixin config to FML so that it gets loaded.
#[[mixins]]
#config="${mod_id}.mixins.json"

# The [[accessTransformers]] block allows you to declare where your AT file is.
# If this block is omitted, a fallback attempt will be made to load an AT from META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg
#[[accessTransformers]]
#file="META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg"

# The coremods config file path is not configurable and is always loaded from META-INF/coremods.json

# A dependency - use the . to indicate dependency for a specific modid. Dependencies are optional.
[[dependencies.${mod_id}]] #optional
    # the modid of the dependency
    modId="neoforge" #mandatory
    # The type of the dependency. Can be one of "required", "optional", "incompatible" or "discouraged" (case insensitive).
    # 'required' requires the mod to exist, 'optional' does not
    # 'incompatible' will prevent the game from loading when the mod exists, and 'discouraged' will show a warning
    type="required" #mandatory
    # Optional field describing why the dependency is required or why it is incompatible
    # reason="..."
    # The version range of the dependency
    versionRange="${neo_version_range}" #mandatory
    # An ordering relationship for the dependency.
    # BEFORE - This mod is loaded BEFORE the dependency
    # AFTER - This mod is loaded AFTER the dependency
    ordering="NONE"
    # Side this dependency is applied on - BOTH, CLIENT, or SERVER
    side="BOTH"

# Here's another dependency
[[dependencies.${mod_id}]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    # This version range declares a minimum of the current minecraft version up to but not including the next major version
    versionRange="${minecraft_version_range}"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

# Features are specific properties of the game environment, that you may want to declare you require. This example declares
# that your mod requires GL version 3.2 or higher. Other features will be added. They are side aware so declaring this won't
# stop your mod loading on the server for example.
#[features.${mod_id}]
#openGLVersion="[3.2,)"
```

# stonecutter.gradle

```gradle
plugins {
    id "dev.kikugie.stonecutter"
    id 'dev.architectury.loom' apply false
    id 'architectury-plugin' apply false
    id 'com.gradleup.shadow' apply false
}
stonecutter.active('1.21.11') /* [SC] DO NOT EDIT */

// Parse the active version from the line above (Stonecutter updates it on switch).
def matcher = buildFile.text =~ /stonecutter\.active\('([^']+)'\)/
def activeVer = matcher[0][1] as String
def vprops = new Properties()
def vpropsFile = file("versions/${activeVer}/gradle.properties")
if (vpropsFile.exists()) vprops.load(new FileInputStream(vpropsFile))

ext.active_mc_version  = vprops.getProperty('minecraft_version',           activeVer)
ext.active_parch_mc    = vprops.getProperty('parchment_minecraft_version', '')
ext.active_parch_ver   = vprops.getProperty('parchment_mappings_version',  '')
ext.active_fabric_api  = vprops.getProperty('fabric_api_version',          '')
ext.active_neo_version = vprops.getProperty('neo_version',                 '')
ext.active_mc_range    = vprops.getProperty('minecraft_version_range',     '')
ext.active_neo_range   = vprops.getProperty('neo_version_range',           '')

allprojects {
    repositories {
        mavenLocal()
        maven { url = 'https://maven.fabricmc.net/' }
        maven { url = 'https://maven.architectury.dev/' }
        maven { url = 'https://maven.neoforged.net/releases' }
        maven { url = 'https://maven.parchmentmc.org' }
    }
}

// Register chiseled-build tasks (build every declared MC version).
// Each version needs TWO separate Gradle processes:
//   1. switch  — updates stonecutter.gradle + transforms sources
//   2. compile — fresh process reads the new active version and configures Loom correctly
// Running both in one process would compile with the old ext.active_mc_version.
def gradlewCmd = org.gradle.internal.os.OperatingSystem.current().isWindows()
        ? ['cmd', '/c', '.\\gradlew.bat'] : ['./gradlew']
def verList = stonecutter.versions.toList()
verList.forEach { ver ->
    def switchTask = "switch-${ver.project}"
    def remapTask  = "remap-${ver.project}"

    tasks.register(switchTask, Exec) {
        group      = 'stonecutter'
        workingDir = rootDir
        commandLine(*gradlewCmd, "stonecutterSwitchTo${ver.project}")
    }
    tasks.register(remapTask, Exec) {
        group      = 'stonecutter'
        workingDir = rootDir
        commandLine(*gradlewCmd, ':neoforge:remapJar', ':fabric:remapJar')
        dependsOn switchTask
    }
    tasks.register("collect-${ver.project}") {
        group       = 'stonecutter'
        def mcVer   = ver.project
        def distDir = file("${rootDir}/dist")
        doLast {
            distDir.mkdirs()
            copy {
                from file("${rootDir}/neoforge/build/libs")
                into distDir
                include 'neohouse-*.jar'
                exclude '*-dev*.jar', '*-shadow*.jar'
                rename { "neohouse-neoforge-${mcVer}.jar" }
            }
            copy {
                from file("${rootDir}/fabric/build/libs")
                into distDir
                include 'neohouse-fabric-*.jar'
                exclude '*-dev*.jar', '*-shadow*.jar'
                rename { "neohouse-fabric-${mcVer}.jar" }
            }
        }
        dependsOn remapTask
    }
    tasks.register("build-${ver.project}") {
        group       = 'stonecutter'
        description = "Build NeoForge + Fabric JARs for MC ${ver.project}"
        dependsOn "collect-${ver.project}"
    }
}
// Force sequential ordering so version switches don't overlap.
def prev = null
verList.forEach { ver ->
    if (prev != null) {
        def cur = ver; def p = prev
        tasks.named("switch-${cur.project}").configure { mustRunAfter "build-${p.project}" }
    }
    prev = ver
}
tasks.register('chiseledBuild') {
    group       = 'stonecutter'
    description = 'Build all MC versions (NeoForge + Fabric) sequentially'
    verList.forEach { ver -> dependsOn "build-${ver.project}" }
}
tasks.named('wrapper', Wrapper).configure {
    distributionType = Wrapper.DistributionType.BIN
}

```
